https://punchng.com/lasg-seals-nine-prop.summary: The Lagos State Government has sealed nine properties across the state for alleged sewage violations, including a healthcare facility accused of pumping untreated waste directly into public drains. Its General Manager, Adefemi Afolabi, warned that property owners and facility operators who discharged untreated sewage or failed to maintain functional wastewater systems would face sanctions, including closure and prosecution.
https://punchng.com/lasg-seals-nine-prop.summary_zh: 拉各斯州政府以涉嫌违反污水管理规定为由，关闭了全州9处物业，其中包括一家被指控将未经处理的废物直接排入公共排水设施的医疗机构。该机构总经理阿德费米·阿福拉比警告称，排泄未经处理的污水或未能维持污水处理系统正常运行的物业业主和设施运营者将受到制裁，包括查封和起诉。
https://punchng.com/lasg-seals-nine-prop.body: The Lagos State Government has sealed nine properties across the state for alleged sewage violations, including a healthcare facility accused of pumping untreated waste directly into public drains. According to a statement by the Lagos State Wastewater Management Office, the facilities and their operators were guilty of violations that exposed residents to environmental pollution and public health risks. Its General Manager, Adefemi Afolabi, warned that property owners and facility operators who discharged untreated sewage or failed to maintain functional wastewater systems would face sanctions, including closure and prosecution. Afolabi added that the enforcement action targeted properties found discharging raw sewage into drainage channels and the open environment, as well as facilities with defective sewage infrastructure and unsanitary conditions. He said, “Indiscriminate discharge of untreated sewage into public drains and the open environment is a serious environmental violation that exposes residents to avoidable health risks, pollutes our surroundings and undermines the State’s sanitation efforts.” Step-by-step guide to accessing N5m Lagos business loan N10bn intervention not for Ebola alone, says NCDC boss Fintech operators seek role in Lagos digital agenda He specifically warned against using pumping machines to empty sewage into public drainage channels, insisting that property owners and business operators must use authorised evacuation services. “Every property owner, facility manager and business operator has a responsibility to provide and maintain functional sewage infrastructure and ensure that wastewater is evacuated and disposed of through authorised service providers. Defaulters will face the full weight of the law, including sealing of affected premises and prosecution where necessary,” he said. The properties sealed were located at Oko-Oba, Isolo, Alimosho, Sangotedo, Lekki, Adeniji, Lagos Island, Olodi-Apapa and Ajegunle. The agency also warned residents against assaulting or obstructing its enforcement officers, saying it would not tolerate attempts to prevent personnel from carrying out their statutory duties. Ayoola Babalola
https://punchng.com/lasg-seals-nine-prop.title_zh: LASG查封九处房产，因其排放未经处理的污水
https://punchng.com/lasg-seals-nine-prop.body_zh: 拉各斯州政府以涉嫌违反污水管理规定为由，封闭了该州9处房产，其中包括一家被控将未经处理的污水直接抽入公共排水管的医疗机构。拉各斯州污水管理办公室在一份声明中表示，这些场所及其运营者违反了相关规定，使居民面临环境污染和公共卫生风险。该机构总经理阿德费米·阿福拉比警告称，排污未经处理的污水或未能维护有效污水系统的业主及场所运营者将受到制裁，包括查封和起诉。阿福拉比补充说，此次执法行动针对的是被发现将未经处理的污水排入排水沟和开放环境的房产，以及污水基础设施存在缺陷、卫生条件不达标的场所。他说：“擅自将未经处理的污水排入公共排水管和开放环境，是严重的环保违法行为，会使居民面临本可避免的健康风险，污染周边环境，并削弱本州的卫生工作。”获取500万奈拉拉各斯商业贷款的分步指南；尼日利亚疾病控制中心负责人称，100亿奈拉干预措施并非只针对埃博拉；金融科技运营商寻求在拉各斯数字议程中发挥作用。他特别警告不要使用抽排设备将污水排入公共排水沟，并强调业主和企业运营者必须使用获准的清运服务。他说：“每一处房产的业主、场所管理者和企业运营者都有责任提供并维护有效的污水基础设施，确保污水由获准的服务提供商清运并妥善处置。违规者将依法受到全面惩处，包括查封相关场所，必要时还将被起诉。”被封闭的房产位于奥科奥巴、伊索洛、阿利莫肖、桑戈特多、莱基、阿德尼吉、拉各斯岛、奥洛迪阿帕帕和阿杰贡莱。该机构还警告居民不得袭击或妨碍其执法人员，并表示绝不容忍任何阻止工作人员履行法定职责的行为。阿约拉·巴巴洛拉

https://punchng.com/akume-lokpobiri-othe.summary: With the theme: ‘Scaling Innovative Industrial Capacity for Africa’s Energy Security,’ the 10th Africa Energy Summit is being powered by the Solewant Energy Training Institute (SETI), a subsidiary of Solewant Group of Companies, a player in the energy ecosystem. Akume is expected to deliver the keynote address to set the tone for deliberations while Lokpobiri will present a keynote speech showcasing Nigeria as a major key player in the entire global energy mix.
https://punchng.com/akume-lokpobiri-othe.summary_zh: 第十届非洲能源峰会以“扩大创新工业产能，保障非洲能源安全”为主题，由能源生态系统企业 Solewant Group of Companies 旗下子公司 Solewant Energy Training Institute（SETI）提供支持。Akume 预计将发表主旨演讲，为各项讨论定下基调；Lokpobiri 则将发表主旨演讲，展示尼日利亚作为全球能源格局中重要关键参与者的地位。
https://punchng.com/akume-lokpobiri-othe.body: Amidst pressing global energy crisis, supplies deficit, and shipping disruptions, occasioned by blockades at the Strait of Hormuz, international energy leaders, diplomats, African business leaders, and stakeholders drawn from both the public and private sector are set to discuss a roadmap for Africa’s energy security dynamics at the 10th Africa Energy Summit, holding in Nigeria’s oil and gas capital, Port Harcourt, Rivers State from on the 26th to 28th November,2026. With the theme: ‘Scaling Innovative Industrial Capacity for Africa’s Energy Security,’ the 10th Africa Energy Summit is being powered by the Solewant Energy Training Institute (SETI), a subsidiary of Solewant Group of Companies, a player in the energy ecosystem. With the core objective of connecting policy, capital, industry, enterprise, technology and knowledge in ways that translate into measurable opportunities for Africa’s industrial capacity and energy security, the conference will bring together some of Africa’s top leaders, brightest minds, energy industry captains, high-level diplomats and professionals, Including Nigeria’s Secretary to the Government of the Federation, Senator George Akume; Nigeria’s Minister of State for Petroleum (Oil), Senator Heineken Lokpobiri; Namibia’s Minister of Mines, Energy & Industry, Modestus Amutse; former Nigerian Ambassador to Thailand with concurrent accreditation to the United Nations Economic & Social Commission for Asia & the Pacific, Ambassador Oma Djebah; First Bank of Nigeria CEO/Managing director, Mr Olusegun Alebiosu; former Secretary General of Africa Petroleum Producers Organization and current World Energy Council’s Chair for Africa, Dr Farouk Ibrahim; Executive Secretary of the Nigerian Content Development & Monitoring Board, Engr Felix Ogbe; the High Commissioner of Namibia to Nigeria, Ambassador Walde Ndevashiya; top diplomats, international industry leaders from Kenya, Ghana, amongst others. Akume is expected to deliver the keynote address to set the tone for deliberations while Lokpobiri will present a keynote speech showcasing Nigeria as a major key player in the entire global energy mix. Akume loyalists reject inclusion in Alia’s campaign council Nigeria, France seek increased energy investments Nigeria hosts $5bn Africa Energy Bank headquarters Similarly, Ogbe will deliver a keynote address as a leading regulator in the industry in Nigeria while Chairman, Petroleum Technology Association of Nigeria, Engr Wole Ogunsanya, and the current chair, World Energy Council for Africa, Dr Omar Ibrahim, will deliver addresses at the summit on capacity models for advancing energy security in Africa. On his part, Namibia’s Energy Minister, Modestus Amutse, is expected to share his country’s energy experiences and opportunities at the summit while Djebah will provide insights on diplomacy, international cooperation, B-to-B, C-to-C, and P-to-P investment partnerships across international jurisdictions. Also, Ndevashiya will throw light on the Namibian experience in shaping Africa’s energy capacity and security. Other top diplomats and international industry leaders from various countries in Africa, including Kenya and Ghana, will deliver addresses on energy security ecosystem in Africa. The conveners maintain that the 10th energy summit is designed to move beyond dialogue towards practical and measurable outcomes. Dare Olawin Dare Olawin is a journalist at Punch Newspapers with over a decade of reporting experience. He began his career as a community reporter and now covers the energy sector, including oil, gas, electricity, and renewables. Dare’s work reflects hands-on newsroom experience, professional development through workshops and conferences, and a strong commitment to accurate and insightful journalism
https://punchng.com/akume-lokpobiri-othe.title_zh: 阿库梅、洛克波比里等将在第十届非洲能源峰会上发表讲话
https://punchng.com/akume-lokpobiri-othe.body_zh: 在全球能源危机日益严峻、供应短缺以及霍尔木兹海峡封锁引发航运中断之际，国际能源领域的领导者、外交官、非洲商界领袖以及来自公共和私营部门的相关各方，将于2026年11月26日至28日在尼日利亚油气之都、河流州哈科特举行的第十届非洲能源峰会上，讨论非洲能源安全动态发展路线图。第十届非洲能源峰会的主题是“扩大创新工业能力，保障非洲能源安全”，由能源生态领域企业Solewant Companies旗下机构Solewant Energy Training Institute（SETI）承办。大会的核心目标是以切实可行的方式连接政策、资本、产业、企业、技术和知识，将其转化为促进非洲工业能力提升和能源安全的可衡量机遇。大会将汇聚非洲多杰出的行业领袖、顶尖人才、能源行业领军企业负责人、高级外交官和专业人士，包括尼日利亚联邦政府秘书乔治·阿库梅参议员、尼日利亚联邦石油（石油）部国务部长海尼根·洛kpobiri参议员、纳米比亚矿产、能源与工业部长莫德斯图斯·阿穆采、前尼日利亚驻泰国大使兼常驻联合国亚洲及太平洋经济与社会委员会大使奥马·杰巴、尼日利亚第一银行首席执行官兼董事总经理奥卢塞贡·阿勒比奥苏、非洲石油生产国组织前秘书长兼世界能源理事会非洲区域主席法鲁克·易卜拉欣博士、尼日利亚本地内容开发与监督委员会执行秘书菲利克斯·奥格贝工程师、纳米比亚驻尼日利亚高级专员瓦尔德·恩德瓦希亚大使，以及来自肯尼亚、加纳等国的顶尖外交官和国际行业领袖。阿库梅预计将发表主旨演讲，为各项审议定下基调；洛kpobiri将发表主旨演讲，展示尼日利亚作为全球能源格局重要参与者的地位。阿库梅的支持者拒绝参与阿利亚的竞选委员会；法国寻求增加对尼日利亚能源投资；尼日利亚承接价值50亿美元的非洲能源银行总部。此外，奥格贝将作为尼日利亚该行业的重要监管机构代表发表主旨演讲；尼日利亚石油技术协会主席沃莱·奥贡桑亚工程师及世界能源理事会非洲区域现任主席奥马尔·易卜拉欣博士，也将在峰会上就推动非洲能源安全的能力建设模式发表讲话。纳米比亚能源部长莫德斯图斯·阿穆采预计将在峰会上分享本国的经验与机遇；杰巴将就外交、国际合作以及跨司法管辖区的B-to-B、C-to-C和P-to-P投资伙伴关系分享见解。恩德瓦希亚也将阐释纳米比亚在塑造非洲能源能力和保障能源安全方面的经验。来自非洲多个国家的其他顶尖外交官和国际行业领袖，包括来自肯尼亚和加纳的人士，将围绕非洲能源安全生态体系发表讲话。主办方表示，第十届能源峰会的宗旨是超越对话，推动形成切实可行且可衡量的成果。达雷·奥拉温是《Punch Newspapers》记者，拥有十余年报道经验。他的职业生涯始于社区新闻记者，如今负责报道能源领域，包括石油、天然气、电力和可再生能源。达雷的工作体现了深入一线的编辑部经验、通过研讨会和会议进行的专业提升，以及对准确且富有洞察力的新闻报道的坚定 commitment

https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/foreignaffa.title: N. Korea says dialogue with U.S. an option but not a must for national interest
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/foreignaffa.summary: North Korea said Wednesday that dialogue with the United States remains an option for peace, but that it would not be necessary for its own interest while again stressing the U.S.' accusation of its involvement in a major cryptocurrency theft as a sign of Washington's hostility toward Pyongyang.
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/foreignaffa.summary_zh: 朝鲜周三表示，与美国对话仍是实现和平的一个选项，但出于自身利益，目前并无必要；与此同时再次强调，美方指控其参与一起重大加密货币盗窃案，体现了华盛顿对平壤的敌意。
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/foreignaffa.body: North Korea said Wednesday that dialogue with the United States remains an option for peace, but that it would not be necessary for its own interest while again stressing the U.S.' accusation of its involvement in a major cryptocurrency theft as a sign of Washington's hostility toward Pyongyang. Kim Yo-jong, the powerful sister of North Korean leader Kim Jong-un, made the remarks, saying the continued "hostile signal" by Washington was compelling the regime to reconsider the "true nature" of the U.S. "The choice for peace includes dialogue of course, but this is not surely equated with national interests for us," Kim said in a statement carried by the North's official Korean Central News Agency (KCNA). The remarks came a day after she rejected the U.S. Federal Bureau of Investigation's (FBI) findings that the regime was behind the theft of more than US$6 billion in cryptocurrency from Binance, the world's largest cryptocurrency exchange. She earlier called the accusation a "grave political provocation" against the North. "The so-called 'cryptocurrency hacking case by the DPRK' is no more than a tip of iceberg that shows the essence of the U.S. hostile policy toward the DPRK," Kim reiterated Wednesday, referring to the North's official name, the Democratic People's Republic of Korea. Kim pointed to a recent trilateral meeting between the top diplomats of South Korea, the U.S. and Japan, where they reaffirmed their commitment to the complete denuclearization of North Korea, along with various joint military drills, as other examples of U.S. hostility. "The U.S. abandonment of its hostile policy" toward Pyongyang "is a major premise and key to solving all problems," she said, adding that North Korea has no reason to engage in talks with the U.S. unless that happens. "It is our clear stand that we have no need to sit face to face with such unreliable and hostile persons who refuse to abandon their policy of confrontation," she said. She further warned that Pyongyang would respond to what it views as continued U.S. hostility. "In the present reality when new records are being set in the implementation of the U.S. hostile policy toward the DPRK, it is natural that new records should be created in our reflective counteraction." She did not specify what counteractions Pyongyang would take
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/foreignaffa.title_zh: 朝鲜称与美国对话是选项，但国家利益并非必须对话
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/foreignaffa.body_zh: 朝鲜周三表示，与美国进行对话仍是实现和平的一个选项，但这对朝鲜自身利益而言并无必要；朝鲜再次强调，美国指控其参与一起重大加密货币盗窃案，体现了华盛顿对平壤的敌意。朝鲜领导人金正恩权势强大的妹妹金与正发表上述言论。她说，华盛顿持续发出“敌对信号”，迫使该政权重新审视美国政策的“真正本质”。金与正在朝鲜官方朝鲜中央通讯社（KCNA）播发的声明中说：“实现和平的选择当然包括对话，但这肯定不等同于我们的国家利益。”此前一天，她否认了美国联邦调查局（FBI）认定该政权策划从全球最大加密货币交易平台币安窃取超过60亿美元加密货币的结论。她早些时候称，这项指控是对朝鲜的“严重政治挑衅”。周三，金与正再次表示，所谓“朝鲜加密货币黑客案件”不过是冰山一角，揭示了美国对朝鲜敌对政策的实质。她以朝鲜正式国名朝鲜民主主义人民共和国指代朝鲜。金与正指出，韩国、美国和日本三国外交部长最近举行了三边会议，会上重申推动朝鲜半岛完全无核化的承诺，并举行各种联合军事演习；这些也是美国敌意的其他例证。她说，美国放弃对平壤的“敌对政策”是解决所有问题的重要前提和关键；除非这种情况发生，否则朝鲜没有理由与美国谈判。她说：“我们立场鲜明，无需与那些拒绝放弃对抗政策、既不可靠又充满敌意的人坐下来谈判。”她还警告，平壤将回应其所认定的美国持续敌意。她说：“在落实美国对朝鲜敌对政策不断刷新纪录的当下，我们作出反思性反制并刷新纪录也是理所当然的。”她没有说明平壤将采取何种反制措施

https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/world/20261.title: SK hynix's New York chip plans hit snag over US restrictions on China, sources say
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/world/20261.summary: U.S. officials have held up approval for American chipmaking equipment needed by SK Hynix to expand production in China, complicating the South Korean chipmaker's plans for new memory-chip plants in New York, according to people familiar with the matter. Its Solidigm unit plans to invest about $45 billion and build two NAND plants in Marcy, New York, two people said, with investment potentially reaching about $100 billion over time.
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/world/20261.summary_zh: 据知情人士透露，美国官员暂缓批准SK海力士在中国扩大生产所需的美国芯片制造设备，令这家韩国芯片制造商在纽约新建存储芯片工厂的计划面临变数。两名人士表示，SK海力士旗下Solidigm部门计划投资约$45 billion，在纽约州马西建造两座NAND工厂，投资额未来可能增至约$100 billion。
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/world/20261.body: U.S. officials have held up approval for American chipmaking equipment needed by SK Hynix to expand production in China, complicating the South Korean chipmaker's plans for new memory-chip plants in New York, according to people familiar with the matter. SK Hynix is seeking U.S. export licenses to equip its Dalian plant, arguing that increased production there would help fund its planned U.S. expansion. But the Commerce Department has yet to approve the new licenses, the people said. Its Solidigm unit plans to invest about $45 billion and build two NAND plants in Marcy, New York, two people said, with investment potentially reaching about $100 billion over time. NAND is memory that retains data even when power is turned off and is used for storage in data centers. The negotiations raise questions about how far the Trump administration is willing to bend national security guardrails established to keep U.S. technology from aiding China's military, in order to bring foreign investment and chipmaking onshore. "Ultimately, none of this is going to go forward without a green light from the White House," said Leland Miller, a member of the U.S.-China Economic and Security Review Commission, a bipartisan panel created by the U.S. Congress. The White House did not immediately respond to a request for comment. Negotiations are continuing, the people said, with approval for the Dalian expansion central to SK Hynix's plans in New York. Executives from SK Hynix's U.S. subsidiary, Solidigm, have met nearly 10 times with officials from the Commerce Department since late August, one of the people said. The company needs to ramp up production and develop more sophisticated NAND chipmaking in China to generate revenue to build a U.S. facility and to stay competitive, the people said. In a meeting last week, Commerce Under Secretary Jeffrey Kessler held to his position that the U.S. would not allow more American chipmaking tools to upgrade or expand capacity, the person said, though the department has not formally denied a license to export American equipment to fill empty clean space in Dalian. The two sides are also negotiating a separate license for 2027 for equipment to keep up the Dalian facility, the person said. A spokesperson for the Department of Commerce did not immediately respond to a request for comment. In a statement last week, Solidigm said: "As a U.S.-founded and headquartered company, Solidigm regularly evaluates strategic alternatives to best serve its customers and enhance its long-term competitiveness. The company is currently exploring options for building a NAND memory fab at potential locations around the world. No decision regarding any specific course of action has been made." Solidigm stuck to its statement from last week. SK Hynix did not immediately respond to a request for comment outside business hours
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/world/20261.title_zh: 消息人士称，SK海力士的纽约芯片计划因美国对华限制而受阻
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/world/20261.body_zh: 据知情人士透露，美国官员暂缓批准 SK Hynix 扩大在华生产所需的美国芯片制造设备，使这家韩国芯片制造商在纽约新建存储芯片工厂的计划复杂化。SK Hynix 正寻求美国出口许可，为其大连工厂配备设备，并主张增加当地产量将有助于为其计划中的美国扩张提供资金。不过，知情人士表示，美国商务部尚未批准这些新许可。两名知情人士称，其旗下 Solidigm 部门计划投资约 $45 billion，在纽约州马西建造两座 NAND 工厂，日后投资额可能达到约 $100 billion。NAND 是一种即使断电也能保留数据的存储器，用于数据中心的数据存储。相关谈判引出了一个问题：特朗普政府究竟愿意在多大程度上突破为防止美国技术协助中国军事而设立的国家安全底线，从而吸引外国投资并将芯片制造转移到美国。美国国会设立的两党联合机构美中经济与安全审查委员会成员 Leland Miller 表示：“归根结底，没有白宫点头，这一切都不会推进。”白宫没有立即回应置评请求。知情人士表示，谈判仍在继续，大连扩产能否获批是 SK Hynix 纽约计划的关键。知情人士之一称，自 8 月底以来，SK Hynix 美国子公司 Solidigm 的高管已与商务部官员会面近 10 次。知情人士表示，公司需要提高产量并在中国开发更先进的 NAND 芯片制造技术，以创造收入建设美国设施并维持竞争力。该人士称，在上周的一次会议上，商务部副部长 Jeffrey Kessler 坚持原有立场，即美国不会允许更多美国芯片制造工具用于升级或扩大产能，尽管商务部尚未正式拒绝向大连出口美国设备的许可，以为当地尚未启用的洁净生产空间补充设备。该人士称，双方还在谈判一项单独的 2027 年许可，用于维持大连工厂运营的设备。商务部发言人也未立即回应置评请求。Solidigm 上周在一份声明中表示：“Solidigm 是一家在美国创立并设于美国总部的公司，经常评估各种战略方案，以更好地服务客户并增强其长期竞争力。公司目前正在探索于全球各地潜在地点建设 NAND 存储芯片晶圆厂的方案。公司尚未就任何具体行动方案作出决定。”Solidigm 上周重申了这份声明。非营业时间外，SK Hynix 未立即回应置评请求

https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/world/20261.body: WASHINGTON — South Korea's Hanwha Group has appointed a new president of its Philadelphia shipyard in the United States, as the conglomerate seeks to expand its U.S. naval shipbuilding operations, according to the company. Kim Hyuk has been named president of Hanwha Philly Shipyard, effective Monday, succeeding David Kim, who helped oversee Hanwha's acquisition of the facility in 2024 and a near doubling of its workforce since then, the shipyard said in a press release. The new president brings more than 25 years of experience in commercial and naval shipbuilding, including senior positions at Hanwha Ocean Co. and its predecessor, Daewoo Shipbuilding & Marine Engineering. The appointment comes as Hanwha Defense USA (HDUSA), a subsidiary of South Korean defense giant Hanwha Aerospace Co., takes majority ownership of the Philadelphia shipyard as part of efforts to transform the facility into a dual-use shipyard capable of building both commercial and military vessels. Kim will report directly to Tom Anderson, president of U.S. shipbuilding at HDUSA, who oversees the company's shipbuilding operations in the United States. "By building on the strong foundation established in the months since Hanwha acquired the yard, we will focus on strengthening operational excellence, expanding shipbuilding capacity, and developing the workforce needed to support both commercial and naval programs," Kim said. Recently, HDUSA was selected by U.S. maritime services firm Tote Services to build one medium landing ship at Hanwha Philly Shipyard, with options to construct three additional vessels

https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/business/te.summary: “Korea's current strength in the AI supply chain is largely because high bandwidth memory (HBM) has fortunately become a critical component of AI accelerators,” Kim said. Korea therefore needs to secure an indispensable position in the AI supply chain. Such interdependence, he said, could make Korea more indispensable to the U.S. not only as a technology supplier, but also as a strategic partner in the AI era
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/business/te.summary_zh: 金表示：“韩国目前之所以能在人工智能供应链中占据较强优势，很大程度上是因为高带宽存储器（HBM）恰好已成为人工智能加速器的关键部件。”因此，韩国需要在人工智能供应链中确保不可或缺的地位。他说，这种相互依赖不仅可能让韩国作为技术供应商对美国更加不可或缺，也可能让韩国成为人工智能时代的战略伙伴。
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/business/te.body: They suggested that Korea could secure a unique position in the global AI landscape by leveraging its manufacturing capabilities, industrial know-how and advanced semiconductor supply chain, as well as building AI infrastructure that would deepen its strategic importance to the U.S. and its allies. Lee Do-kyung, founder and CEO of Bone AI, proposed developing Korea into a “forward-deployed industrial base” for the U.S. and its allies, combining American technologies with Korea's manufacturing capabilities to produce, deploy and maintain AI-powered systems in the Indo-Pacific region. “Even if a single motor breaks down, a drone cannot operate, and sourcing new parts from the U.S. mainland can take three to four months by sea,” Lee said. “The U.S. and its allies need partners that can manufacture and repair equipment locally, deploy and operate it in the field and help build the industrial capabilities needed to sustain attritable systems, drones and other robotic systems in operational environments.” An attritable military system is designed to be cheap enough to lose in combat without significantly affecting overall operational capabilities. Drones, a prime example, are playing an increasingly critical role in modern conflicts. Lee said Gen. Xavier Brunson, commander of U.S. Forces Korea, has also expressed the need for partners to help the U.S. military in Korea expand such capabilities. The capability Lee was referring to has a broader meaning than simply manufacturing drones or developing AI models. It involves operational knowledge that only companies working in the field can accumulate, such as understanding why a system fails in real-world conditions and how to repair and operate them effectively. Lim Jong-in, former presidential cybersecurity adviser and Soongsil University AI committee chair, also stressed that Korea should not abandon competition in frontier AI models, but should simultaneously explore how to apply the tacit knowledge accumulated through decades of manufacturing experience to physical AI. Tacit knowledge refers to practical expertise and know-how gained through experience that is difficult to record in traditional documentation. “One example is Korea’s shipbuilding sector,” Lim said. “Welding ships requires skills and know-how that workers acquire through years of experience. Korea is already struggling to find enough skilled workers for these jobs. What we need to do — and what the industry is already working on — is turn the tacit knowledge accumulated by these experienced craftsmen into a structured set of data that can be used to train humanoid robots.” Reform Party of Korea Rep. Lee Jun-seok also agreed, saying that China's dominance in humanoid robots does not mean Korea is shut out of opportunities in physical AI. “What we need to question is whether humanoid robots are optimal for industrial use,” he said. “In Star Wars, we can see both R2-D2 and C-3PO. The question is whether factories would be better served by specialized robots like R2-D2 or humanoid robots like C-3PO. “If we think about what kind of physical AI robots Korea should develop, the answer could be specialized machines such as welding robots. At a robotics exhibition in China, dancing humanoids attracted the most attention, but the booths that drew the most buyers were those showcasing robots specialized in cleaning toilets.” Kim Sung-han, former national security adviser and professor emeritus of international relations at Korea University, said such efforts should be accompanied by a broader strategy to make Korea indispensable across the AI supply chain. “Korea's current strength in the AI supply chain is largely because high bandwidth memory (HBM) has fortunately become a critical component of AI accelerators,” Kim said. “But there are lingering concerns about when this cycle will end. Korea therefore needs to secure an indispensable position in the AI supply chain. To do so, we must build our own ecosystem, including advanced packaging technologies.” Rep. Lee also proposed turning Korea into a global AI infrastructure hub by combining its strengths in semiconductors, energy and telecommunications to host large-scale data centers and undersea cable networks. “A friend of mine in the data center industry once joked that Korea is an ideal location for U.S. data centers because of its roughly 12-hour time difference, which could help operators optimize their operations by distributing computing workloads across different time zones,” Lee said. “I believe it is extremely important to build an infrastructure ecosystem centered on Korea. Even if companies do business with China, they would not want to locate their data centers or management operations in a country where data sovereignty could be at risk.” Rep. Lee argued that hosting critical U.S. AI infrastructure could also strengthen Korea's strategic importance to Washington by creating a “tripwire” effect, in which any threat to Korean data centers or communications networks would directly affect American interests. Such interdependence, he said, could make Korea more indispensable to the U.S. not only as a technology supplier, but also as a strategic partner in the AI era
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/business/te.title_zh: 【圆桌会议】韩国蓝图：成为人工智能领域不可或缺的重要力量
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/business/te.body_zh: 他们认为，韩国可以利用其制造能力、专有工业知识和先进的半导体供应链，并建设人工智能基础设施，从而在全球人工智能格局中确立独特地位；这也将深化韩国对美国及其盟友的战略重要性。Bone AI创始人兼首席执行官Lee Do-kyung提议，将韩国建设成美国及其盟友的“前沿部署工业基地”，把美国技术与韩国的制造能力结合起来，在印太地区生产、部署和维护人工智能驱动的系统。Lee说：“即便只有一台电机出了故障，无人机也无法运作，而从美国本土海运新零件需要三到四个月。美国及其盟友需要能够在当地制造和维修设备、在现场部署和运行设备，并帮助建设维持可消耗武器系统、无人机和其他机器人系统在作战环境中持续运作所需工业能力的伙伴。”可消耗军事系统的设计成本足够低，即使在战斗中损失，也不会对整体作战能力造成显著影响。无人机就是其中的典型例子，正在现代冲突中发挥日益关键的作用。Lee说，驻韩美军司令Xavier Brunson将军也提出，需要合作伙伴帮助美国在韩国的军队扩大此类能力。Lee所指的能力，其含义比单纯制造无人机或开发人工智能模型更为广泛。它涉及只有在现场工作的公司才能积累的实战知识，例如了解系统为何会在现实条件下发生故障，以及如何有效维修和操作这些系统。前总统网络安全顾问、延世大学人工智能委员会主席Lim Jong-in也强调，韩国不应放弃在前沿人工智能模型领域的竞争，同时应探索如何把数十年制造经验积累的隐性知识应用于实体人工智能。隐性知识是指通过经验获得、难以记录在传统文件中的实践技能和专门知识。Lim说：“一个例子就是韩国的造船业。焊接船舶需要工人通过多年经验掌握的技能和诀窍。韩国目前已经难以找到足够多的技术工人从事这些工作。我们需要做的，也是该行业正在推进的，就是把这些经验丰富的工匠所积累的隐性知识转化为结构化的数据集，用于训练人形机器人。”韩国改革党议员Lee Jun-seok也表示认同，称中国在人形机器人领域占据主导地位，并不意味着韩国在实体人工智能领域被排除在机会之外。他说：“我们需要质疑的是，人形机器人是否最适合工业用途。在《星球大战》中，我们既能看到R2-D2，也能看到C-3PO。问题在于，与R2-D2这类专用机器人相比，还是与C-3PO这类人形机器人相比，工厂能够获得更好的服务。如果我们思考韩国应开发何种实体人工智能机器人，答案可能是焊接机器人之类的专用机器。在中国的一次机器人展览上，会跳舞的人形机器人吸引了最多关注，但吸引最多买家的是那些展示清洁厕所专用机器人的展台。”前国家安全顾问、高等大学国际关系名誉教授Kim Sung-han表示，此类努力还应配合一项更广泛的战略，使韩国在整个人工智能供应链中变得不可或缺。Kim说：“韩国目前之所以在人工智能供应链中拥有较强实力，主要是因为高带宽内存（HBM）幸运地成为人工智能加速器的关键部件。但这一周期何时结束，仍令人担忧。因此，韩国需要在人工智能供应链中确立不可或缺的地位。要做到这一点，我们必须建立自己的生态系统，其中包括先进封装技术。”Lee议员还提议，把韩国的半导体、能源和电信优势结合起来，承载大规模数据中心和海底电缆网络，将韩国打造为全球人工智能基础设施中心。Lee说：“我有一位从事数据中心行业的朋友曾开玩笑说，由于韩国与美国大约存在12小时的时差，韩国是美国数据中心的理想地点，这有助于运营方通过在不同时间区之间分配计算工作负荷来优化运营。我相信，打造一个以韩国为中心的基础设施生态极为重要。即便企业与中国开展业务，也不会愿意把数据中心或管理运营机构设在数据主权可能面临风险的国家。”Lee议员认为，承载关键美国人工智能基础设施，还能通过形成“绊线效应”加强韩国对华盛顿的战略重要性，即任何针对韩国数据中心或通信网络的威胁，都会直接影响美国利益。他说，这种相互依赖不仅能让韩国作为技术供应商对美国更加不可或缺，也能使其成为人工智能时代的战略伙伴

https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/business/co.title: Why more K-food brands need 'OU' for global markets
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/business/co.summary: Orthodox Union's Seoul operation promotes kosher label Companies seeking to expand into global markets like North America and Europe should consider applying for OU certification, a kosher label approved by the Orthodox Union, according to an associate of the oldest Orthodox Jewish organization in the United States.
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/business/co.summary_zh: 正统犹太联盟驻首尔机构推广犹太洁食标签。美国历史最悠久的正统犹太组织的一名助理表示，希望拓展北美和欧洲等全球市场的企业，应考虑申请正统犹太联盟认证；这是正统犹太联盟批准的一种犹太洁食标签。
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/business/co.body: Orthodox Union's Seoul operation promotes kosher label Companies seeking to expand into global markets like North America and Europe should consider applying for OU certification, a kosher label approved by the Orthodox Union, according to an associate of the oldest Orthodox Jewish organization in the United States. Steve Hong, certification sales agent for the New York City-based group operating OU Kosher worldwide, said that to get mainstream distribution in the U.S., Canada and Europe, Korean food firms should seek to certify their products with OU, the most widespread kosher certification label in those regions. He said over 1.3 million kosher products manufactured at 15,000 plants in 105 countries have been certified with OU. That is over 70 percent of all kosher products being distributed worldwide. Hong said the majority of kosher food products at Costco and Walmart stores in the U.S. are OU-labeled. According to OU Kosher, 71 percent of kosher products at 190 Ralph’s Supermarkets stores in California and 66 percent of kosher products at Stop & Shop stores in the northeastern U.S. have been certified by OU Kosher, while the remainders are labeled with other kosher certifications like OK, Kof-K or Star-K. OU’s presence goes beyond consumers who need to adhere to traditional Jewish dietary laws. According to a WAC Survey and Strategic Consulting’s report from 2016, nearly 80 percent of all kosher food sales worldwide were to non-kosher shoppers. “Kosher products draw over 12 million shoppers in the U.S. each year and their sales are over $150 billion per year. Major distributors in the U.S. are recognizing OU as the de facto quality standard. That’s why OU-labelled products are directly connected to the American customers with strong consumption,” Hong said in his interview with The Korea Times. The problem is that the majority of small- and medium-size firms (SMEs) in Korea, which constitute the bulk of the Korean food industry, do not know about OU, according to Hong. While large firms like Daesang, Nongshim, CJ, Pulmuone, Samyang Foods, Dongsuh Foods and Dongwon Systems have already had their manufacturing plants pass certification standards for the label, SMEs without enough production capacity for global markets have not yet prepared for it. As of this year, 87 companies in Korea passed standards for OU Kosher. That accounts for just 0.27 percent of the Korean food manufacturing industry. “Many Korean firms misunderstand OU or other kosher labels as a Jewish requirement and don’t realize the labels’ market power. They also don’t know how critical the labels are to the local distributors like Costco or Walmart. Korean SMEs, unlike the large firms, mostly operate domestically. Lastly, OU Kosher hasn’t invested enough in reaching out to Korean firms,” Hong said. Hong compared kosher labels to those for halal foods, breaking down the global markets for both certifications. He concluded products with halal labels have access to a worldwide market estimated between $1.6 trillion to $2.5 trillion, which overshadows kosher’s $22 billion market, but have higher hurdles to reach local consumer bases than kosher. “We must understand that even K-food products with halal labels can only reach a portion of local consumers. They are the top-percentile consumer groups who can afford premium imports. Furthermore, not many Muslim nations have advanced retail chain systems like major cities in the U.S.,” Hong said. “Many Korean firms began learning about halal certifications in 2016, but started with wrong information. They found their halal products exported to major economies around the world didn’t rack up as much as they anticipated in sales. They in turn learned about kosher certifications from local consultants and started gearing toward the kosher labels instead in 2020.” OU Kosher, established by the Orthodox Union in 1923, dispatches a rabbinical field inspector to facilities of companies interested in OU certification. What each inspection focuses on is assessing sources of ingredients used, checking whether meat and dairy are properly separated and how long each pipeline has been in operation. The six-step assessment procedure, whether the facilities’ export target countries are in North America or Europe, is the same. This is different from halal labels, which are issued by different authorities across more than 50 countries and have varying standards. The field inspector sends reports to the Orthodox Union’s headquarters which later issues a self-printable OU label online. “The field inspector for Korea also covers India and Southeast Asian nations. Companies here, meanwhile, get subsidized by the government and pay just 30 percent of the administration fee for the certification,” Hong said
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/business/co.title_zh: 为何更多韩国食品品牌需要获得“OU”认证才能进入全球市场
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/business/co.body_zh:
正统犹太工会驻首尔机构推广犹太洁食认证标签

美国历史最悠久的正统犹太组织的一名顾问表示，希望拓展北美和欧洲等全球市场的企业，应考虑申请正统犹太工会认证。这是正统犹太工会批准的犹太洁食标签。

负责在 全球开展 OU Kosher 业务的纽约市组织，其认证销售代理人 Steve Hong 表示，企业若要在美国、加拿大和欧洲获得主流渠道销售，食品企业应寻求用 OU 对产品进行认证。OU 是上述地区应用最广泛的犹太洁食认证标签。

他说，全球105个国家的1.5万家工厂生产的逾130万件犹太洁食产品已获得 OU 认证，占全球流通的全部犹太洁食产品的70%以上。

Hong 表示，美国 Costco 和 Walmart 门店销售的大多数犹太洁食食品均带有 OU 标签。

据 OU Kosher 介绍，加利福尼亚州190家 Ralph’s Supermarkets 门店中71%的犹太洁食产品、美国东北部 Stop & Shop 门店中66%的犹太洁食产品均获得 OU Kosher 认证，其余产品则标有 OK、Kof-K 或 Star-K 等其他犹太洁食认证。

OU 的影响力并不限于需要遵守传统犹太饮食法规的消费者。根据 WAC Survey and Strategic Consulting 2016年的报告，全球近80%的犹太洁食食品销售额来自并非购买犹太洁食食品的消费者。

Hong 在接受《韩国时报》采访时表示：“犹太洁食产品每年在美国吸引逾1200万名消费者，销售额超过1500亿美元。美国的大型经销商正将 OU 视为事实上的质量标准。因此，带有 OU 标签的产品能够直接触达消费能力强劲的美国消费者。”

Hong 表示，问题在于，构成韩国食品工业主体的多数中小型企业在韩国并不了解 OU。Daesang、Nongshim、CJ、Pulmuone、Samyang Foods、Dongsuh Foods 和 Dongwon Systems 等大型企业的生产基地已经通过该标签的认证标准，但缺乏足够全球市场生产能力的中小企业尚未为此做好准备。

截至今年，韩国共有87家公司通过 OU Kosher 标准，仅占韩国食品制造业的0.27%。

Hong 表示：“许多韩国企业误以为 OU 或其他犹太洁食标签是犹太人的必备要求，没有认识到这些标签的市场潜力。他们也不了解这些标签对 Costco 或 Walmart 等当地经销商有多关键。与大企业不同，韩国中小企业大多只在国内经营。最后，OU Kosher 在接触和拓展韩国企业方面投入不足。”

Hong 将犹太洁食标签与清真食品标签进行比较，分解了两种认证各自对应的全球市场。他总结称，带有清真标签的产品可进入规模估计在1.6万亿至2.5万亿美元之间的全球市场，这一规模远超规模为220亿美元的犹太洁食市场，但清真产品触达当地消费者群体的门槛也高于犹太洁食产品。

他说：“我们必须认识到，即使是带有清真标签的 K-food 产品，也只能触达一部分当地消费者。他们属于负担得起高端进口产品的顶尖消费群体。此外，并非有许多穆斯林国家拥有美国主要城市那样成熟的零售连锁体系。”

他说：“许多韩国企业从2016年开始了解清真认证，但最初掌握的信息并不准确。他们发现出口到全球主要经济体的清真产品，销售额未达到预期，于是转而通过当地咨询机构了解犹太洁食认证，并从2020年开始转向申请犹太洁食标签。”

OU Kosher 由正统犹太工会于1923年设立。负责 OU 认证的现场检查员会派往有意申请认证的企业设施，逐一检查每家工厂，重点评估原料来源、肉类与乳制品是否妥善隔离，以及各条生产线运行了多长时间。无论这些设施的出口目标国是北美还是欧洲，六步评估程序都完全相同。这与清真标签不同，后者的标准不一，且由50多个国家的不同机构签发。

现场检查员会向正统犹太工会总部提交报告，随后由总部在线签发可自行打印的 OU 标签。

Hong 表示：“负责韩国的现场检查员同时负责印度和东南亚国家。与此同时，这里企业可以得到政府补贴，只需承担认证管理费的30%。”

https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/business/co.title: Every space has a story: Urbanplay connects people with local culture
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/business/co.summary: For Urbanplay CEO Hong Joo-seok, every space has a story of its own. Founded in 2013, Urbanplay connects brands and local creators with audiences through physical spaces. Beyond helping local businesses attract visitors, Urbanplay also seeks to introduce international audiences to Korea's regional culture and identity.
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/business/co.summary_zh: Urbanplay首席执行官洪柱锡认为，每一处空间都有自己的故事。Urbanplay成立于2013年，通过实体空间连接品牌、本地创作者与受众。除了帮助本地企业吸引顾客外，Urbanplay还希望让国际受众了解韩国的地域文化与身份认同。
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/business/co.body: This is the third in a series of interviews with the heads of promising startups that are pioneers of their respective fields and seek to go public in the near future. In Korea, cafes are no longer just places to grab a cup of coffee. They are increasingly becoming cultural venues where visitors can discover local brands, browse curated products and exhibitions and sample menus developed in collaboration with local businesses. The shift extends beyond cafes, with retail spaces doubling as venues for exhibitions, performances and pop-up events. For Urbanplay CEO Hong Joo-seok, every space has a story of its own. He believes the value of a physical space lies not simply in its design, but in the experiences it offers and the stories it tells visitors. "It is important to carefully plan what kind of content visitors will experience and what services can keep them connected to a brand even after the experience ends," Hong said in a recent interview with The Korea Times. "We are not a company that simply designs the physical structure of a space. We plan the content inside it and design the user experience," he added. Founded in 2013, Urbanplay connects brands and local creators with audiences through physical spaces. Rather than designing buildings or interiors itself, the company develops the concepts and content for each space and oversees its business planning and operations. It also works with architectural firms and construction companies on detailed designs and construction. Hong likened Urbanplay's role to that of an operating system for a city. He said the company has developed its own Urbanplay OS, drawing on 13 years of accumulated data. "Through this system, we can anticipate changes in the offline environment, recommend content suited to our partners and simulate how spaces can be planned and operated," he said. The company's projects range from neighborhood cultural venues to corporate spaces and large-scale exhibitions. For example, Yeonnam Bangagan, a cafe and curated lifestyle store with locations near Seoul Station and at Dongdaemun Design Plaza, showcases local brands, artists and seasonal products. Yeonnamjang, located in Seoul's Yeonhui-dong neighborhood, focuses on performances, lectures and other cultural events. Its FYI lounge in Yeoksam-dong, Gangnam District, combines a cafe with a curated selection of books and stationery aimed at people working in the startup industry. Hong's idea is to give people a reason to visit a place beyond the products it sells. The company applied this approach to the 2026 Seoul Design Week, held from Oct. 14 to 25, by connecting 150 design destinations across five areas through the Seoul Design Road: Dongdaemun, Seongsu, Yeonhui, Seochon and Apgujeong. Rather than simply listing design-related venues across the city, the routes connected places where visitors can encounter products, crafts, studios and exhibitions within distinct neighborhoods, the CEO said. The company has also sought to connect individual creators and businesses with broader neighborhood experiences. Through local projects in Seoul and other cities, including Busan and Gwangju, it brings together shops, artists and cultural programs to give visitors more reasons to explore an area. Urbanplay also works to nurture small businesses, which Hong refers to as "local creators" rather than simply small-business owners. The company helps them develop their own brands and content, sometimes through incubation programs run in partnership with public institutions such as the Seoul Metropolitan Government and the Ministry of SMEs and Startups. "We began using the term 'local creators' around 2015," Hong said. "It refers to entrepreneurs who build their own brands and content and can grow their businesses around their own intellectual property." "Small businesses generally operate on a self-employment model, so scaling up is structurally difficult. But we believe that businesses with strong intellectual property, creativity and compelling stories have the potential to grow into bigger brands." Hong cited Sungsimdang, the Daejeon bakery that has become a tourist attraction in its own right, as an example of a local brand’s power to draw visitors. Beyond helping local businesses attract visitors, Urbanplay also seeks to introduce international audiences to Korea's regional culture and identity. Hong cited Seochon, near Gyeongbokgung Palace, as an example of a neighborhood that offers a glimpse into different layers of Korean culture, where traditional architecture and cultural heritage coexist with contemporary brands. Urbanplay put this vision into practice last October with "Edition Seochon," a five-day local art fair that brought together young artists, shops and brands across the neighborhood. The event turned streets and neighborhood venues into spaces for exhibitions, pop-ups and cultural programs, with the aim of developing Seochon into a globally recognized cultural district. Looking beyond Korea, Hong sees opportunities to bring Korean local brands and creators to overseas markets. He said Urbanplay could serve as a bridge, connecting them with potential partners abroad. "We receive a lot of proposals, particularly from Southeast Asia, where there is growing demand for urban development projects that incorporate Korean culture," Hong said. "Since we have a pool of business owners in food and beverage, lifestyle, design and culture, we will be able to bring various brands together and create exhibition spaces." Urbanplay is also exploring opportunities in Europe, where interest in Korean culture is extending beyond entertainment and popular culture. Hong said the company had held several meetings with potential partners in the region, where Korean wellness, food, crafts and visual arts have attracted attention. "Even in countries such as Switzerland, there is considerable interest in Korean wellness culture. Along with interest in the Buddhist culture, they are interested in Korean food made with healthy ingredients, particularly temple cuisine," Hong said

”系列访谈的第三篇，采访对象是各自领域的先驱，并计划在未来寻求上市。在韩国，咖啡馆已不再只是喝一杯咖啡的场所。它们正日益成为文化空间，让访客可以发现本地品牌、浏览精心策划的商品和展览，并品尝与本地商家合作开发的菜单。这一转变不只发生在咖啡馆，零售空间也越来越多地兼作展览、演出和快闪活动的场所。对Urbanplay首席执行官Hong Joo-seok而言，每一处空间都有自己的故事。他认为，实体空间的价值不仅在于设计，更在于它提供的体验以及向访客讲述的故事。Hong近日接受《The Korea Times》采访时说：“仔细规划访客将体验哪些内容，以及哪些服务能在体验结束后继续让他们与品牌保持联系，这很重要。我们并非一家只负责设计空间实体结构的公司。我们策划空间内部的内容，并设计用户体验。”Urbanplay成立于2013年，通过实体空间连接品牌、本地创作者与受众。公司不亲自设计建筑或室内空间，而是为每个空间开发概念和内容，并监督其商业规划和运营。公司还与建筑事务所和施工企业合作，完成详细设计和施工。Hong将Urbanplay的角色比作城市操作系统。他说，公司利用13年积累的数据开发了自己的Urbanplay OS。“通过这一系统，我们可以预判线下环境的变化，为合作伙伴推荐适合的内容，并模拟空间如何进行规划和运营。”公司的项目涵盖社区文化空间、企业空间和大型展览。例如，Yeonnam Bangagan既是一家咖啡馆，也是一家策划型生活方式商店，在首尔站附近以及东大门设计广场设有门店，展示本地品牌、艺术家和季节性商品。位于首尔延辉洞社区的Yeonnamjang主要举办演出、讲座及其他文化活动。其位于江南区驿三洞的FYI休息室将咖啡馆与精心策划的书籍和文具相结合，面向在初创企业行业工作的人士。Hong的想法是，除了场所销售的商品之外，还要给人们到访的理由。公司将这一理念应用于2026年首尔设计周。该活动于10月14日至25日举行，通过“首尔设计之路”连接五大区域的150个设计目的地：东大门、城圣、延辉、 서村和狎鸥亭。Hong表示，这些路线并非简单罗列全城与设计有关的场所，而是将访客能够体验产品、手工艺、工作室和展览的地点连接起来，而且每个地点都位于不同社区之中。公司还致力于把个人创作者和商家与更广泛的社区体验联系起来。通过在首尔以及釜山、光州等其他城市开展本地项目，Urbanplay把商店、艺术家和文化活动汇聚在一起，为访客提供更多探索某一区域的理由。Urbanplay还努力扶持小微企业，Hong称这些人为“本地创作者”，而不仅仅是小企业主。公司帮助他们打造自己的品牌和内容，有时还通过与首尔市政府、中小企业与初创企业部等公共机构合作开展的孵化项目来提供支持。Hong说：“我们大约从2015年开始使用‘本地创作者’这一称谓。它指的是打造自己品牌和内容，并能够围绕自有知识产权发展业务的创业者。”“小企业通常采用自雇模式运营，因此在结构上很难扩大规模。但我们认为，拥有强大知识产权、创意和动人故事的企业，有潜力成长为更大的品牌。”Hong以大田面包店Sungsimdang为例，指出它本身已成为旅游景点，说明本地品牌吸引访客的力量。除了帮助本地商家吸引访客外，Urbanplay还希望把国际受众介绍到韩国的地域文化和身份之中。Hong以景福宫附近的西村为例，称这个社区能够让人们窥见韩国文化的不同层面，传统建筑和文化遗产在这里与当代品牌共存。去年10月，Urbanplay通过举办为期五天的本地艺术展“Edition Seochon”落实这一愿景，把年轻艺术家、商店和品牌聚集在整个社区。展览把街道和社区场所变成展览、快闪活动和文化项目的空间，旨在把西村打造为享誉全球的文化街区。放眼韩国以外，Hong认为公司有机会把韩国本地品牌和创作者带入海外市场。他说，Urbanplay可以发挥桥梁作用，把他们与海外潜在合作伙伴连接起来。Hong说：“我们收到了很多提案，尤其是来自东南亚的提案，那里对融入韩国文化的城市开发项目需求正在增长。”“由于我们拥有一批涉及餐饮、生活方式、设计和文化领域的商家，因此能够把各类品牌汇聚起来，打造展览空间。”Urbanplay还在探索欧洲市场的机会。在那里，人们对韩国文化的兴趣正从娱乐和流行文化延伸至其他领域。Hong说，公司已与该地区的若干潜在合作伙伴举行了几次会面，韩国 wellness、美食、手工艺和视觉艺术都引起了人们的关注。“即使在瑞士这样的国家，人们对韩国 wellness 文化也有相当大的兴趣。除了对佛教文化的兴趣，他们也对使用健康食材制作的韩国美食感兴趣，尤其是寺庙料理。”Hong说

https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/economy/202.summary_zh: 传奇酒饮品牌 Captain Q 在沉寂11年后卷土重来，引发全国热潮。许多消费者还指出，新版酒饮似乎不再有过去那种令人难堪的宿醉感。最新一轮 Captain Q 热潮尤其引人注目，因为它主要由MZ世代（千禧一代和Z世代）成员推动，其中许多人此前从未尝过这款酒。
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/economy/202.body: Captain Q, the legendary liquor brand, has made a comeback after 11 years, sparking a nationwide craze. For middle-aged and older consumers who enjoyed it in the past, the relaunch evokes nostalgia. For younger generations who never got to try it, the brand has become an object of curiosity, fueled by notorious hangover tales that have evolved into entertaining internet memes. The product is now so hard to find that it is reportedly changing hands on the secondhand market for several times its retail price. Captain Q was first launched in 1980 by Lotte Chilsung Beverage, then known as Lotte Liquor, and is considered one of the original mass-market Korean liquors. Such products were developed at a time when liquor imports were restricted. They were essentially imitation spirits made by blending neutral alcohol (ethanol) with coloring, flavoring and small amounts of liquor concentrates to mimic the taste and aroma of imported spirits. Captain Q was one such product, containing a small amount of rum concentrate. Its affordable price made it particularly popular among college students and ordinary consumers. However, as the liquor market shifted toward premium products, production was discontinued in 2015. The brand returned to store shelves last month. The relaunched version retains the original bottle design to preserve its retro appeal, but features a significantly upgraded recipe. It is now made with 99 percent Caribbean rum and undergoes oak barrel aging to enhance its flavor and aroma. Many consumers have also noted that the notorious hangovers once associated with the drink appear to be absent from the new version. Although about two weeks have passed since its launch, the buzz shows no signs of fading. Social media platforms continue to see a steady stream of purchase reviews and information on where to find the product. Captain Q has also consistently ranked among the most searched items on convenience store apps' inventory-checking services. The craze has even extended to a limited-edition promotional package released ahead of the official launch. Some of its accessories, including drinking glasses and commemorative coins, have recently appeared separately on secondhand marketplaces for 350,000 won. That is more than 17 times the original retail price of 19,800 won ($15) for the entire package, including the liquor. What makes the latest Captain Q craze particularly noteworthy is that it is being driven largely by members of the MZ (Millennials and Gen Z) generation, many of whom have never tried the drink. Despite declining alcohol consumption among younger people and a slowdown in liquor sales, the combination of the "newtro" (new and retro) trend and the brand's unusual hangover folklore appears to have piqued their curiosity. "I think it is popular because it is reasonably priced and appeals to young people's curiosity," he said. The manufacturer has also welcomed the unexpected enthusiasm. A Lotte Chilsung Beverage official said consumer responses had been far more positive than initially anticipated. "We find it meaningful that interest in a brand with such a long history has translated into positive responses to the actual product and purchases," the official said. The success of Captain Q is also prompting renewed interest in other mass-market liquors that once enjoyed widespread popularity. Notable examples include Napoleon, launched in 1976 and discontinued in 2017, and Very Nine Gold, launched in 1976 and discontinued in 1991. Although no manufacturers have officially announced plans to bring these brands back, expectations are growing over whether the retro craze sparked by Captain Q could revive other long-forgotten favorites. https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/economy/202.body_zh: 传奇酒饮品牌Captain Q时隔11年强势回归，引发全国热潮。对于过去品尝过这一品牌的中老年消费者而言，它的重启令人追忆往昔；对于从未尝试过的年轻一代来说，该品牌已成为猎奇对象，而声名狼藉的宿醉故事也演变成了颇具娱乐性的网络迷因。如今这款产品十分难得，据报道在二手市场上的转手价格达到零售价的数倍。Captain Q于1980年由当时名为乐天酒业的Lotte Chilsung Beverage首次推出，被视为韩国最早的大众化酒饮产品之一。这类产品诞生于酒类进口受到限制的年代，主要是将中性酒精（乙醇）与色素、香料及少量酒类浓缩液混合，仿制进口烈酒的口感和香气。Captain Q正是其中之一，含有少量朗姆酒浓缩液。亲民的价格使它在大学生和普通消费者中格外畅销。然而，随着酒类市场转向高端产品，该品牌于2015年停产。上个月，Captain Q重新摆上商店货架。重启版保留了原有瓶身设计，以延续复古吸引力，但配方经过了大幅升级。新版采用99%的加勒比朗姆酒酿造，并经橡木桶陈酿，以提升风味和香气。许多消费者还表示，新版似乎已不存在这款饮品过去那令人闻之色变的严重宿醉。尽管上市仅约两周，其热度丝毫没有减弱。社交媒体平台上关于购买体验和寻找购买地点的信息仍源源不断涌现。Captain Q也持续位居便利店应用库存查询服务中搜索量最高的商品之列。这股热潮甚至延伸到了正式上市前推出的限量促销套装。其部分配件，包括 drinking glasses 和纪念币，近期也分别出现在二手交易平台上，售价达350,000韩元。这一价格是整套产品19,800韩元（$15）原零售价的17倍以上，而该套装本身还包含酒饮。最新这场Captain Q热潮尤其引人注目之处在于，推动热潮的主要是MZ（千禧一代和Z世代）群体，其中许多人此前从未品尝过这款饮品。尽管年轻人的酒精消费持续下降，酒类销售增长放缓，但“新复古”（既新又复古）潮流与该品牌不同寻常的宿醉传说相结合，显然激起了他们的好奇心。“我认为，它受欢迎是因为定价合理，而且迎合了年轻人的好奇心。”他说。制造商也对这份意外的热情表示欢迎。Lotte Chilsung Beverage的一名官员表示，消费者反馈远好于最初预期。“一个拥有如此悠久历史的品牌，其关注度转化为消费者对实物的积极评价和购买行为，这让我们深感意义重大。”该官员说。Captain Q的成功也重新唤起了人们对其他曾经广受欢迎的大众酒饮品牌的兴趣。典型例子包括1976年推出、2017年停产的Napoleon，以及1976年推出、1991年停产的Very Nine Gold。尽管尚无制造商正式宣布重启这些品牌的计划，但市场对Captain Q掀起的复古热潮能否让其他被遗忘已久的明星产品重获新生，正抱有越来越高的期待。本文来自《韩国时报》的姊妹报《韩国先驱报》，由生成式人工智能系统翻译并经《韩国时报》编辑

https://www.vanguardngr.com/2026/11/ekit.summary_zh: ADO-EKITI——埃基蒂传统酋长头衔持有者协会承诺，在2027年总统选举中动员100万张选票，支持总统 Bola Tinubu 争取连任。“值此之际，埃基蒂传统酋长头衔持有者协会宣布，我们将通过各自社区动员100万张选票，在2027年总统选举中支持总统 Bola Ahmed Tinubu，同时支持你们的政治动员工作。
https://www.vanguardngr.com/2026/11/ekit.body: ADO-EKITI – The Association of Ekiti Traditional Chieftaincy Title Holders has pledged to mobilise one million votes for President Bola Tinubu’s re-election bid in the 2027 presidential election. The association made the pledge at a gathering hosted by the Managing Director of the Federal Housing Authority (FHA), Hon. Oyetunde Ojo, where traditional title holders from across Ekiti State expressed support for Tinubu’s administration and called for sustained implementation of its policies. The Chairman of the association, Chief Oluwole Ogunsakin, said the one-million-vote target represented its commitment to mobilising communities across the state ahead of the election. He said the association’s network extended to towns, villages, families and grassroots organisations, adding that members would encourage eligible voters to participate peacefully and freely in the electoral process. Ogunsakin also identified insecurity as one of the major concerns confronting residents, saying traditional rulers and chiefs were strategically positioned to contribute to grassroots security because of their closeness to the people. He welcomed ongoing legislative discussions on the establishment of state police, expressing optimism that the proposal would eventually become law. The association urged the government to consider involving traditional chiefs in screening and recommending credible candidates from their communities for recruitment into the proposed state police structure. Ogunsakin said such involvement would strengthen public confidence in the security system, given traditional leaders’ knowledge of their communities and local security challenges, including activities around farmlands. He said: “As custodians of our heritage and respected community leaders, we recognise the importance of peaceful democratic participation and constructive political engagement. “On this occasion, the Association of Ekiti Traditional Chieftaincy Title Holders declares its commitment and aspiration to mobilise one million votes through our communities in support of President Bola Ahmed Tinubu in the 2027 presidential election, while supporting your political mobilisation efforts. Speaking at the event, Ojo described the Tinubu administration’s infrastructure projects, particularly road construction, as unprecedented, comparing their scale to infrastructure development during the administration of former Head of State, General Yakubu Gowon. He said the roads being constructed under Tinubu’s administration were designed to last between 30 and 40 years. Ojo also commended the President’s appointments, saying they reflected fairness and representation across the country’s ethnic groups. On security, he said the situation was gradually improving, citing the ongoing construction of a military barracks in Ikere-Ekiti as an intervention expected to strengthen security operations and create employment opportunities. He said the project would stimulate economic activities and help address security challenges by providing more opportunities for productive engagement. Ojo challenged critics of the President’s policies and programmes to explain what they would do differently if given the opportunity to govern. Former Ekiti State Governor, Engr. Segun Oni, also called for collective support for Tinubu, saying the President’s second-term ambition required the commitment of political stakeholders. Oni urged Nigerians seeking a prosperous future for the country to support the President while advocating political understanding and national unity across ethnic and regional lines. A former member of the House of Representatives, Bimbo Daramola, expressed optimism about Tinubu’s electoral prospects in Ekiti State, saying the mobilisation target was to secure 90 per cent of the votes for the President. He described traditional title holders as an important grassroots constituency in the mobilisation effort. A highlight of the event was the conferment of the title of patron on Oyetunde Ojo in recognition of his contributions to community development, relationship with traditional institutions and philanthropic activities. https://www.vanguardngr.com/2026/11/ekit.title_zh: 埃基蒂州酋长承诺在2027年为蒂努布贡献100万张选票
https://www.vanguardngr.com/2026/11/ekit.body_zh: ADO-EKITI——埃基蒂传统酋长头衔持有者协会承诺，在2027年总统选举中动员100万张选票，支持总统博拉·蒂努布竞选连任。该协会在联邦住房管理局（FHA）董事长Hon. Oyetunde Ojo主持的集会上作出这一承诺。来自埃基蒂州各地的酋长头衔持有者在集会上表达了对蒂努布政府的支持，并呼吁持续落实其政策。协会主席Chief Oluwole Ogunsakin表示，100万张选票的目标体现了协会在选举前动员全州社区的决心。他说，协会的网络覆盖城镇、村庄、家庭和基层组织，成员将鼓励符合条件的选民和平、自主地参与选举进程。Ogunsakin还指出，安全问题仍是居民面临的主要关切之一。他说，由于传统统治者和酋长贴近民众，能够为基层安全作出贡献。他对正在进行的关于设立州警察的立法讨论表示欢迎，并乐观地认为该提案最终将成为法律。该协会敦促政府考虑让传统酋长参与筛选和推荐所在社区中品行可靠的人员，以充实拟议中的州警察队伍。Ogunsakin说，传统领导人了解各自社区和当地安全挑战，包括农田周边的活动，因此让它们参与其中有助于增强公众对安全体系的信心。他说：“作为我们文化遗产的守护者和备受尊敬的社区领袖，我们认识到和平参与民主和建设性政治参与的重要性。“值此之际，埃基蒂传统酋长头衔持有者协会声明，我们将通过社区动员100万张选票，在2027年总统选举中支持博拉·艾哈迈德·蒂努布总统，同时支持你们的政治动员工作。Ojo在活动上发言时称，蒂努布政府开展的基础设施项目，尤其是道路建设，规模空前，他将其与前国家元首雅库布·戈翁将军执政时期的基础设施发展相比。他说，蒂努布政府正在建设的道路设计寿命为30年至40年。Ojo还赞扬了总统的人事任命，称这些任命体现了公平以及全国各族群的代表性。在安全问题上，他表示局势正在逐步改善，并提到Ikere-Ekiti正在建设一座军营，称这项干预措施有望加强安全行动并创造就业机会。他说，该项目将促进经济活动，并通过提供更多从事生产性活动的机会，帮助应对安全挑战。Ojo要求批评总统各项政策和方案的人说明，如果他们获得执政机会，将会采取哪些不同的做法。埃基蒂州前州长、工程师Segun Oni也呼吁各方共同支持蒂努布，称总统争取第二任期的目标需要政治利益相关者作出承诺。Oni敦促寻求国家繁荣未来的尼日利亚人支持总统，同时推动各民族和地区之间的政治理解与国家团结。众议院前成员Bimbo Daramola对蒂努布在埃基蒂州的选举前景表示乐观，称此次动员目标是确保总统获得90%的选票。他将传统酋长头衔持有者描述为动员工作中的重要基层群体。活动的一项亮点是授予Oyetunde Ojo“赞助人”称号，以表彰其对社区发展的贡献、与传统机构的关系以及慈善活动。此处发表的意见并不代表Vanguard报纸或其任何员工的观点

https://www.yna.co.kr/view/akr2026110402.summary_zh: （首尔＝韩联社）记者 강수지＝大信证券于4日预计，尽管LG新能源解决方案[373220]的储能系统（ESS）业务短期表现不佳，但其业绩改善将在明年全面展开。大信证券研究员金贵妍评价说：“ESS事业部持续亏损、订单业绩不佳令人遗憾，但改善趋势切实有效。”ESS事业部亏损是以美国先进制造生产税收抵扣（AMPC）之外的营业利润为基准计算的。
https://www.yna.co.kr/view/akr2026110402.body: (서울=연합뉴스) 강수지 기자 = 대신증권은 4일 LG에너지솔루션[373220]이 에너지저장장치(ESS) 사업의 단기 부진에도 내년에는 실적 개선이 본격화할 것으로 예상했다. 대신증권의 김귀연 연구원은 "ESS 사업부 적자 지속과 수주 성과가 부진한 점은 아쉬우나 개선세는 유효하다"고 평가했다. ESS 사업부 적자는 미국 첨단제조생산세액공제(AMPC)를 제외한 영업이익 기준이다. 다만, 대신증권은 LG에너지솔루션의 내년 북미 배터리 출하량과 소형전지 수익성 전망을 낮춘 점을 들어 목표주가를 하향 조정했다. 목표주가는 기존 53만원에서 50만원으로 낮아졌으며, 이는 전일 종가 33만8천원 대비 약 48%의 상승 여력을 의미한다. 김 연구원은 예상보다 ESS 수주와 흑자 전환이 늦어지는 점은 아쉽지만, 북미 ESS 프로젝트 수요에 비해 공급이 빠듯한 상황은 내년에도 이어질 것으로 전망했다. 그는 올해 3분기 말 기준 160GWh(기가와트시)인 북미 ESS 수주잔고를 바탕으로 내년 출하가 본격화하고, 신규 생산라인의 초기 가동 비용 부담도 줄어들 것으로 전망했다. 이에 따라 ESS 사업부가 내년 흑자로 돌아설 것으로 예상했다. 올해 4분기 매출은 전 분기보다 12% 증가한 10조8천억원, 영업이익은 35% 감소한 4천906억원으로 추정했다. 3분기에 반영된 전기차 고객사 물량 보상금의 일회성 효과가 사라지는 영향이지만, 북미 ESS 출하 확대 등으로 이익 체력은 개선될 것으로 내다봤다. 제보는 카카오톡 okjebo <저작권자(c) 연합뉴스, 무단 전재-재배포, AI 학습 및 활용 금지> 2026/11/04 08:33 송고 2026년11월04일 08시33분 송고
https://www.yna.co.kr/view/akr2026110402.title_zh: 대신证券称：“LG新能源明年ESS业绩将全面提升……下调目标价”
https://www.yna.co.kr/view/akr2026110402.body_zh: （首尔=韩联社）记者姜수지 =  대신证券表示，尽管LG新能源解决方案（股票代码373220）的能源存储系统（ESS）业务短期内表现疲弱，但预计其业绩改善将从明年全面展开。대신证券研究员金귀연（音译）评价道：“ESS业务部门持续亏损、订单表现不佳令人遗憾，但改善趋势确实存在。”ESS业务部门的亏损以营业利润为基准，不包括美国先进制造生产税收抵免（AMPC）。不过，대신证券下调了LG新能源解决方案的目标股价，理由是其对明年北美电池出货量和小型电池盈利能力的预期有所降低。目标股价从原来的53万韩元降至50万韩元，这意味着较前一日收盘价33.8万韩元仍有约48%的上涨空间。金研究员表示，ESS订单和扭亏为盈的时间晚于预期令人遗憾，但北美ESS项目需求相比供给仍然紧张，这一局面预计将持续到明年。她预计，以今年第三季度末160GWh（吉瓦时）的北美ESS订单积压为基础，明年出货将全面展开，新建生产线的初期运行成本负担也将随之减少。因此，预计ESS业务部门明年将恢复盈利。今年第四季度营收预计为10.8万亿韩元，较上一季度增长12%；营业利润预计为4906亿韩元，下降35%。这是因为第三季度计入的电动汽车客户订单量补偿金一次性效应将消失，但随着北美ESS出货扩大，盈利能力预计将得到改善。报道请通过KakaoTalk联系okjebo <版权所有(c) 韩联社，未经许可禁止转载、翻印及用于人工智能学习和应用> 2026/11/04 08:33发稿 2026年11月4日08时33分发稿

https://www.yna.co.kr/view/akr2026110402.title_zh: KB证券下调丰山目标价……“铜价暴跌等外部环境不利”
https://www.yna.co.kr/view/akr2026110402.body_zh: （首尔=韩联社）记者高恩智=KB证券4日就风산[103140]表示：“韩元升值、铜价回落趋于稳定等不利经营环境的影响难以避免”，并将目标股价从11.2万韩元下调至9万韩元。分析师崔东贤在当天的报告中解释称：“受不利的宏观（宏观经济）环境影响，_shield部门增长放缓，而国防产业部门的交付全面恢复预计要到2027年，因此下调2026年和2027年营业利润率预测，进而下调目标股价。”今年第三季度营业利润为1088亿韩元，略高于市场一致预期（市场平均预测值）。尤其是在国内供应持续受阻的情况下，国防产业部门出口量增加，营业利润率提高至17%。另一方面，盾牌部门尽管平均销售单价（ASP）有所增长，但由于销量下降和韩元升值的影响，营业利润率仅为2%。崔研究员表示：“盾牌部门录得140亿韩元营业亏损，预计将转为亏损”，并预计“随着韩元升值及铜价回落稳定的效果全面显现，金属损失（Metal Loss·铜价下跌时持有存货价值降低而产生的损失）将超过400亿韩元。”关于国防产业部门，他表示：“预计随着国内业务占比提高带动收入增长，营业利润将达到669亿韩元”，并预测“由于国内业务贡献度较高，国防产业营业利润率（OPM）将降至13.1%，较上季度下降3.9个百分点。”明年值得关注的事项包括国防产业部门交付恢复正常、盾牌部门扩大高利润率业务以及宏观因素（铜价、汇率）的影响。崔研究员解释道：“国防产业交付将恢复正常，但截至2027年，由于国内业务占比较高，盈利能力改善幅度不会太大；盾牌部门将把高附加值业务占比扩大至40%，使单纯加工利润率提高1个百分点以上”，并称“宏观环境恶化的可能性较高，因此预计全年将出现金属损失”。本报通过KakaoTalk okjebo发送 < exclusively copyrighted by 联合新闻，禁止擅自转载·再发布及用于AI学习和应用> 2026/11/04 08:32发稿 2026年11月04日08时32分发稿

https://www.vanguardngr.com/2026/11/abia.body: UMUAHIA — For pregnant women in Okuenyi community, Obingwa Local Government Area of Abia State, the journey to motherhood was often a painful test of endurance, one that began long before labour pains set in. With no functional health facility to attend to them, expectant mothers had to trek approximately three miles to neighbouring communities in search of antenatal care and safe delivery. For some, the journey was a desperate race against time, with the lives of both mother and child hanging in the balance. But one woman who grew up in the community could no longer bear the sight of her people enduring such hardship. Moved by the plight of the women, Mrs Ebere Ulelu-Obiesie, an indigene of Okuenyi, stepped in to change the narrative, sponsoring the renovation and upgrading of the community’s dilapidated temporary health post and equipping it with essential medical facilities. Her intervention, complemented by financial support from Rev. Friday Nnah, Proprietor of Abundant Living Christian School, Okuenyi, has brought renewed hope to a community whose women had for years faced the agonising prospect of travelling miles to access basic healthcare. For the women of Okuenyi, the renovated facility which was inaugurated recently, represents much more than refurbished walls and newly acquired medical equipment. It offers the possibility of receiving medical attention closer to home and, perhaps, a safer journey into motherhood. Narrating the circumstances that prompted the intervention, Mrs. Ulelu-Obiesie told SEV that her attachment to Okuenyi, where she was born and raised before marriage, made it impossible for her to turn her back on the suffering of her people. She disclosed that the decision to rehabilitate the health post was driven by her worry over the deplorable condition of the facility and the difficulties pregnant women in the area pass through to access healthcare. According to her, a visit to the health post with her husband, Mr Ernest Obiesie, exposed the gravity of the situation and strengthened her resolve to intervene. “I was born in Okuenyi before I got married. I could not stand by and watch my people continue to face these difficult challenges, especially in accessing healthcare services. Pregnant women, in particular, were exposed to enormous difficulties. “After visiting the former health post in Okuenyi with my husband and seeing its deplorable condition, I resolved to liberate my people from these challenges by initiating the project through my husband, in collaboration with my co-sponsors,” she said. Her husband, Ernest, revealed that he initially hesitated when she presented the proposal, citing financial constraints. However, seeing the condition of the health post during a subsequent visit changed his perspective, as the couple resolved to respond to the community’s urgent healthcare needs. One of the beneficiaries of the medical outreach, Mrs Nwablessing Nwankudu, offered a poignant account of the ordeal residents had endured before the intervention. She said pregnant women and other residents were often compelled to trek approximately three miles to neighbouring communities to access medical services, including antenatal care and delivery. For expectant mothers, the distance was not merely an inconvenience. It was a potentially dangerous undertaking, particularly when labour commenced unexpectedly or complications arose. Nwankudu expressed gratitude to the project sponsors, praying that God would continue to bless them for bringing relief to the community. She, however, appealed to the Abia State Government to upgrade the facility into a standard health centre and rehabilitate the community’s access roads to make healthcare delivery more accessible. Representing Governor Otti at the commissioning, Director, Office of the Special Adviser to the Governor on Health, Hon. Ukaegbu Ndubuisi said the intervention had drawn the state government’s attention to the absence of a standard health centre in Okuenyi and the deplorable condition of roads linking the community. He assured the residents that their concerns would be conveyed to the governor for necessary action. “We assure the people of Okuenyi that this message will get to the Governor, and he will swing into action in the coming months to ensure that the upgraded temporary health post is transformed into a standard health centre, the inaccessible roads are graded, and the people of Okuenyi receive their democratic dividends,” he said. The inauguration ceremony was accompanied by a free medical outreach led by Dr Obioma Nwaogwugwu, Supervisor for Health, Obingwa LGA, and other healthcare professionals. The outreach provided residents with access to medical consultations and other healthcare services, further extending the benefits of the intervention beyond the rehabilitation of the facility. In a related humanitarian gesture, Mrs Precious Nnah, wife of Rev. Friday Nnah, distributed food items to women who attended the medical outreach. In his remark, the Labour Party flagbearer for Obingwa East State Constituency in the 2027 Abia State House of Assembly election, Seth Kelechi Ebere, commended the benefactors for their contributions to the project. He described the intervention as an exemplary act of community development worthy of emulation by other prominent indigenes. Meanwhile, Ebere pledged continued support towards transforming the facility into a standard health centre and urged residents to support the continuity of the Otti administration in the 2027 general elections. The inauguration attracted government officials, political stakeholders, traditional rulers, community leaders, healthcare professionals and other dignitaries. For Mrs Ulelu-Obiesie, the intervention is a personal response to a longstanding communal challenge. But for the women of Okuenyi, it is a potential turning point in their healthcare experience. But for pregnant women who once had to trek miles in search of a place to deliver their babies, the renovated health post simply means that motherhood should no longer begin with a hazardous journey in search of medical care. However, with the facility still awaiting transformation into a standard health centre and the community’s access roads remaining a challenge, residents hope the government’s pledge will translate into concrete action. For now, one daughter’s compassion has brought healthcare closer to homes. The agrarian community awaits the next chapter. Even though some health care facilities in Abia have received a facelift, some are still yearning for intervention. Checks by SEV revealed that Otti’s administration has recorded significant progress in the health sector, renovating over 200 primary healthcare centres, six general hospitals and three tertiary health institutions across Abia State. The governor has also promised to sustain his health care transformation, assuring that other PHCs in dilapidated condition will receive government attention. However, communities yet to benefit from the interventions are eagerly awaiting their turn. Comments expressed here do not reflect the opinions of Vanguard newspapers or any employee thereof

https://www.vanguardngr.com/2026/11/abia.body_zh: 乌穆阿希亚——在阿比亚州奥宾格瓦地方政府辖区的奥库埃尼社区，对于孕妇而言，漫长的产育之路往往是一场令人煎熬的耐力考验，而且早在阵痛来临之前就已开始。由于当地没有可正常运营的医疗设施 serviced 孕妇只能徒步约三英里前往邻近社区，寻求产前护理和安全分娩。对一些人来说，这是一场与时间赛跑的绝望之旅，母亲和孩子的生命都命悬一线。然而，一位在该社区长大的女性再也无法忍受家乡民众忍受这样的困境。奥库埃尼本族人埃贝雷·乌莱卢-奥比耶夫人受到妇女们苦境的触动，挺身而出改变这一局面，资助翻修和升级社区破旧的临时卫生站，并为该站配备必要的医疗设施。在她的努力和奥库埃尼丰盛生活基督学校负责人弗莱迪·纳纳牧师提供的资金支持下，这个多年以来一直让当地妇女痛苦不堪、不得不跋涉数英里才能获得基本医疗服务的社区重新看到了希望。对奥库埃尼的妇女而言，最近启用的翻修设施远不只是焕然一新的墙壁和新购置的医疗设备。它让她们有望在家附近获得医疗服务，或许也让她们走向母职的旅程更加安全。乌莱卢-奥比耶夫人讲述促使她采取行动的经历时告诉SEV，她出生并在婚前成长于奥库埃尼，这使她无法对家乡民众的苦难袖手旁观。她透露，决定修复卫生站，是因为她对设施令人失望的状况以及当地孕妇为获得医疗服务而经历的艰难深感担忧。据她表示，她与丈夫欧内斯特·奥比耶先生探访卫生站后，意识到问题的严重性，也更加坚定了她出手干预的决心。她说：“我婚前就出生在奥库埃尼。我无法袖手旁观，任由家乡民众继续面对这些艰难挑战，尤其是在获得医疗服务方面。孕妇尤其面临极大的困难。“与丈夫探访奥库埃尼旧卫生站并看到其令人失望的状况后，我决定通过丈夫发起这个项目，并与我的共同资助人合作，让家乡民众摆脱这些困境。”她的丈夫欧内斯特表示，妻子最初提出这个方案时，他因资金受限而有所犹豫。然而，后来探访卫生站时看到那里的状况后，他改变了看法，夫妻二人决定回应社区迫切的医疗需求。医疗外展活动的受益者之一、内布拉斯辛·恩万库杜夫人深情讲述了干预行动前居民所忍受的艰辛。她说，孕妇和其他居民经常不得不徒步约三英里前往邻近社区接受医疗服务，包括产前护理和分娩。对孕产妇来说，这段距离绝不只是带来不便，尤其在临产突然开始或出现并发症时，更可能危及安全。恩万库杜感谢项目资助人，并祈祷上帝继续保佑他们，为社区带来relief。不过，她也呼吁阿比亚州政府将这座设施升级为标准卫生中心，并修复社区的通达道路，让医疗服务更加便利。奥蒂州长办公室卫生特设顾问办公室主任乌凯格布·恩杜比西阁下代表州长出席启用仪式时表示，这一干预行动促使州政府注意到奥库埃尼没有标准卫生中心，以及连接该社区的道路状况令人失望等问题。他向居民保证，会将他们的关切转达州长，以便采取必要行动。他说：“我们向奥库埃尼民众保证，这一诉求会传达给州长，他将在未来数月采取行动，确保升级后的临时卫生站被改造成标准卫生中心，改造目前难以通行的道路，让奥库埃尼人民享受民主红利。”启用仪式还配套举行了一场免费医疗外展活动，由奥宾格瓦地方政府卫生主管奥比奥马·恩瓦奥古古博士及其他医疗专业人员带队。外展活动让居民能够获得医疗咨询和其他医疗服务，将此次干预带来的益处进一步延伸至设施修复之外。作为一项相关的人道举措，弗莱迪·纳纳牧师的妻子普里西奥斯·纳纳夫人向参加医疗外展活动的妇女分发了食品。在讲话中，2027年阿比亚州众议院选举奥宾格瓦东州选区劳动党候选人塞思·凯莱奇·埃贝雷称赞资助人为项目作出的贡献。他说，这一干预行动是社区发展的典范，值得其他杰出本族人效仿。与此同时，埃贝雷承诺继续支持将这座设施改造成标准卫生中心，并敦促居民在2027年大选中支持奥蒂政府延续执政。启用仪式吸引了政府官员、政治利益相关者、传统统治者、社区领袖、医疗专业人员及其他贵宾。对乌莱卢-奥比耶夫人而言，此次干预是她个人对一项长期社区难题作出的回应；但对奥库埃尼的妇女而言，它可能成为其医疗体验的转折点。对于那些曾经不得不跋涉数英里寻找分娩之地的孕妇来说，翻修后的卫生站意味着成为母亲不再需要以一段充满危险的求医之旅作为开端。然而，由于该设施仍有待改造成标准卫生中心，社区通达道路的问题也依然存在，居民希望政府的承诺能够转化为实际行动。如今，一名女儿的善意让医疗服务离家门更近了。这个农业社区正等待下一章的到来。尽管阿比亚州部分医疗设施已经焕然一新，但一些设施仍在等待干预。SEV核查发现，奥蒂政府已在卫生领域取得显著进展，对全州200多所初级卫生保健中心、6所综合医院和3所三级医疗机构的翻新。州长还承诺继续推进医疗保健转型，并保证其他处于破旧状态的初级卫生保健中心也将得到政府关注。然而，尚未受益于这些干预行动的社区正急切等待轮到自身。此处表达的意见不代表Vanguard报及其任何员工的观点

https://www.yna.co.kr/view/akr2026110402.body: (서울=연합뉴스) 김유향 기자 = 키움증권은 4일 한국항공우주047810의 신규 수주가 올해 제시한 목표치의 약 20%만 충족한 상황이라며 목표주가를 기존 23만원에서 18만5천원으로 하향했다. 이한결 연구원은 "한국항공우주는 올해 수주 가이던스(회사측 전망치)를 약 10조4천억원으로 제시했는데 3분기 누적 기준 신규 수주는 약 2조2천억원으로 목표치의 약 20%를 충족하며 부진한 상황"이라고 설명했다. 특히 "국내 사업은 약 3조원 규모의 LAH(소형무장헬기) 3차 양산 계약 체결을 추진 중"이라며 "완제기 수출 부문은 인도네시아와 KF-21 수출을 위한 논의가 지속되고 있다"고 전했다. 이 연구원은 "약 4조원 규모의 KF-21 16대 공급 협상이 마무리 단계에 있으며 인도네시아의 예산 편성 승인을 기다리고 있는 것으로 파악된다"고 덧붙였다. 그는 한국군의 KF-21 전력화가 시작되면서 해외 수주 협상도 점진적으로 증가할 것으로 분석했다. 특히 인도네시아 외에 추가 수주 논의가 본격화할 경우, 주가 상승 동력으로 작용할 것이라고 기대했다. 그러면서 투자의견 '매수'를 유지했다. 앞서 한국항공우주는 올해 3분기 매출이 지난해 같은 기간보다 51.6% 늘어난 1조643억원, 영업이익은 31.9% 증가한 794억원을 기록했다고 전날 공시했다. 이 연구원은 "이번 영업이익은 시장 전망치인 753억원을 상회했다"며 "원화 강세의 영향으로 수출사업의 예정원가 변동에 따라 약 400억원의 이익이 발생했다"고 설명했다. 제보는 카카오톡 okjebo <저작권자(c) 연합뉴스, 무단 전재-재배포, AI 학습 및 활용 금지> 2026/11/04 08:28 송고 2026년11월04일 08시28분 송고
https://www.yna.co.kr/view/akr2026110402.title_zh: 키움证券称：“KAI新增订单乏力，目标价下调……预计第四季度复苏”
https://www.yna.co.kr/view/akr2026110402.body_zh: （首尔=韩联社）记者金有香 = 韩国金融投资证券表示，Korea Aerospace Industries（韩国航空航天工业，股票代码047810）4日的新订单仅完成今年既定目标的约20%，因此将目标股价从原来的23万韩元下调至18.5万韩元。研究员李汉洁（音译）解释道：“韩国航空航天工业今年提出的订单指引（公司预测值）约为10.4万亿韩元，但截至第三季度累计的新订单约为2.2万亿韩元，仅完成目标的约20%，表现不佳。”她尤其表示：“公司正在推进约3万亿韩元规模的LAH（轻型武装直升机）第三批次量产合同，‘国内业务方面正推进签署约3万亿韩元规模的LAH（轻型武装直升机）第三批次量产合同’；‘完整机出口方面，正在持续就面向印度尼西亚和KF-21的出口进行讨论。’”她还补充道：“目前，约4万亿韩元规模的16架KF-21供应谈判已进入最后阶段，据悉正等待印度尼西亚批准预算编制。”她分析认为，随着韩国军队开始列装KF-21，海外订单谈判也将逐步增加。尤其是在印度尼西亚以外的新增订单讨论全面展开之际，预计将成为推动股价上涨的动力。同时，她维持“买入”的投资评级。此前，韩国航空航天工业前一天公布，今年第三季度营收同比增长51.6%，达到1.0643万亿韩元；营业利润增长31.9%，达到794亿韩元。该研究员解释道：“本次营业利润高于市场预期的753亿韩元。由于韩元升值，出口业务预定成本发生变化，产生了约400亿韩元的利润。”报道请通过KakaoTalk联系okjebo <版权所有(c) 韩联社，未经许可禁止转载、翻印及用于人工智能学习和应用> 2026/11/04 08:28发稿 2026年11月4日08时28分发稿

https://www.yna.co.kr/view/akr2026110402.title: 카카오뱅크, 3분기 누적 순익 4천698억원…또 역대 최대

https://www.yna.co.kr/view/akr2026110402.title_zh: Kakao Bank第三季度累计净利润4698亿韩元……再创历史新高
https://www.yna.co.kr/view/akr2026110402.body_zh: （首尔=韩联社记者 姜赛罗姆）Kakao Bank[323410]于4日宣布，第三季度累计净利润为4698亿韩元，同比增长25.2%。Kakao Bank表示：“以小商户和实际需求者为中心扩大贷款，支付结算、投资等非利息收入实现多元化，再加上稳健的资金运用，共同促成了这一业绩。”贷款收益（信贷利息收入）为1.6409万亿韩元，同比增长10.0%；除贷款收益外的非利息收入为8883亿韩元，同比增长6.4%。非利息收入占全部营业收入的比重约为35%。第三季度，通过Kakao Bank的贷款比价服务执行合作金融机构贷款的资金规模达到1.4万亿韩元，同比增长14%。第三季度韩国国内银行家庭存款余额减少之际，Kakao Bank的活期存款和储蓄型存款均有所增长，存款余额达到71.805万亿韩元，同比增长9.2%（增加6.063万亿韩元）。即使银行业个人经营者贷款减少，Kakao Bank仍扩大相关供给，截至第三季度末，个人经营者贷款余额较上季度增加3490亿韩元，达到4.036万亿韩元。Kakao Bank第三季度新发放的中低收入群体贷款约为5100亿韩元；截至今年第三季度，累计供应规模约1.5万亿韩元的中低收入群体贷款。继推出非面对面购房尾款贷款后，Kakao Bank计划在明年推出中间金贷款等新产品，扩大住房抵押贷款覆盖范围。第三季度逾期率和固定收益贷款占比分别为0.49%和0.53%，较上季度分别改善0.02和0.01个百分点。据分析，最近一年新加入Kakao Bank的客户中，每4人就有3人（75%）为未成年人或50岁以上人群。集体账户用户数和余额分别为1330万用户和12.1万亿韩元。Kakao Bank计划通过推出采用“只有我知道的秘密账户”理念的“隐身账户”等新产品，扩大存款业务组合。Kakao Bank表示：“将以存款和平台能力为基础推动业务模式多元化，实现利息收入与非利息收入的均衡增长，同时把2026会计年度的股东回报率提高至50%。”举报请通过Kakao Talk联系okjebo <版权所有(c) 韩联社，禁止擅自转载、发行以及用于人工智能学习和应用> 2026/11/04 08:27发稿 2026年11月4日08时27分发稿

https://www.vanguardngr.com/2026/11/asuu.body: JALINGO – The Academic Staff Union of Universities (ASUU), Yola Zone, has declared solidarity with lecturers of Taraba State University (TSU) over their ongoing strike, describing their grievances as legitimate and demanding immediate implementation of the 2025 Federal Government-ASUU agreement. The union also urged the Taraba State Government to stop delaying the implementation of the agreed remuneration framework and settle outstanding arrears owed to the university’s academic staff. The Zonal Coordinator of ASUU, Comrade Dani Mamman, stated this while addressing journalists after an expanded congress meeting of the union in Jalingo. Mamman criticised the state government for what he described as unnecessary administrative delays, insisting that the grievances of the university’s lecturers deserved immediate attention. He said the zone’s support for ASUU-TSU was based on the principles of justice, equity, collective responsibility and the protection of the legitimate rights and entitlements of academic staff. The Yola Zone comprises seven public university branches across Adamawa, Borno, Taraba and Yobe states. They are Adamawa State University, Mubi; Federal University Gashua; Kashim Ibrahim University, Maiduguri; Modibbo Adama University, Yola; Taraba State University, Jalingo; University of Maiduguri; and Yobe State University, Damaturu. Mamman faulted the state government for placing Taraba State University lecturers in a different position from their counterparts in other universities in the region, urging it to end further delays. He said a report by the Taraba State Government’s fact-finding team, presented to ASUU on September 24, 2026, established that the universities covered by the exercise had fully implemented the 2025 FGN/ASUU agreement. According to him, the finding was particularly significant because other universities in the zone had adopted the payment tables provided under the agreement without undergoing similar fact-finding exercises. He said the state government had no justification for subjecting ASUU-TSU to further administrative processes after completing its verification exercise in August 2026. Mamman also expressed concern over what he described as endless computations by the government, particularly its consideration of alternative implementation levels of 95, 98 and 100 per cent after the verification exercise had been concluded. He maintained that consultations, negotiations and computations had been completed, leaving no reason for further delays. The zonal coordinator demanded the immediate and full implementation of the agreed remuneration framework without setting up additional committees or conducting further verification exercises. He also called for the settlement of all accumulated arrears based on the financial computations submitted by the tripartite committee. Other demands include strict adherence to the standard payment template stipulated in the 2025 agreement and immediate, meaningful engagement between the state government and ASUU-TSU in line with collective bargaining and mutual respect. Comments expressed here do not reflect the opinions of Vanguard newspapers or any employee thereof
https://www.vanguardngr.com/2026/11/asuu.title_zh: 尼日利亚联邦大学教师协会支持塔拉巴州立大学讲师，要求解决罢工问题
https://www.vanguardngr.com/2026/11/asuu.body_zh: 贾林戈——尼日利亚联邦大学学术人员工会（ASUU）约拉区已声援塔拉巴州立大学（TSU）教师针对持续罢工提出的诉求，称其诉求合理，并要求立即落实2025年联邦政府与ASUU达成的协议。工会还敦促塔拉巴州政府停止拖延落实协议约定的薪酬框架，并结清拖欠该大学学术人员的欠款。ASUU区协调员达尼·马曼在工会于贾林戈举行的扩大会议上对记者表示了上述立场。马曼批评州政府存在不必要的行政拖延，坚持认为大学教师的诉求理应得到立即处理。他说，该区对ASUU-TSU的支持以正义、公平、集体责任以及保护学术人员合法权益和应享权益为原则。约拉区包括阿达马瓦、博尔诺、塔拉巴和约贝4州各地的7所公立大学分支机构，分别为穆比的阿达马瓦州立大学、加舒阿联邦大学、迈杜古里的卡希姆·易卜拉欣大学、约拉的莫迪博·阿达马大学、贾林戈的塔拉巴州立大学、迈杜古里大学以及达马图鲁的约贝州立大学。马曼指责州政府使塔拉巴州立大学教师与该地区其他大学的同行处境不同，敦促其停止进一步拖延。他说，塔拉巴州政府事实调查小组于2026年9月24日向ASUU提交的报告确认，纳入此次调查的大学已全面落实2025年联邦政府与ASUU协议。据他称，这一调查结果尤为重要，因为该区其他大学在未开展类似事实调查的情况下，已采用协议规定的薪酬支付表。他说，州政府在2026年8月完成核查后，没有任何理由再让ASUU-TSU经历更多行政程序。马曼还对政府所谓的无尽计算表示关切，尤其是在核查结束后仍考虑按95%、98%和100%的不同水平执行协议。他坚持认为，磋商、谈判和计算均已完成，没有理由继续拖延。该区协调员要求立即全面落实协议约定的薪酬框架，不得另设委员会，也不得开展进一步的核查工作。他还要求根据三方委员会提交的财务计算结果，结清所有积欠款项。其他要求包括严格遵守2025年协议规定的标准薪酬支付模板，以及依据集体谈判原则和相互尊重，立即与ASUU-TSU开展实质性沟通。此处发表的意见不代表Vanguard报纸及其任何员工的观点

https://www.yna.co.kr/view/akr2026110402.body: (서울=연합뉴스) 황철환 기자 = IBK투자증권은 씨엠티엑스[388210]에 대한 목표주가를 11만5천원에서 8만원으로 하향 조정했다고 4일 밝혔다. 투자의견은 '매수'를 유지했다. 이건재 코스닥리서치센터장은 "씨엠티엑스의 2026년 3분기 잠정 매출액은 전년 동기 대비 18.1% 증가한 484억원, 영업이익은 32.2% 감소한 105억원을 기록했다"고 전했다. 특히 "매출 증가에도 영업이익이 감소하며 영업이익률은 21.6%에 그쳤다"면서 "기존 투자판단의 핵심이었던 매출 성장과 30% 이상의 수익성 유지 가운데 수익성에 대한 기대를 충족하지 못한 것"이라고 짚었다. 이 센터장은 "이번 실적은 TSMC 공급 이력과 높은 이익률을 바탕으로 형성된 기업가치 프리미엄을 재점검하는 계기가 될 것"이라면서 "실적 부진의 주요 배경은 국내 주요 고객사의 생산라인 전환과 일부 제품의 사양 변경으로 추정한다"고 말했다. 아울러 대만 고객사에서도 제품 사양 변경이 진행되면서 공급에 영향을 미친 것으로 보이며 "이에 따라 매출이 당초 기대에 미치지 못하면서 고정비 부담이 커져 수익성이 하락했을 가능성이 있다"고 진단했다. 다만 "고객사별 매출 변화와 세부 비용 내역은 추가 확인이 필요하며, 이번 부진이 일시적인 공급 차질인지 수익구조의 변화인지는 추가로 확인이 필요한 상황"이라고 덧붙였다. 이 센터장은 "지난 9월 커버리지 개시 당시, 3분기 실적이 매출 성장과 높은 수익성의 지속 여부를 확인할 중요한 계기가 될 것으로 전망했다"면서 "향후 주가 재평가의 관건은 고객사의 사양 변경에 따른 공급 차질 해소와 영업이익률 회복 여부"라고 강조했다. 제보는 카카오톡 okjebo <저작권자(c) 연합뉴스, 무단 전재-재배포, AI 학습 및 활용 금지> 2026/11/04 08:20 송고 2026년11월04일 08시20분 송고
https://www.yna.co.kr/view/akr2026110402.title_zh: IBK证券下调Cmtx目标价……“未能证明盈利能力预期”
https://www.yna.co.kr/view/akr2026110402.body_zh: （首尔＝韩联社）记者黄铁铉报道＝IBK投资证券4日宣布，将对CMTX[388210]的目标股价从11.5万韩元下调至8万韩元，并维持“买入”的投资评级。该公司科斯达克研究中心主任李健在表示：“CMTX第三季度初步财报显示，2026年第三季度营业收入为484亿韩元，同比增长18.1%；营业利润为105亿韩元，同比下降32.2%。”他指出：“尽管营业收入增长，但营业利润仍出现下降，营业利润率仅为21.6%，未能满足此前投资判断所依据的营收增长以及维持30%以上盈利能力中对盈利能力的期待。”该中心主任表示：“此次业绩将成为重新审视企业价值溢价的机会，而这一溢价主要建立在与TSMC的供应合作历史和较高利润率的基础上。”他解释道：“预计业绩不佳的主要背景是国内主要客户转换生产线以及部分产品更改规格。与此同时，随着台湾客户也在推进产品规格变更，供应也受到影响，因此营收可能未达到最初预期，同时固定成本负担加重，导致盈利能力下降。”不过，他补充说：“各客户的营收变化和详细成本构成仍需进一步确认；此次表现不佳究竟是暂时性的供应中断，还是盈利结构发生了变化，目前仍有必要继续核查。”该中心主任强调：“此前在9月开始覆盖该公司时，我们预计第三季度业绩将成为确认营收增长和高盈利能力能否持续的重要节点。”他同时强调：“今后股价能否重新估值，关键在于客户更改规格所造成的供应问题能否解决，以及营业利润率能否回升。”报道联系邮箱：okjebo〈版权(c) 韩联社，未经许可禁止转载、再发布及用于AI学习和应用〉2026/11/04 08:20发布，2026年11月4日08时20分发布

https://www.yna.co.kr/view/akr2026110316.summary: (서울=연합뉴스) 황재하 기자 = 더불어민주당이 여론 역풍에 '조작기소 특검법안'에서 공소취소 권한을 빼고 추진하지만, 수사 대상 12건 가운데 이재명 대통령이 관련된 것이 8건에 달해 정치적 논란이 계속될 전망이다. 4일 법조계에 따르면 특검법안 명칭은 '윤석열 정권 검찰청, 국가정보원, 감사원 등의 조작수사·조작기소 등 의혹의 진상규명을 위한 특별검사 임명 등에 관한 법률안'이다. 법안이 정한 특검 수사 대상 중 이 대통령 관련은 ▲ 쌍방울 대북송금 ▲ 대장동 개발비리 ▲ 위례신도시 개발비리 ▲ 백현동 개발 특혜 ▲ 대장동·백현동 개발 관련 허위사실 공표 ▲ 성남FC 불법 후원 ▲ 김진성씨 위증교사 ▲ 경기도지사 법인카드 유용 등 8건이다.
https://www.yna.co.kr/view/akr2026110316.summary_zh: （首尔＝韩联社）记者黄在河＝共同民主党虽然遭遇舆论逆风，仍推动在“操纵起诉特别检察法”中删除公诉取消权，但预计政治争议将持续，因为特别检察的12项调查对象中有8项涉及李在明总统。据法界4日消息，该特别检察法草案的全称为《为查明尹锡悦政权检察厅、国家情报院、审计院等操纵调查、操纵起诉等嫌疑真相而任命特别检察官等法律草案》。法律草案规定的特别检察调查对象中，涉及李总统的事项包括：▲双方就对朝汇款▲大庄洞开发贪腐▲威律新市开发贪腐▲白贤洞开发特殊优待▲就大庄洞和白贤洞开发公布虚假事实▲성남FC非法提供资金▲金真成证人作伪证▲利用京畿道知事法人卡等，共8项。
https://www.yna.co.kr/view/akr2026110316.body: (서울=연합뉴스) 황재하 기자 = 더불어민주당이 여론 역풍에 '조작기소 특검법안'에서 공소취소 권한을 빼고 추진하지만, 수사 대상 12건 가운데 이재명 대통령이 관련된 것이 8건에 달해 정치적 논란이 계속될 전망이다. 4일 법조계에 따르면 특검법안 명칭은 '윤석열 정권 검찰청, 국가정보원, 감사원 등의 조작수사·조작기소 등 의혹의 진상규명을 위한 특별검사 임명 등에 관한 법률안'이다. 법안이 정한 특검 수사 대상 중 이 대통령 관련은 ▲ 쌍방울 대북송금 ▲ 대장동 개발비리 ▲ 위례신도시 개발비리 ▲ 백현동 개발 특혜 ▲ 대장동·백현동 개발 관련 허위사실 공표 ▲ 성남FC 불법 후원 ▲ 김진성씨 위증교사 ▲ 경기도지사 법인카드 유용 등 8건이다. 쌍방울 대북 송금은 조작 기소 의혹을 둘러싼 국정조사에서 가장 큰 쟁점이 된 사건으로, 특검을 추진하는 결정적 계기가 됐다. 이 대통령은 경기도지사였던 2019년 1월부터 이듬해 1월까지 이화영 당시 평화부지사와 공모해 경기도가 북한에 지급해야 할 스마트팜 사업비 500만달러와 도지사 방북 비용 300만달러를 김성태 전 쌍방울그룹 회장에게 대납시킨 의혹으로 기소됐다. 이화영 전 부지사에 대한 유죄 판결이 확정된 이 사건에서 이 대통령은 제3자 뇌물수수 혐의로 재판에 넘겨졌으나 대선 당선 이후 수원지법에서 공판준비 단계였던 1심이 중단됐다. 민주당 의원들은 특검법안 원문에서 쌍방울 대북송금 사건을 두고 "수사 검사가 변호인을 회유, 압박한 사실이 폭로됐다"며 "윤석열 정부 대통령실과 국가정보원 등이 유기적으로 관여해 검찰에 증거를 선택적으로 제공하도록 조치하는 등 사건 조작 정황이 드러났다"고 했다. 마찬가지로 수원지법에서 1심이 중단된 법인카드 유용 혐의는 이 대통령이 2018년 7월∼2021년 10월 법인카드 등 경기도 예산으로 과일과 샌드위치, 음식 대금으로 지출하는 등 총 1억653만원을 사적으로 사용했다는 내용이다. 대장동 개발비리, 위례신도시 개발비리, 성남FC 불법 후원은 각각 별개의 사건이나 검찰은 수사 끝에 2023년 3월 세 사건을 한꺼번에 기소했다. 대장동 개발비리는 이 대통령이 성남시장 시절 민간 업자들에게 유리한 대장동 개발 사업 구조를 승인해 성담도시개발공사에 4천895억원에 달하는 손해를 끼친 혐의로 2023년 3월 재판에 넘겨진 사건이다. 이 대통령은 2013년 11월 위례신도시 개발사업에서 측근들을 통해 민간 업자들에게 내부 정보를 알려줘 부당이득 211억원을 얻게 한 혐의를 받는다. 또 성남FC 구단주로서 2014년 10월부터 2016년 9월까지 두산건설 등 4개 기업의 후원금 133억5천만원을 받는 대가로 건축 인허가나 토지 용도 변경 등 편의를 제공한 혐의가 있다. 백현동 개발 특혜는 이 대통령이 2014년 4월∼2018년 3월 성남 분당구 백현동 개발사업 과정에서 민간 업자인 정바울 아시아디벨로퍼 회장에게 특혜를 몰아줘 1천356억원의 이익을 독차지하게 하고, 사업에 배제된 성남도개공에 최소 200억원의 손해를 끼쳤다는 혐의다. 이 밖에 이 대통령이 대선후보 시절 방송 인터뷰에서 대장동 개발사업 관련자인 고(故) 김문기 성남도시개발공사 개발1처장을 몰랐다는 허위 사실을 공표한 혐의(공직선거법 위반)는 대법원 전원합의체가 유죄 취지로 파기환송한 후 파기환송심 단계에서 심리가 멈췄다. 이 대통령이 2019년 자신의 공직선거법 위반 혐의 재판에서 고(故) 김병량 전 성남시장의 비서 김진성씨에게 거짓 증언을 요구한 혐의는 1심에서 무죄가 나온 후 항소심 도중 재판이 중단됐다. 나머지 특검 수사대상 4건 가운데 김용 전 민주연구원 부원장의 금품수수 사건은 이 대통령과 직접 관련은 없으나 측근의 비리로 볼 수 있다. 이 밖의 3건은 문재인 정부의 부동산 통계 조작, 서해 공무원 피격, 윤석열 전 대통령에 대한 명예훼손 허위 보도 등이다. 앞서 민주당은 지난 5월 특검법을 발의하면서 이미 제기한 공소를 취소할 권한까지 특검에게 부여하는 내용을 넣었다가 사법 독립성을 침해한다는 비판이 제기됐다. 진보 성향 법학자들까지 나서 비판하며 여론이 악화하자 이재명 대통령은 지난 9월 18일 기자회견에서 "조작기소 특검의 권한 사항 중 기존 기소 사건의 이송 및 처분에 관한 조항을 삭제하고 진상 규명에만 집중해달라"고 당부했다. 이에 민주당은 이 대통령 발언대로 기존 사건의 공소 취소 권한을 삭제한 특검법안을 추진하고 있지만, 특검이 공소청을 통해 공소를 취소할 법적·논리적 근거를 마련하는 역할을 할 가능성이 있어 논란이 이어질 것으로 보인다. 제보는 카카오톡 okjebo <저작권자(c) 연합뉴스, 무단 전재-재배포, AI 학습 및 활용 금지> 2026/11/04 05:30 송고 2026년11월04일 05시30분 송고 올해 10월 28일 국회
