https://www.politico.eu/article/germany-.title: Germany’s Merz warns Europe needs seat at the table as Trump renews Ukraine talks
https://www.politico.eu/article/germany-.summary: BERLIN — German Chancellor Friedrich Merz warned that Europe must help shape any Ukraine peace agreement as U.S. President Donald Trump renews his push to negotiate a deal with his Russian counterpart Vladimir Putin.
https://www.politico.eu/article/germany-.summary_zh: 柏林——美国总统唐纳德·特朗普再次推动与其俄罗斯 counterpart弗拉基米尔·普京协商达成协议之际，德国总理弗里德里希·默茨警告，欧洲必须参与塑造任何乌克兰和平协议。
https://www.politico.eu/article/germany-.body: BERLIN — German Chancellor Friedrich Merz warned that Europe must help shape any Ukraine peace agreement as U.S. President Donald Trump renews his push to negotiate a deal with his Russian counterpart Vladimir Putin. “Europe must and wants to play a role in this process,” said Merz alongside Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy in Berlin Tuesday. “Key elements of a peaceful solution — whether regarding sanctions or the security architecture — can only be resolved with us Europeans. And everyone involved knows that very well.” “The U.S. and Russia — with all due respect to the U.S. — cannot decide whether Ukraine will become a member state of the European Union,” Zelenskyy said. “For that we need the support of other countries, and all of those countries are in Europe.” Merz’s meeting with Zelenskyy in Berlin comes as the Trump administration renews efforts to reach a negotiated end to the full-scale war in Ukraine and before U.S.-brokered talks between Ukraine and Russia are set to resume in Abu Dhabi next week . The meeting in Berlin also comes a day before talks hosted by the European Commission with representatives from the U.S., Ukraine and key European allies on Ukraine’s post-war reconstruction and economic future. Merz also sharply criticized the U.S. decision to invite Russian President Vladimir Putin to December’s G20 summit in Miami, saying the move is shutting Ukraine out of talks about its own fate. “If President Trump were to decide to invite the Russian president, then Ukraine must be the first topic of discussion,” Merz said. “And if Ukraine is discussed, then the president of Ukraine must be seated at the table. In any case, from my perspective, it is completely unacceptable for third countries to discuss Ukraine’s fate without involving Ukraine itself.” European leaders, including Merz, have long feared the U.S. may pursue a Ukraine peace deal on terms that sideline Europe and disadvantage Ukraine
https://www.politico.eu/article/germany-.title_zh: 特朗普重启乌克兰谈判之际，德国总理默茨警告欧洲需要参与决策
https://www.politico.eu/article/germany-.body_zh: 柏林——美国总统唐纳德·特朗普再次推动与俄罗斯总统弗拉基米尔·普京就协议进行谈判之际，德国总理弗里德里希·默茨警告，欧洲必须参与塑造任何乌克兰和平协议。周二，默茨在柏林与乌克兰总统弗拉基米尔·泽连斯基一同发表讲话时表示：“欧洲必须，也希望在这一进程中发挥重要作用。和平解决方案的关键要素——无论是制裁还是安全架构——只有在我们欧洲人的参与下才能解决。所有相关方都非常清楚这一点。”泽连斯基说：“美国和俄罗斯——充分尊重美国——不能决定乌克兰是否会成为欧盟成员国。为此，我们需要其他国家的支持，而所有这些国家都在欧洲。”此前，特朗普政府正加紧努力，争取通过谈判结束乌克兰全面战争；由美国斡旋的乌克兰与俄罗斯会谈定于下周在阿布扎比恢复。默茨在柏林与泽连斯基会晤之际，欧洲委员会也将在次日主持会谈，邀请美国、乌克兰以及欧洲主要盟友的代表，讨论乌克兰的战后重建与经济未来。默茨还严厉批评美国决定邀请俄罗斯总统弗拉基米尔·普京出席12月在迈阿密举行的二十国集团峰会，称此举将乌克兰排除在有关自身命运的讨论之外。默茨说：“如果特朗普总统决定邀请俄罗斯总统，那么乌克兰必须成为讨论的首要议题。而且，如果要讨论乌克兰，乌克兰总统就必须坐在谈判桌旁。无论如何，在我看来，第三方国家不邀请乌克兰参与，就讨论乌克兰的命运，是完全不可接受的。”包括默茨在内的欧洲领导人长期以来一直担心，美国可能会推动一项将欧洲边缘化并使乌克兰处于不利地位的乌克兰和平协议……

https://leadership.ng/asuu-backs-tsu-str.title: ASUU Backs TSU Strike, Urges Kefas To Implement 2025 Agreement
https://leadership.ng/asuu-backs-tsu-str.summary: The ASUU Yola Zone Coordinator, Dani Mamman, made the call on Tuesday during a solidarity visit to the university in Jalingo, where he accused the Taraba State Government of failing to honour its agreement with academic staff.
https://leadership.ng/asuu-backs-tsu-str.summary_zh: 尼日利亚教师工会（ASUU）Yola（地区）协调员Dani Mamman于周二提出这一要求。他当时到Jalingo的大学进行声援访问，指责Taraba（州）政府未能履行与教职员工达成的协议。
https://leadership.ng/asuu-backs-tsu-str.body: The union said TSU was the only university in the North yet to implement the agreed remuneration framework, despite the conclusion of a government-constituted verification exercise. The ASUU Yola Zone Coordinator, Dani Mamman, made the call on Tuesday during a solidarity visit to the university in Jalingo, where he accused the Taraba State Government of failing to honour its agreement with academic staff. Mamman described the delay as a breach of an established agreement and a disregard for the welfare and legitimate entitlements of lecturers, insisting that the grievances of the TSU branch were legitimate and required urgent government intervention. He expressed concern that while other state governments across the North-East had implemented the 2025 agreement, Taraba State was yet to do so, despite the completion of a verification exercise initiated by the state government. According to him, a fact-finding team constituted by the government had established that the universities visited had fully implemented the agreement. He said the report was reportedly presented to the union on September 24, 2026, following a verification exercise that commenced in August. Mamman, however, expressed disappointment that the government was still undertaking salary computations despite the conclusion of the exercise, describing the development as an unnecessary administrative delay. He also faulted the reported consideration of three implementation options of 95 per cent, 98 per cent and 100 per cent, arguing that the verification and financial assessment processes had already been concluded. The ASUU zonal coordinator insisted that the remuneration framework should be implemented in accordance with the payment template contained in the December 23, 2025 Federal Government-ASUU agreement, which was circulated by the National Salaries, Incomes and Wages Commission on December 30, 2025. He explained that the agreement covered several remuneration components, including Basic CONUASS, Consolidated Academic Tools Allowance, Professorial Allowance, Earned Academic Allowances and responsibility allowances for designated academic and administrative positions. Mamman warned that continued delays could undermine staff retention, institutional competitiveness and the university’s ability to attract qualified academic personnel, with adverse implications for academic standards and institutional stability. He consequently demanded immediate and full implementation of the agreement without further consultations, committees or verification exercises. The union also demanded payment of all accumulated arrears in line with the financial computation submitted by the tripartite committee, strict adherence to the agreed payment template and meaningful engagement with the TSU branch to resolve the ongoing industrial dispute. Mamman said academic staff had demonstrated considerable patience through sustained engagements and constructive dialogue before resorting to industrial action, reaffirming the zonal leadership’s solidarity with the striking lecturers. He maintained that industrial harmony was a collective responsibility and warned that the patience of academic staff should not be taken for granted. The ASUU leader appealed to stakeholders, members of the university community and the general public to prevail on the state government to honour the agreement, clear outstanding entitlements and bring the dispute to an amicable conclusion. The zonal leadership further alleged that TSU remained one of the few universities, if not the only institution among the 19 northern states, yet to implement the agreed remuneration framework. https://leadership.ng/asuu-backs-tsu-str.title_zh: ASUU支持TSU罢工，敦促Kefas落实2025年协议
https://leadership.ng/asuu-backs-tsu-str.body_zh: 工会表示，尽管政府组建的核查工作已经结束，TSU仍是北方唯一尚未落实双方商定薪酬框架的大学。ASUU约拉地区协调员Dani Mamman于周二前往贾林戈对这所大学进行声援访问时提出这一要求，并指责塔拉巴州政府未履行其与学术人员达成的协议。Mamman称，此举拖延既违反既定协议，也无视讲师的福利和合法权益；他坚持认为，TSU分会提出的诉求合理，需要政府立即干预。他表示担忧，东北部其他州政府均已落实2025年协议，但塔拉巴州尽管完成了州政府启动的核查工作，却仍未予执行。据他称，由政府组建的事实调查小组已经确认，受访大学均已全面落实协议。他说，该报告据称于2026年9月24日提交给工会，此前启动的核查工作于8月开始。然而，Mamman对核查结束后政府仍在计算工资感到失望，称这是没有必要的管理拖延。他还批评了据报正在考虑的95%、98%和100%三种落实方案，认为核查和财务评估程序均已结束。ASUU地区协调员坚持认为，薪酬框架应根据2025年12月23日联邦政府与ASUU协议所载的付款模板执行，该模板由National Salaries, Incomes and Wages Commission于2025年12月30日分发。他解释称，协议涵盖多个薪酬组成部分，包括基本CONUASS、综合学术工具津贴、教授津贴、 Earned Academic Allowances以及指定学术和行政岗位的职责津贴。Mamman警告称，持续拖延可能削弱教职员工的留任率、机构的竞争力以及大学吸引合格学术人才的能力，进而对学术标准和机构稳定造成不利影响。因此，他要求立即全面落实协议，不再进行任何磋商、设立委员会或开展核查。工会还要求，根据三方委员会提交的财务核算结果，支付所有积欠款项；严格遵守商定的付款模板；并与TSU分会展开实质性沟通，以解决持续存在的行业争议。Mamman说，在采取行业行动之前，学术人员通过持续交涉和建设性对话展现了极大的耐心；他再次确认地区领导层声援罢课讲师。他强调，行业和谐是集体责任，并警告称，不应把学术人员的耐心视为理所当然。ASUU负责人呼吁利益相关方、大学社区成员和公众向州政府施压，促使其履行协议、清偿拖欠待遇，并以友好方式结束争议。地区领导层进一步指控称，在北方19个州中，TSU仍是少数尚未落实商定薪酬框架的大学之一，甚至可能是唯一一所这样的院校。我们掌握独家优势。实时报道、突发新闻和独家角度将直接推送到您的手机。不要满足于过时新闻。加入LEADERSHIP NEWS的WhatsApp，随时获取全天候更新 →

https://www.themoscowtimes.com/2026/11/0.title: Melania Trump to Host Russian and Ukrainian Delegations at White House
https://www.themoscowtimes.com/2026/11/0.summary: U.S. first lady Melania Trump will host representatives from Russia and Ukraine at the White House this week to deliver remarks on a recently concluded ceasefire and humanitarian mission in the occupied Ukrainian town of Oleshky, the White House announced Tuesday. “This achievement marks an unprecedented diplomatic initiative by an American First Lady,” the White House said in a statement, adding that Melania Trump will deliver an address on the Oleshky ceasefire at 11 a.m. Eastern Time on Thursday.
https://www.themoscowtimes.com/2026/11/0.summary_zh: 白宫周二宣布，美国第一夫人梅拉尼娅·特朗普本周将在白宫接待俄罗斯和乌克兰的代表，就 recently 达成的停火协议以及在乌克兰被占领城镇奥列什基开展的人道主义任务发表讲话。白宫在声明中表示：“这一成就标志着美国第一夫人开展了一项前所未有的外交行动。”梅拉尼娅·特朗普将于周四美国东部时间上午11时就奥列什基停火协议发表讲话。
https://www.themoscowtimes.com/2026/11/0.body: U.S. first lady Melania Trump will host representatives from Russia and Ukraine at the White House this week to deliver remarks on a recently concluded ceasefire and humanitarian mission in the occupied Ukrainian town of Oleshky, the White House announced Tuesday. The six-day ceasefire, which ended Sunday, had allowed emergency aid to reach Oleshky and any civilians to leave if they wanted, either to Ukrainian-controlled territory or Russia. “This achievement marks an unprecedented diplomatic initiative by an American First Lady,” the White House said in a statement, adding that Melania Trump will deliver an address on the Oleshky ceasefire at 11 a.m. Eastern Time on Thursday. It did not name the Russian and Ukrainian representatives invited to appear during the address. https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/business/co.title: Korea weighs tax incentives for EVs as Chinese rivals gain ground
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/business/co.summary: Korea is weighing tax incentives for domestically produced electric vehicles (EVs) as Chinese rivals rapidly gain market share, fueling calls from automakers and lawmakers across party lines for government support to protect local production and jobs.
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/business/co.summary_zh: 在中国竞争对手迅速抢占市场份额之际，韩国正考虑为国产电动汽车提供税收优惠。这引发了车企和议员跨党派要求政府提供支持，以保护本土生产和就业。
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/business/co.body: Korea is weighing tax incentives for domestically produced electric vehicles (EVs) as Chinese rivals rapidly gain market share, fueling calls from automakers and lawmakers across party lines for government support to protect local production and jobs. Deputy Prime Minister and Finance Minister Lee Hyoung-il said the government would announce measures to strengthen the EV industry's competitiveness this month, following talks with Hyundai Motor Group Executive Chair Chung Euisun on Monday. Whether EVs should qualify for domestic production tax credits is expected to be a key focus of parliamentary debate over the government's tax reform plan. Chinese-made passenger EVs accounted for 43.5 percent of new registrations in Korea from January to September, up 8.4 percentage points from a year earlier, according to the Korea Automobile and Mobility Association and the Korea Automobile Importers and Distributors Association. Registrations more than doubled to about 112,400 vehicles from 51,500 year-on-year. Meanwhile, the share of domestically produced passenger EVs fell 6.2 percentage points to 48.7 percent, slipping below the 50 percent threshold for the first time. Chinese automakers are stepping up their push into the Korean market, following BYD's entry last year and Zeekr's local sales launch this year. Xpeng also appointed the first head of its new Korean unit on Tuesday, with former Volvo Car Korea executive Lee Man-sik set to take the post on Dec. 1. Chery Automobile and Great Wall Motor are also reportedly preparing to enter the market next year. The competitive pressure has intensified demands to extend a domestic production tax credit to EVs. The program, a key campaign pledge of President Lee Jae Myung, would provide tax credits based on production volumes to companies that manufacture and sell designated strategic products domestically. EVs were excluded from the government's tax reform proposal announced in August. During parliamentary audits last month, lawmakers from both the ruling Democratic Party of Korea (DPK) and the main opposition People Power Party (PPP) urged the government to extend the tax credit to domestically produced EVs. "The government stepped in to support our semiconductor industry when it was struggling. I believe we should provide support, including EV tax credits, to industries that are having difficulty competing with other countries and need a similar boost," Rep. Bae June-young of the PPP said during the audit. Rep. Moon Jin-seog of the DPK also criticized the exclusion of EVs from the government's tax reform proposal, saying it appeared to be pushing domestic automakers "to the brink" as they compete with price-competitive Chinese manufacturers. A total of 24 bills proposing to include EVs and other future mobility vehicles in the tax credit program have been introduced in the National Assembly. Seven more were submitted after the government unveiled its tax reform plan in August. The issue is expected to be taken up by the National Assembly's tax subcommittee this month, ahead of a possible floor vote in December. Meeting EV, autonomous-driving and parts industry executives on Monday, Lee signaled government engagement without committing to extending the credit. “Regarding support through electric vehicle production tax credits, the government will actively participate in parliamentary discussions and engage in in-depth discussions on the matter,” he said. He also said the government plans to announce a package of measures to strengthen the EV industry's competitiveness this month, incorporating industry feedback and support for autonomous driving technology and research and development of key components
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/business/co.title_zh: 随着中国竞争对手扩大优势，韩国考虑为电动汽车提供税收激励
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/business/co.body_zh: 随着中国竞争对手迅速抢占市场份额，韩国正考虑为国内生产的电动汽车提供税收优惠。汽车制造商和跨党派议员纷纷呼吁政府出手支持，以保护本土生产和就业。副首相兼财政部长李明 il表示，政府将在本月公布加强电动汽车行业竞争力的措施；此前，他于周一与现代汽车集团执行董事长郑义善举行了会谈。电动汽车是否应纳入国内生产税收抵免，预计将成为议会围绕政府税收改革方案辩论的重点。据韩国汽车与移动出行协会和韩国汽车进口商及经销商协会的数据，1月至9月，中国制造的乘用电动汽车占韩国新车注册量的43.5%，同比提高8.4个百分点。注册量同比翻了一番以上，达到约112,400辆，而上年同期为51,500辆。与此同时，国内生产的乘用电动汽车占比下降6.2个百分点，降至48.7%，首次跌破50%这一关口。随着比亚迪去年进入韩国市场、极氪今年启动本地销售，中国汽车制造商正加大进军韩国市场的力度。周二，小鹏汽车还任命了新设韩国公司的首任负责人，前沃尔沃汽车韩国公司高管李万锡将于12月1日就任。据报道，奇瑞汽车和长城汽车也在准备于明年进入韩国市场。竞争压力加剧，要求将国内生产税收抵免政策延伸至电动汽车的呼声不断高涨。该计划是总统李在明竞选期间作出的关键承诺，将根据生产量，为在韩国国内制造和销售指定战略产品的企业提供税收抵免。8月公布的政府税收改革提案未将电动汽车纳入其中。在上月举行的议会审计会上，执政的韩国民主党和主要反对党国民力量党议员均敦促政府将税收抵免延伸至国内生产的电动汽车。国民力量党议员裴峻永在审计会上表示：“当我们的半导体行业陷入困境时，政府出手予以支持。我认为，对那些难以与其他国家竞争、需要类似提振的产业，政府也应提供支持，包括电动汽车税收抵免。”韩国民主党议员文镇硕也批评政府税收改革提案将电动汽车排除在外，称这似乎是在国内汽车制造商与具有价格优势的中国制造商竞争时，将它们逼到了‘悬崖边’。国民议会共提出了24项法案，建议将电动汽车及其他未来出行交通工具纳入税收抵免计划。政府8月公布税收改革方案后，又提交了7项相关法案。预计本月，国民议会税务小组委员会将审议这一问题，并可能于12月进行全体表决。周一，李明il与电动汽车、自动驾驶和零部件行业的高管会面，释放出政府将参与相关事务的信号，但没有承诺延长税收抵免政策。他说：“关于通过电动汽车生产税收抵免提供支持，政府将积极参与议会讨论，并就此事展开深入探讨。”他还表示，政府计划于本月公布一揽子加强电动汽车行业竞争力的措施，其中包括吸收行业意见，以及支持自动驾驶技术和关键零部件的研发

https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/opinion/202.title: Miscellany on the eve of a blue tsunami in the US
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/opinion/202.summary: 3 in the United States is midterm election day, indeed the most critical midterm election of my lifetime, as U.S. voters will pass judgment on President Donald Trump and the MAGA movement. Alas, my editor did me no favors by setting me a Nov. 4 (Korea time) publication date for my monthly column.
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/opinion/202.summary_zh: 美国3日是中期选举日，确实是我一生中最关键的 midterm选举，美国选民将对唐纳德·特朗普总统和“让美国再次伟大”（MAGA）运动作出评判。唉，我的编辑可没帮我什么忙，竟把我的月刊专栏发布日期定在韩国时间11月4日。
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/opinion/202.body: Nov. 3 in the United States is midterm election day, indeed the most critical midterm election of my lifetime, as U.S. voters will pass judgment on President Donald Trump and the MAGA movement. Alas, my editor did me no favors by setting me a Nov. 4 (Korea time) publication date for my monthly column. That is, here in Seoul, my deadline is during the election, which means I don’t have any results to analyze, yet it is too late for me to pontificate ahead of time on the election’s possible outcomes. Because they are predictable, event anniversaries and events scheduled in advance (like elections) are a columnist’s best friend (if you don’t believe me, look at my column history, in which I would estimate that nearly half concerns anniversaries (9/11, martial law, etc.) or dated events (summits, Olympics, elections). Deprived of my best friend this election season, I’ll have to make do with some prognostication and miscellaneous observations about U.S. politics. To start with predictions — which will make me publicly accountable! — the Democrats will get about 52 percent of the national vote and win between 230 and 235 seats in the House of Representatives. This will give Democratic leadership a comfortable margin for going after the Trump administration for its galactic-scale malfeasance and desecration of the U.S. Constitution. The Senate will be tighter: the Democrats will win a slim majority of 52 seats, in the process flipping North Carolina, Maine, Ohio, Texas and one of Alaska, Kansas or Iowa. The Republican Party will contest the election results, but only half-heartedly due to the obvious nature of the anti-MAGA directional shift in U.S. politics. The big question moving forward will be how Democrats use their congressional powers— notably budgetary, investigative hearings, impeachment — to rein in Trump’s imperial presidency and the grift and graft of MAGA. With a Democratic House of Representatives and/or Senate, Trump’s budgetary prospects will dim, and it will be interesting to see how the Democrats use their fiscal authority to limit funding of Homeland Security, Trump’s Washington vanity construction projects, and the Pentagon in general and the Iran War specifically. As for oversight and investigations, there are so many goons and crackpots deserving of congressional hearings and impeachment that the biggest challenge for Democrats will be choosing their targets and finding enough time in the day to go after them all. Beyond Trump himself, Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth is high on the list for impeachment, along with Health and Human Services Secretary Robert F. Kennedy Jr. and Attorney General Todd Blanche. Office of Management and Budget Director Russell Vought is also a solid candidate, since he has repurposed his position to focus on refusing to spend congressionally mandated outlays, thus undercutting the congressional “power of the purse.” Elon Musk may also come under the hammer. This list is just the tip of the iceberg. That said, Democratic leadership may well (mis)calculate that more limited political warfare — focusing only on selected officials — will make them appear less polarizing and thus prepare them better for the 2028 election. And of course even if all the Cabinet officials named above are impeached, none of them will be convicted in the Senate, which requires a supermajority. Nor will they likely face justice for corruption and other crimes — notably abuse of power — they may have committed, since Trump will likely issue mass pardons for his henchmen. I’ve long hated the presidential pardon power, which is a toxic holdover from the era of absolute monarchy. Trump has made it much worse, obviously, basically using it as a vehicle for corruption and abuse of power, but investing any head of state or government — especially in democracies — with the sole power to pardon is a travesty that should be abolished in favor of independent, neutral pardon commissions. Yet another impact of the election will be the coming battle for the future of the two parties. If Republicans are crushed and MAGA is electorally discredited, it is an open question as to what will emerge in its place, as Trump has destroyed the ostensible traditional sources of Republican spirit (liberal economics and trade, honest government, Christian values, etc.). Democrats will have their own ideological confrontation between a traditional mainstream wing and a progressive movement in ascendence. Traditional mainstream Democrats are fearful of playing hardball, breaking congressional decorum and norms, and generally doing anything politically interesting or effective; younger, progressive Democrats see an opportunity in the post-MAGA political wasteland to seize on initiatives (affordability measures, health care, immigration, Israel policy) and a political aesthetic (aggressive, brash) that they believe can found new norms favoring them. Traditional mainstream Democrats should not be underestimated — they have held power in the party for a reason — but the time of progressives may have arrived in the U.S. Trump will be rebuked on Nov. 3, but his superpower is his shamelessness; it is the key to his sociopathy. He will not go gently into that good night, but rather rage and try to tear the U.S. apart. Mason Richey is a professor of international politics at Hankuk University of Foreign Studies and president of the Korea International Studies Association
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/opinion/202.title_zh: 美国“蓝色浪潮”来临前夕的杂谈
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/opinion/202.body_zh: 美国11月3日是中期选举日，这确实是我一生中最关键的一次中期选举，因为美国选民将就唐纳德·特朗普总统和MAGA运动作出评判。遗憾的是，我的编辑没有帮我什么忙，把我每月专栏的发布日期定在韩国时间11月4日。也就是说，我在首尔的截稿时间正值选举期间，这意味着我届时没有任何选举结果可供分析，而要提前对选举可能结果大发议论，此刻又为时已晚。由于结果可以预测，事件周年日和预先安排的活动（如选举）最是专栏作家的好友（如果不信，不妨看看我的专栏往期文章；据我估计，其中近一半都涉及周年纪念日，如“9·11”、戒严等，或特定日期的活动，如峰会、奥运会和选举）。这个选举季失去了我的好友，我只好就美国政治作一些预测和杂论。先说预测——这会让我公开承担问责！——民主党将获得约52%的全国普选票，并在众议院赢得230至235个席位。这将使民主党领导层拥有从容优势，可以追究特朗普政府令人无法想象的不法行为及其对美国宪法的亵渎。参议院的竞争将更加胶着：民主党将以52席赢得微弱多数，同时拿下北卡罗来纳州、缅因州、俄亥俄州、得克萨斯州，以及阿拉斯加州、堪萨斯州或爱荷华州中的一个。共和党将对选举结果提出申诉，但由于美国政治中反MAGA的方向性转变十分明显，这种申诉也只会半心半意。接下来最大的问题是，民主党将如何运用其国会权力——尤其是预算权、调查听证和弹劾——来遏制特朗普的帝王式总统职位，以及MAGA的欺诈和贪腐。有了民主党控制的众议院和／或参议院，特朗普在预算方面的前景将黯淡；民主党将如何运用财政权力，限制对国土安全部、特朗普在华盛顿的自负建设以及五角大楼，尤其是伊朗战争的拨款，将值得观察。在监督和调查方面，有太多恶棍和怪人应当接受国会听证和弹劾，因此民主党面临的最大挑战将是选择目标，并找出足够的时间逐一追究。除了特朗普本人之外，国防部长皮特·赫格塞思也位列弹劾候选名单前列，卫生与公众服务部长罗伯特·F·肯尼迪 Jr.和司法部长托德·布兰奇同样在列。管理和预算办公室主任拉塞尔·沃特也是一名稳妥人选，因为他把自己的职位改作专注于拒绝执行国会批准的支出，从而削弱国会“钱袋子权”。埃隆·马斯克也可能受到严惩。这份名单还只是冰山一角。话虽如此，民主党领导层很可能会误判形势，认为只针对少数官员展开有限的政治战，更能让自己显得不那么两极化，从而为2028年选举作更充分准备。当然，即便上述所有内阁官员都遭到弹劾，他们也不会有一人在参议院被定罪，因为参议院定罪需要超级多数。他们也很可能不会因自己可能犯下的腐败和其他罪行——尤其是滥用权力——而受到制裁，因为特朗普很可能会对其爪牙实施大规模赦免。我长期以来一直痛恨总统赦免权，它是绝对君主制时代遗留下来的有毒产物。显然，特朗普把这种权力变得更糟，基本上把它当作腐败和滥用权力的工具；然而，把赦免这一权力仅仅交给任何国家元首或政府首脑——尤其是民主国家——本身就是一种荒谬，应由独立、中立的赦免委员会取代。此次选举的另一个影响，将是围绕两党未来的战斗。如果共和党惨败，MAGA在选举中名誉扫地，那么由什么取代其位置仍是悬而未决的问题，因为特朗普已经摧毁了共和党精神的传统来源（自由经济主义与贸易、诚实政府、基督教价值观等）。民主党内部也将围绕传统主流派与正在崛起的进步运动展开意识形态交锋。传统主流派民主党人担心采取强硬手段、破坏国会礼仪和规范，或做任何在政治上富有趣味或有效性的事情；年轻一代进步派民主党人则看到了后MAGA政治荒原中的机会，主张抓住相关倡议（生活成本措施、医疗保健、移民、以色列政策）以及一种政治风格（咄咄逼人、锋芒毕露），并认为这些可以据以建立有利于他们的新规范。传统主流派民主党人不应被低估——他们掌握党内权力是有原因的——但进步派的时代或许已经在美国到来。特朗普将在11月3日受到斥责，但他的“超能力”是其无耻，而这正是其反社会人格的关键。他不会温顺地走进那个良夜，而会暴怒并试图撕裂美国。梅森·里奇是韩国外国语大学国际政治学教授、韩国国际研究协会会长

https://www.yna.co.kr/view/akr2026110318.summary: (서울=연합뉴스) 권숙희 기자 = 장성민 중국 중앙군사위원회 부주석이 3일 안드레이 벨로우소프 러시아 국방장관과 만나 양국이 군사 협력을 강화 의지를 확인했다. 중국 관영 신화통신에 따르면 장 부주석은 이날 베이징 댜오위타이(조어대)에서 벨로우소프 장관과 만나 "시진핑 중국 국가주석과 블라디미르 푸틴 러시아 대통령의 전략적 지도 아래 중러 관계가 더욱 적극적인 역할을 수행하고 더욱 빨리 발전하는 새로운 단계에 진입했다"고 말했다. 그는 이어 "중국은 러시아와 함께 양국 정상 간 중요한 합의를 심도 있게 이행하고 전략적 소통을 지속적으로 강화하기를 바란다"며 "각국의 주권과 안보, 발전 이익을 더욱 효과적으로 수호하고 세계와 지역의 평화와 안정을 확고하게 유지해나가기를 바란다"고 밝혔다.
https://www.yna.co.kr/view/akr2026110318.summary_zh: （首尔=韩联社）权淑hee记者报道：中共中央军委副主席张成敏3日会见俄罗斯国防部长安德烈·别洛乌索夫，确认两国加强军事合作的意愿。据中国官方的新华社报道，张副主席当天在北京钓鱼台国宾馆会见别洛乌索夫部长，并表示：“在习近平主席和俄罗斯总统弗拉基米尔·普京的战略引领下，中俄关系正进入更加积极发挥作用、加快发展的新阶段。”他接着说：“中方愿同俄方一道，深入落实两国领导人之间的重要共识，持续加强战略沟通，并希望更加有效地维护各国主权、安全和发展利益，坚定不移地维护世界和地区的和平与稳定。”
https://www.yna.co.kr/view/akr2026110318.body: (서울=연합뉴스) 권숙희 기자 = 장성민 중국 중앙군사위원회 부주석이 3일 안드레이 벨로우소프 러시아 국방장관과 만나 양국이 군사 협력을 강화 의지를 확인했다. 중국 관영 신화통신에 따르면 장 부주석은 이날 베이징 댜오위타이(조어대)에서 벨로우소프 장관과 만나 "시진핑 중국 국가주석과 블라디미르 푸틴 러시아 대통령의 전략적 지도 아래 중러 관계가 더욱 적극적인 역할을 수행하고 더욱 빨리 발전하는 새로운 단계에 진입했다"고 말했다. 그는 이어 "중국은 러시아와 함께 양국 정상 간 중요한 합의를 심도 있게 이행하고 전략적 소통을 지속적으로 강화하기를 바란다"며 "각국의 주권과 안보, 발전 이익을 더욱 효과적으로 수호하고 세계와 지역의 평화와 안정을 확고하게 유지해나가기를 바란다"고 밝혔다. 신화통신에 따르면 벨로우소프 장관은 "러시아는 중국과 긴밀한 협력을 지속하고 전략적 협의를 강화하며 상호 지지를 확고히 하기를 바란다"고 말했다. 그는 또 "각 분야의 실질적 협력을 확대해 양국 및 군 관계 발전에서 더 많은 성과를 거두기를 바란다"고 덧붙였다. 이번 회담은 북한의 김성남 조선노동당 국제비서가 평양에서 출발해 베이징에 도착한 것으로 보인다는 교도통신의 보도가 나온 당일 이뤄져 주목된다. 또한 장 부주석이 '중국군 2인자'였던 장유샤 전 중앙군사위원회 부주석의 숙청이 확정된 직후 중국의 대(對)러시아 군사외교 전면에 나선 것으로도 풀이된다. 지난달 29일 폐막한 중국 공산당 중앙위원회 제5차 전체 회의(5중전회)에서는 장유샤 등 군 수뇌부를 포함한 고위직들의 당적 박탈이 공식 추인됐다. 중앙군사위원회의 공석이 채워지지 않는 상황에서 장 부주석은 중국 핵심 권력기구인 중앙정치국 위원으로도 선출돼 그의 정치적 입지가 강화됐다는 평가가 나왔다. 제보는 카카오톡 okjebo <저작권자(c) 연합뉴스, 무단 전재-재배포, AI 학습 및 활용 금지> 2026/11/03 20:09 송고 2026년11월03일 20시09분 송고

https://www.yna.co.kr/view/akr2026110318.body_zh: （首尔=韩联社）权淑姬记者 张成民：中国中央军委副主席于3日会见俄罗斯国防部长安德烈·别洛索夫，确认两国加强军事合作的意向。据中国官媒新华社报道，张副主席当天在北京钓鱼台（国宾馆）会见别洛索夫部长，并表示：“在习近平中国国家主席和弗拉基米尔·普京俄罗斯总统的战略引领下，中俄关系正进入一个新的阶段，将发挥更加积极的作用，迎来更加快速的发展。”他接着说：“希望中国与俄罗斯一道，深入落实两国领导人之间达成的各项重要共识，持续加强战略沟通。”他并表示：“希望更加有效地维护各国主权、安全和发展利益，坚定不移地维护世界和地区的和平与稳定。”据新华社报道，别洛索夫部长表示：“俄罗斯希望继续与中国保持密切合作，加强战略磋商，筑牢相互支持的基础。”他并补充说：“希望扩大各领域的务实合作，在两国关系和军事关系发展方面取得更多成果。”韩国教育通信社报道，朝鲜劳动党国际书记金成男从平壤出发并抵达北京。此次会谈于上述报道发布当天举行，因而受到关注。还有分析认为，在曾任“中国军队第二号人物”的原中央军委副主席张又侠遭查处的决定刚刚确定之际，张副主席全面展开对俄军事外交。上个月29日闭幕的中国共产党中央委员会第五次全体会议（二十届三中全会）正式追认了对张又侠等军方高级将领等党内高级官员的党籍处分。在中央军委出现空缺的情况下，张副主席还当选为中国核心权力机构中央政治局委员，因而有评价认为其政治地位得到加强。稿件通过KakaoTalk okjebo发送，版权归韩联社所有，禁止擅自转载、重新发布以及用于人工智能训练和利用。2026/11/03 20:09发布，2026年11月3日20时09分发布

https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/world/20261.body: HONG KONG — Investments by some companies from Asian economies in the United States are set to keep climbing amid a global supply-chain shake-up, Citi's international chief said, with spending expected to build in stages. "These companies have a lot of capacity to invest. I think that investments from the South Koreans, Taiwanese, and Japanese firms is likely to continue," said Ernesto Torres Cantu, who heads Citi's global business outside of North America, across more than 180 countries and jurisdictions. There is a lot of investment from global companies into the United States, with "double-digit growth in the inbound business into North America", Cantu told Reuters in Hong Kong. Citi and JPMorgan are financing Japanese projects tied to Tokyo's $550 billion U.S. investment pledge, while the White House recently unveiled the initial tranche of Seoul's $350 billion strategic package. Investments in U.S.-bound projects tend to compound over time, Cantu said, comparing a company's capital expenditure to a multi-stage manufacturing ramp-up, from buying land to building a factory and running daily operations. Large multinationals are showing resiliency amid geopolitical shocks, and are "adjusting exceptionally fast", Cantu said. While tariffs remain a factor, he said the Gulf War may be having a bigger impact, which is forcing many companies to rework their trade flows and supply chains. That requires the bank to keep executing payments, trade finance and transaction settlements for clients across changing market environments, he noted. While Citi's overall revenue rose by 8% in the third quarter of this year, its services business, which provides cash management, payments, trade finance as well as liquidity to corporations, financial institutions, and governments outperformed with a 15% increase in revenue. Cantu also expects flows through other cross-border corridors involving Asia to keep rising, with China and India at the centre of two of the most active ones. Trade between Britain and India is "growing significantly" after the tariff cuts, he said. Cantu expects the European Union's free trade agreement with India, which takes effect in 2027, to bring "a lot of business opportunities" too. "We see business expansion from China to the rest of the world continuing to grow," he said, adding that flows from China to the rest of the world have expanded "significantly," by more than 20% a year for the past two years. In China, Citi, which recently won approval to set up a wholly owned securities unit, plans to draw on its large corporate banking client base as it seeks more of the onshore securities business serving both local and international companies, according to Cantu
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/world/20261.title_zh: 花旗：日本、韩国和台湾企业在美投资将继续增长
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/world/20261.body_zh: 香港——花旗国际业务主管埃内斯托·托雷斯·坎图表示，在全球供应链重组之际，一些亚洲经济体的企业对美国的投资预计将持续攀升，相关支出将分阶段增加。负责花旗北美以外全球业务（覆盖180多个国家和司法管辖区）的坎图说：“这些企业拥有雄厚的投资能力。我认为，韩国、台湾和日本企业的投资很可能继续增长。”坎图在香港告诉路透社，全球企业在美国有大量投资，“流入北美的业务实现两位数增长”。花旗和摩根大通正在为日本项目提供融资，这些项目与东京承诺的5500亿美元对美投资计划有关；白宫最近公布了首尔3500亿美元战略投资方案的首批项目。坎图说，对美国市场的项目投资往往会随着时间推移产生复合效应。他把企业的资本支出比作多阶段制造业扩产：从购置土地、兴建工厂，到开展日常运营。坎图说，大型跨国公司在地缘政治冲击面前表现出韧性，并且“调整速度极快”。他表示，尽管关税仍是一个影响因素，但海湾战争可能带来的冲击更大，正迫使许多企业重新设计贸易流向和供应链。他指出，这要求银行在不断变化的市场环境中，继续为客户执行支付、贸易融资和交易结算。尽管花旗今年第三季度整体营收增长8%，但其服务业务表现更佳，营收增长15%；该业务为企业、金融机构和政府提供现金管理、支付、贸易融资及流动性服务。坎图还预计，其他涉及亚洲的跨境走廊资金流也将继续增加，其中中国和印度位于两条最活跃走廊的中心。他说，关税削减后，英国与印度之间的贸易“显著增长”。坎图预计，欧盟与印度将于2027年生效的自由贸易协定也将带来“大量商业机会”。他说：“我们看到中国向世界其他地区的业务扩张持续增长。”他补充称，中国向世界其他地区的资金流过去两年“显著增长”，增幅超过每年20%。据坎图介绍，花旗最近获准在中国设立全资证券业务部门，计划利用其庞大的企业银行客户基础，进一步发展面向本地和国际企业的在岸证券业务。

"We are preparing for it," Chung added. "It is one of the reasons why inter-Korean ties should improve." His remarks came during a discussion on improving animal quarantines and the risk of undomesticated animals, such as wild boars, crossing the border from the North and spreading diseases in the South. Chung cited North Korea's first ASF outbreak at a farm in Jagang Province in May 2019. According to South Korea's agriculture ministry, 77 pigs died and 22 were culled

https://www.lesahel.org/declaration-de-s.body: À l’occasion de la célébration du centenaire de la Ville de Niamey, l’ONG SANTED a rendu publique, le samedi 31 octobre 2026 à Niamey, une déclaration de soutien au Conseil National pour la Sauvegarde de la Patrie (CNSP). Cette déclaration est suivie de la remise de trophées aux meilleurs acteurs de la refondation. C’est le président de l’ONG SANTED, M. Ayouba Mahamadou, qui a procédé à la lecture de la déclaration. Dans cette déclaration, M. Ayouba Mahamadou a rappelé qu’à travers cette initiative, l’ONG SANTED entend contribuer à la valorisation du système éducatif nigérien, à l’encouragement du mérite scolaire et la formation d’une jeunesse responsable, instruite, tient à exprimé son soutien au Conseil national pour la sauvegarde de la patrie (CNSP) et à la dynamique de refondation engagée au Niger, ainsi qu’à l’alliance de l’AES. « Notre organisation souligne l’importance de la paix, de la cohésion sociale, de la solidarité nationale, de la responsabilité citoyenne et de la participation de toutes les composantes de la société au développement du pays », a-t-il ajouté. Par ailleurs, l’ONG SANTED réaffirme, au Président de la République, Chef de l’Etat, le Général d’Armée Abdourahamane Tiani. Enfin, elle appelle l’ensemble des Nigériens à préserver l’unité nationale, la cohésion sociale, le dialogue et la vigilance citoyenne afin de contribuer à la stabilité et à la paix dans Niger. En marge de cette cérémonie, le président de l’ONG SANTED, M. Ayouba Mahamadou, a décerné des trophées aux meilleurs promoteurs de la refondation. Les récipiendaires sont, entre autres, le ministre de la Santé et de l’Hygiène Publique, Médecin Colonel-major Garba Hakimi, le ministre de l’Urbanisme et de l’Habitat, Colonel-major, Abdoul-Kadri Amadou Daouada, le ministre de la Refondation et de la Promotion des Valeurs Sociales du Niger, M. Abdourahamane Oumarou, L’administrateur délégué de la ville de Niamey, Colonel Boubacar Soumana Garanké, le président de l’Observatoire National de la Communication (ONC) au Niger, M. Ibrahim Manzo Diallo, le directeur général de la Nigérienne des Eaux (NDE), l’Officier de la Police Aboubacar Abdou et le directeur de CAIMA, Dr Issifou Baoua. Pour les meilleures écoles professionnelles, il s’agit de l’IAT, l’IPSP, l’ESPA/MT, Lycée d’Excellence, l’ESSCOM, l’ISP, le CLAB, Issa Beri, le GEGA, l’ESM, l’EDC, l’EPI, l’ESIE, l’ESCEP, l’ENSP, le Collège Mariama, le Prytanée Militaire, l’IPHEC et le Lycée Koira
https://www.lesahel.org/declaration-de-s.title_zh: 支持声明：SANTED非政府组织再次重申拥护CNSP理念
https://www.lesahel.org/declaration-de-s.body_zh: 值此尼亚美市建市100周年庆典之际，非政府组织SANTED于2026年10月31日星期六在尼亚美发表声明，支持保卫祖国全国委员会（CNSP）。声明发布后，活动向推动国家重建工作的优秀人士授予奖杯。非政府组织SANTED主席阿尤巴·马哈马杜宣读了声明。他在声明中表示，SANTED希望通过这一行动，为提升尼日利亚教育制度、鼓励学业 Merit以及培养负责任且受过教育的青年作出贡献，并重申对保卫祖国全国委员会（CNSP）、尼日利亚开展的重建进程以及萨赫勒国家联盟的支持。他补充说：“本组织强调和平、社会凝聚力、民族团结、公民责任以及社会各组成部分参与国家发展的重要性。”此外，非政府组织SANTED再次向共和国总统、国家元首陆军上将阿卜杜拉赫曼·蒂亚尼表示支持。最后，它呼吁全体尼日利亚人维护民族团结、社会凝聚、对话和公民警觉，为尼日利亚的稳定与和平作出贡献。此次典礼期间，非政府组织SANTED主席阿尤巴·马哈马杜向优秀的重建工作推动者授予了奖杯。受奖者包括：卫生与公共卫生部长兼少校医生加尔巴·哈基米；城市规划和住房部长、上校阿卜杜勒-卡德里·阿马杜·达瓦达；尼日利亚重建与 promoting 社会价值观部长阿卜杜拉赫曼·奥马鲁；尼亚美市特别行政官、上校布巴卡尔·苏马纳·加朗凯；尼日利亚国家通讯观察站（ONC）主席易卜拉欣·曼佐·迪亚洛；尼日利亚水务公司（NDE）总经理阿布巴卡尔·阿卜杜；CAIMA主任易西福·巴瓦；以及在职业技术学校中表现优秀的IAT、IPSP、ESPA/MT、Lycée d’Excellence、ESSCOM、ISP、CLAB、Issa Beri、GEGA、ESM、EDC、EPI、ESIE、ESCEP、ENSP、Collège Mariama、Prytanée Militaire、IPHEC和Lycée Koira。

https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/lifestyle/p.body: Nine Korean picture books have been selected for the 2026 Korea Picture Book Award, with the government pledging export support to help winning authors reach readers worldwide. The Ministry of Culture, Sports and Tourism said Tuesday that nine works were chosen from 506 entries for the fourth annual awards, established in 2023 to promote the development of Korean picture books and expand their presence in overseas markets. The awards ceremony is scheduled for 2 p.m. Tuesday at Ferrum Tower in central Seoul. The two grand prizes went to Jeon Mi-hwa's "To the Fish in the Sea, to the Birds in the Sky, to the Animals in the Forest, and to Humans" in fiction and Kim Ji-won's "Raising Earthworms" in nonfiction. Each grand prize winner will receive 15 million won ($10,350) and the Culture Minister's Award. Baek's work and the book by Kim Bok-hee and Lee Myung-ae will each receive 10 million won, while the other four will each receive 7 million won. Yeo Seo-yoon received the newcomer award for "I Have a Song I Want to Sing for You," along with a 7 million won prize. The nine publishers behind the winning books will also receive 3 million won each. The ministry said winners will receive sample translations, promotional support, reviews and opportunities to showcase their books at major international events, including the Bologna Children's Book Fair. "Picture books are publishing content that combines writing, illustrations and design to deliver emotion and imagination to a wide range of readers, from children to adults," said Choi Seong-hee, the ministry's director general for content industry policy. https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/business/co.summary_zh: 插电式混合动力SUV兼顾舒适性与效率，并采取激进定价。体验BYD韩国海狮6 DM-i插电式混合动力SUV时，首先映入眼帘的是其座舱非凡的静谧性。在“海狮6 DM-i”这一名称中，DM-i代表“智能双模式”，即BYD自主研发的插电式混合动力电动汽车（PHEV）技术，为该车提供长续航能力。海狮6 DM-i并非为提供高性能电动汽车（EV）般的爆发式加速或灵敏操控而打造。
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/business/co.body: Plug-in hybrid SUV combines comfort and efficiency with aggressive pricing Starting BYD Korea's Sealion 6 DM-i plug-in hybrid SUV, the first thing that stood out was the exceptional quietness of its cabin. Driving through city streets and along highways, the SUV felt more like a mid-size luxury sedan than a family-oriented SUV. In the name Sealion 6 DM-i, DM-i stands for “Dual Mode-intelligent,” BYD’s proprietary plug-in hybrid electric vehicle (PHEV) technology, which powers the vehicle's long-range drive. Its cabin remained remarkably quiet at low speeds, when the electric motor does most of the work. Minor vibrations were barely noticeable, while the suspension softened the impact of speed bumps and uneven pavement. The result was a relaxed, composed ride that made long-distance driving less tiring. On a roughly 100-kilometer round trip between Seoul and Paju, Gyeonggi Province, the SUV proved remarkably easy on the driver, with minimal fatigue and impressive fuel efficiency that exceeded expectations. The Sealion 6 DM-i is not built to deliver the explosive acceleration or sharp handling of a performance electric vehicle (EV). Its appeal lies elsewhere: comfortable cruising, low running costs and the freedom to travel long distances without constantly searching for a charging station. BYD Korea claims a combined driving range approaching 1,000 kilometers, making efficiency one of the SUV's strongest selling points. Its 18.3-kilowatt-hour battery provides up to 70 kilometers of all-electric driving, enough to cover many daily commutes without using gasoline. When the battery charge falls below 25 percent, the gasoline engine can generate electricity to sustain operation. That flexibility addresses one of the biggest inconveniences of owning a pure EV. Drivers can charge at home and use electric power for shorter trips, while relying on the hybrid system for longer journeys. The powertrain pairs a 1.5-liter turbocharged gasoline engine, producing 130 horsepower and 220 newton-meters of torque, with an electric motor. The SUV accelerates from zero to 100 kilometers per hour in 8.3 seconds — a figure seen as fairly unremarkable — but this is still enough for customers who prioritize smooth, predictable progress over outright speed. Pricing, however, may prove its most disruptive feature. Starting at 37.5 million won ($27,000), the Sealion 6 DM-i undercuts many plug-in hybrid rivals, which typically occupy price brackets above 60 million won. BYD's vertically integrated manufacturing, spanning batteries to finished vehicles, helps explain its ability to offer the SUV at such an aggressive price. Seven airbags and driver-assistance features, including adaptive cruise control, lane-departure prevention and rear cross-traffic alerts, come standard. For buyers seeking the refinement of a quiet sedan, the flexibility of a hybrid and the range for extended road trips, the Sealion 6 DM-i makes a compelling case — particularly at a price that puts plug-in hybrid ownership within reach of a much wider market
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/business/co.title_zh: 【试驾】比亚迪海狮6 DM-i在静谧性和续航方面表现出色
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/business/co.body_zh: 比亚迪韩国海狮6 DM-i插电式混合动力SUV以激进定价兼顾舒适性与效率。试驾BYD Korea的Sealion 6 DM-i插电式混合动力SUV时，最先给人留下深刻印象的是其座舱出色的静谧性。行驶在城市街道和高速公路上，这款SUV给人的感觉更像是中型豪华轿车，而非家庭取向的SUV。在Sealion 6 DM-i这一名称中，DM-i代表“智能双模式”（Dual Mode-intelligent），这是比亚迪自主研发的插电式混合动力电动车（PHEV）技术，为车辆的长续航行驶提供动力。低速行驶时，大部分工作由电动机完成，车内始终保持非凡安静。轻微振动几乎难以察觉，悬架也缓和了减速带和不平整路面带来的冲击。由此带来的乘坐体验从容沉稳，让长途驾驶不易疲劳。在京畿道首尔与坡州市之间约100公里的往返行程中，这款SUV让驾驶者感到格外轻松，疲劳程度极低，燃油经济性也超出预期。Sealion 6 DM-i并非为追求性能电动车（EV）那种爆发式加速或灵敏操控而打造。它的吸引力另有其处：舒适的巡航体验、低使用成本，以及无需不断寻找充电站便可长途旅行的自由。BYD Korea声称，该车综合续航里程接近1,000公里，使效率成为这款SUV最突出的卖点之一。其18.3千瓦时电池可支持最长70公里的纯电行驶，足以应对许多日常通勤，全程无需使用汽油。当电池电量降至25 percent以下时，汽油发动机可持续发电以维持车辆运行。这种灵活性解决了拥有纯电动车所面临的最大不便之一。驾驶者可以居家充电，短途出行使用电力，而长途旅行则依靠混合动力系统。这套动力系统将最大输出130马力、220牛·米扭矩的1.5升涡轮增压汽油发动机与电动机结合。该SUV从零加速至每小时100公里需8.3秒——这一成绩只能算中规中矩——但对于更看重平顺、可预期加速表现而非极致速度的消费者而言，仍然足够。不过，定价可能成为其最具颠覆性的特点。Sealion 6 DM-i起售价为3,750万韩元（$27,000），低于许多插电式混合动力竞品，后者的售价通常处于6,000万韩元以上的区间。比亚迪从电池到整车的垂直一体化生产模式，有助于解释该SUV为何能够以如此激进的价格推出。7个安全气囊以及一系列驾驶辅助功能均为标配，包括自适应巡航控制、车道偏离防系统和车后方交叉交通警报。对于希望拥有安静轿车般的精致感、混合动力车的灵活性以及长途自驾续航能力的消费者而言，Sealion 6 DM-i具有很强的说服力，尤其是其价格让插电式混合动力汽车进入了更广泛的市场。

https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/southkorea/.body: Korea's consumer prices rose 2.8 percent in October from a year earlier, data showed Tuesday, as agricultural product prices continued to decline despite energy costs remaining elevated. According to data from the Ministry of Data and Statistics, consumer price growth eased to 2.8 percent in October from 2.9 percent in September and 3.1 percent in August. The data ministry said petroleum products' prices advanced 14.9 percent year-on-year in October, contributing 0.56 percentage point to the month's year-on-year inflation rate. It was the sharpest growth since 15.5 percent posted in July. In detail, diesel prices jumped 19.7 percent year-on-year in October, while gasoline prices increased a sharp 11.6 percent. The report showed that prices of industrial products overall rose 4.4 percent year-on-year in October due to higher global energy prices, with those of mobile phones and computers climbing 10.8 percent and 26.2 percent, respectively. Prices of imported automobiles, on the other hand, fell 3.9 percent over the same period. In addition, prices of agricultural, livestock and fishery products fell 1.7 percent over the same period, the findings showed, lowering the overall inflation rate by 0.14 percentage point. It marked the third consecutive month of an year-on-year decline. Prices of apples, napa cabbages and cucumbers fell 13.4 percent, 44.3 percent and 39.5 percent, respectively. Those of domestically produced beef, however, rose 9.1 percent. The service sector's prices moved up 2.7 percent, led by higher insurance premiums and overseas package tour prices, which increased 13.4 percent and 11.5 percent, respectively. Dining-out prices climbed 2.9 percent year-on-year in October, marking the highest increase since February, when they also increased 2.9 percent, and contributing 0.42 percentage point to the overall inflation rate. Prices of electricity, gas and water went up 0.4 percent over the same period. Core inflation, which excludes volatile food and energy prices, stood at 2.8 percent year-on-year in October
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/southkorea/.title_zh: 10月消费者价格上涨2.8%，连续第二个月维持在2%区间
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/southkorea/.body_zh: 韩国消费者价格10月同比上涨2.8%，数据周二显示，尽管能源成本仍处高位，但农产品价格继续下降。韩国数据统计部数据显示，消费者价格涨幅从9月的2.9%和8月的3.1%放缓至10月的2.8%。数据部表示，10月石油产品价格同比上涨14.9%，对当月同比通胀率贡献0.56个百分点。这是7月录得15.5%以来的最大涨幅。分项来看，10月柴油价格同比飙升19.7%，汽油价格也大幅上涨11.6%。报告显示，受全球能源价格上涨影响，10月工业品价格整体同比上涨4.4%，其中手机和计算机价格分别上涨10.8%和26.2%。另一方面，进口汽车价格同期下降3.9%。此外，结果显示，农产品、畜产品和渔业产品价格同期下降1.7%，使总体通胀率降低0.14个百分点。这标志着同比价格连续第三个月下降。苹果、大白菜和黄瓜价格分别下跌13.4%、44.3%和39.5%。不过，韩国国产牛肉价格上涨9.1%。服务部门价格上涨2.7%，主要受保险费和海外套餐旅游价格上涨推动，两者分别上涨13.4%和11.5%。10月外出就餐价格同比上涨2.9%，创下2月以来的最大涨幅，当时涨幅同样为2.9%，并对总体通胀率贡献0.42个百分点。电力、燃气和水价同期上涨0.4%。剔除波动较大的食品和能源价格的核心通胀率10月同比维持在2.8%

https://www.thehindu.com/news/national/m.body: Account subscription benefits alongside Premium Stories, Editorials, Opinions and more. Unlock these with Subscription Days after Maldives President Mohamed Muizzu visited Pakistan for a bilateral visit that yielded many agreements, the former Foreign Minister of Maldives, Abdulla Shahid, accused him of moving in an “anti- India ” direction. Also read | Defence pacts with India being amended, says Maldives Mr. Shahid, who is running for the leadership of the opposition Maldivian Democratic Party (MDP) ahead of the Presidential elections in 2028, alleged that Mr. Muizzu, who has had a cordial relationship with New Delhi for most of his tenure, would revive the “India Out” campaign of 2023. “The President [Mr. Muizzu] is trying to make India the issue again, because for him, he hasn’t been able to perform. He hasn’t been able to provide any development or deliver on any of the promises, and therefore, come next election again, he will try to create some narrative on hate,” Mr. Shahid, who was Foreign Minister during the tenure of the previous President Ibrahim Solih (2018-2023) and won a term as the President of the UN General Assembly with India’s support in 2021, told The Hindu in an interview here. The Maldives government spokesperson did not reply to a request for a response to Mr. Shahid’s comments. Mr. Shahid called for more transparency about 20 MoUs signed between the Maldives and Pakistan when President Muizzu went on a three-day visit to Islamabad from October 20 to 22, the first such visit by a Maldives President since 2015. After talks between Mr. Muizzu and Pakistan Prime Minister Shehbaz Sharif, the two sides announced agreements in a number of areas, including defence and maritime security, combating illicit trafficking and narcotics, information technology, cybersecurity and AI. They agreed to start direct flights between Male and Islamabad. In particular, Mr. Muizzu’s meeting with Pakistan’s Field Marshal and Army chief General Asim Munir had raised eyebrows in Delhi. Mr. Muizzu also called for the revival of SAARC, on hold since 2016 when India pulled out of the summit in Islamabad over cross-border terrorism. “We do not want Maldives to be drawn into disputes within our neighbours,” said Mr. Shahid, demanding that the Muizzu government make a statement in Parliament about the nature of the agreements signed with Pakistan. “We must aim for expanding our relationship with everyone who has goodwill to the Maldives, but it should not come at the cost of our own friends, our established relationships,” he added. When asked about Mr. Muizzu’s Pakistan visit on Friday, Ministry of External Affairs spokesperson Randhir Jaiswal said that the government kept a “close watch” on such developments and would “take whatever appropriate steps may be necessary”. In response to the comments on SAARC, Mr. Jaiswal said that it was “one country”, indicating Pakistan, that had “stalled” the functioning of SAARC, and India was keen to strengthen regional cooperation. Mr. Shahid’s comments to The Hindu indicate that ties with India may once again become an issue in the Maldivian elections. Mr. Solih lost the elections in 2023 due to the “India Out” campaign of the People’s National Congress (PNC), led by Mr. Muizzu, against what he alleged was undue Indian influence in the island chain, especially accusing the Solih government of allowing India to build military bases in infrastructure projects that India had constructed. Mr. Muizzu had also demanded that Indian Air Force personnel stationed at three locations in the Maldives, including Gan Island and Hanimadhoo Atoll, who operated aircraft that India had provided to the Maldives, be removed. While the beginning of Mr. Muizzu’s tenure saw tensions with the Modi government, and he chose to travel to Turkiye, the UAE, and China before visiting India, relations improved after India agreed to withdraw military personnel and replace them with civilian personnel instead. In June 2024, a month after the final batch of 89 Indian personnel had been withdrawn, Mr. Muizzu visited India to attend Prime Minister Narendra Modi’s swearing-in ceremony, and then returned in October 2024 for a bilateral visit, when India offered the Maldives several economic support measures, including a currency swap agreement to help Maldives avoid a debt failure. Mr. Shahid, who is standing for the primary elections in the MDP next year, is expected to face some tough competition from his other former colleagues in the cabinet as well, including former Economic Minister Fayyaz Ismail, who has the backing of the current MDP chief and former Maldivian President Mohamed Nasheed. Mr. Shahid and Mr. Solih were rivals of Mr. Nasheed during the previous government, but the opposition has come together within the MDP in order to fight against the ruling PNC. The run-up to the 2028 elections has heated up after the PNC confirmed Mr. Muizzu for the 2028 ticket, and the MDP held its party congress, endorsing the “Big Change” ticket for constitutional reform proposed by Mr. Ismail. Mr. Shahid is in India to attend the Words Beyond Borders International Literature Festival and is expected to affirm a campaign more friendly to India. When asked whether he would back an “India-first” campaign like Mr. Solih did, Mr. Shahid said his outreach would always be “first to India” on foreign policy, but not on domestic issues, which were sovereign. “India has always been our first responder. India has always been a generous partner in development. India is our immediate neighbour, who has been consistent in its relationship with the Maldives. So, our history proves the relationship right,” he said, referring to close ties between India and the Maldives since 1965, when the Maldives won its independence from British rule. https://www.thehindu.com/news/national/m.body_zh: 订阅账户还可享受《Premium Stories》、社论、观点等更多内容。 Maldives总统穆伊祖访问巴基斯坦进行双边访问并达成多项协议后，开启订阅专享内容《Subscription Days》。马尔代夫前外交部长阿卜杜拉·沙希德指责他正转向“反印度”方向。他还表示|Maldives正在修改与印度的防务协定。沙希德先生正在竞选马尔代夫民主党（MDP）领导权，并参加2028年总统选举，他声称穆伊祖总统任内大部分时间与新德里关系融洽，但将重拾2023年的“印度离开”运动。沙希德先生曾在易卜拉欣·索利赫总统任内担任外交部长（2018-2023年），并在印度支持下于2021年赢得联合国大会主席任期。他在接受《The Hindu》采访时说：“总统［穆伊祖］试图再次让印度成为议题，因为对他而言，他没有取得成绩。他没有带来任何发展，也没有兑现任何承诺，因此下次选举再次到来时，他会试图制造某种仇恨叙事。”马尔代夫政府发言人没有回应置评请求。10月20日至22日，穆伊祖总统对伊斯兰堡进行为期三天的访问，这是自2015年以来马尔代夫总统首次进行此类访问。访问期间，马尔代夫与巴基斯坦签署了20份谅解备忘录。沙希德呼吁提高这些协议的透明度。穆伊祖与巴基斯坦总理夏巴兹·谢里夫会谈后，双方宣布在防务、海上安全、打击非法走私和毒品、信息技术、网络安全和人工智能等多个领域达成协议，并同意开通马累与伊斯兰堡之间的直航。尤其是穆伊祖与巴基斯坦陆军元帅兼陆军参谋长阿西姆·穆尼尔会面，引发新德里的关注。穆伊祖还呼吁恢复南亚区域合作联盟（SAARC）。该联盟自2016年以来一直处于暂停状态，当时印度因跨境恐怖主义问题退出在伊斯兰堡举行的峰会。沙希德说：“我们不希望马尔代夫被卷入邻国之间的争端。”他要求穆伊祖政府就与巴基斯坦签署协议的性质在议会发表声明。他补充说：“我们必须努力与所有对马尔代夫抱有善意的人扩大关系，但这不应以损害我们的朋友和我们既有关系为代价。”当被问及穆伊祖周五对巴基斯坦的访问时，外交部发言人兰德希尔·贾伊斯瓦尔表示，政府对此类动态保持“密切观察”，并将“采取任何必要的适当措施”。谈及有关SAARC的言论，贾伊斯瓦尔先生说，是“一个国家”，即巴基斯坦，导致SAARC的运作“陷入停滞”，而印度希望加强区域合作。沙希德先生对《The Hindu》发表的言论表明，与印度的关系可能再次成为马尔代夫选举中的议题。2023年，索利赫在穆伊祖领导的国民大会党（PNC）发起“印度离开”运动后输掉选举。该党指责印度对马尔代夫群岛施加不当影响，尤其指责索利赫政府允许印度在印度出资建设的基础设施项目中修建军事基地。穆伊祖还要求撤走驻扎在马尔代夫三个地点的印度空军人员，包括甘岛和哈尼马杜环礁；这些人员使用印度提供给马尔代夫的飞机。穆伊祖任期初期与莫迪政府关系紧张，他先访问了土耳其、阿联酋和中国，之后才访问印度。但在印度同意撤走军事人员并以文职人员取代后，双边关系有所改善。2024年6月，在最后一批89名印度人员撤离一个月后，穆伊祖访问印度，出席总理纳伦德拉·莫迪的就职宣誓仪式，并于2024年10月再次进行双边访问。印度当时向马尔代夫提供了多项经济支持措施，包括一项货币互换协议，以帮助马尔代夫避免发生债务违约。沙希德先生计划明年参加MDP初选，预计将受到内阁其他前同僚的激烈竞争，其中包括前经济部长法亚兹·伊斯梅尔，后者得到现任MDP党首、马尔代夫前总统穆罕默德·纳希德的支持。上一届政府时期，沙希德先生与索利赫先生都曾是纳希德先生的竞争对手，但反对派已在MDP内部联合起来，共同对抗执政的PNC。PNC确认穆伊祖参加2028年选举后，竞选活动逐渐升温；MDP召开党代会， 支持伊斯梅尔提出的宪法改革方案及“大变革”竞选主张。沙希德先生目前身在印度，参加Words Beyond Borders国际文学节，预计将公开支持一项对印度更友好的竞选活动。当被问及是否会像索利赫先生那样支持“印度优先”运动时，沙希德先生说，在外交政策上，他的对外联络将始终“首先面向印度”，但在国内问题上不会如此，因为国内事务属于主权范畴。他说：“印度始终是我们的第一响应者。印度始终是发展领域慷慨的伙伴。印度是我们的近邻，与马尔代夫保持着一贯的关系。因此，我们的历史证明双方的关系是正确的。”他指的是，自1965年马尔代夫摆脱英国统治获得独立以来，印度与马尔代夫一直保持密切关系。评论必须以英文提交，并且使用完整句子。评论不得含有辱骂性内容或针对个人的攻击。请遵守我们的社区评论准则。我们已迁移至新的评论平台。如果你已经是《The https://leadership.ng/2027-sokoto-govt-s.body: In Sokoto, the state government ordered the indefinite closure of the ADC campaign office less than 48 hours before the party’s presidential campaign flag-off scheduled for November 4. The Commissioner for Lands and Housing, Barrister Nasir Aliyu Dantsoho, announced the sealing during an official visit to the premises on Monday, November 2, 2026, according to an update posted by Comr. Abdulazeez Adamu. The development is the latest in a face-off between the ADC and the Sokoto State Government that has dominated the state’s political space over the past week. The dispute began when the ADC notified the state government of its decision to hold its presidential campaign flag-off in Sokoto, the seat of the Caliphate. The event was initially scheduled for October 31. In its response, the state government expressed disagreement with the proposed event, a position the ADC described as troubling and a threat to political pluralism. The party subsequently rescheduled the flag-off to Wednesday, November 4. At a press conference at the party’s headquarters in Sokoto on Sunday, November 1, the Director-General of the ADC Governorship Campaign and state chairman, Alhaji Bello Muhammad Goronyo, alleged a pattern of attacks and intimidation against the party and its supporters. Goronyo said ADC women supporters were attacked during a peaceful solidarity march on Wednesday, October 28, with their phones allegedly snatched, clothes torn and vehicles vandalised. He also alleged that the party’s state campaign office was attacked the same day, with windows and doors smashed, property looted and three motorcycles destroyed. He added that the party’s billboards, posters and other campaign materials were destroyed across the state. According to him, the ADC governorship candidate was attacked on Friday, October 30, while gunshots were fired at the airport as party leaders arrived. Goronyo further alleged that hotels which had confirmed reservations for ADC delegates cancelled their bookings under pressure from the state government, while government-owned hotels claimed they were fully booked. He linked the alleged attacks to the release from prison of two men associated with political thuggery, reportedly by the state government. He identified one Aliyu K.C. and his associates as being connected with the incidents. The ADC chairman also alleged that personnel of the Sokoto Community Guard Corps and Sokoto Marshals had been directed to prevent the party’s supporters from entering the state ahead of the flag-off. The closure of the campaign office marked another escalation in the dispute. The facility, a green-and-orange building in Sokoto metropolis, houses the party’s state campaign council. As of press time, the state government had not issued an official explanation for the sealing. However, sources in the Ministry of Lands said it might be connected to alleged violations involving land title and building permits. Despite the closure, the ADC has vowed to proceed with its November 4 presidential campaign flag-off. “No threat, intimidation or unlawful obstruction will deprive us of our constitutional right to organise political activities,” Goronyo said. He called on the Nigeria Police Force, the Department of State Services (DSS) and the Federal Government to investigate the alleged attacks and provide protection for the party’s candidates and supporters. In neighbouring Zamfara State, pandemonium broke out on Monday during the APC primary for the Zamfara North Senatorial District in Kaura Namoda, as the local government chairman, Hon. Mannir Haidara, narrowly escaped an attack by angry youths. LEADERSHIP gathered that the incident occurred at the primary election venue while Haidara was addressing delegates and urging them to vote for the incumbent senator representing the district, Senator Sahabi Ya’u Kaura. The youths, reportedly supporters of his challenger, Senator Tijjani Yahaya Kaura, rejected the appeal and insisted on backing their preferred candidate. Eyewitnesses said the situation degenerated as the youths shouted at the council chairman and attempted to attack him over alleged bias and imposition. Police officers and other security operatives at the venue intervened and rescued Haidara from the crowd. The primary is a contest between Senator Sahabi Ya’u and Senator Tijjani Yahaya Kaura for the APC ticket to represent Zamfara North, which comprises Kaura Namoda, Birnin Magaji, Shinkafi and Zurmi local government areas. Calm had been restored at the venue as of the time of filing this report, although security operatives maintained a heavy presence. https://leadership.ng/2027-sokoto-govt-s.body_zh: 在索科托，州政府下令无限期关闭人民民主大会党（ADC）竞选办公室，而距离该党原定于11月4日举行的总统竞选启动仪式已不足48小时。据Comr. Abdulazeez Adamu发布的消息，土地与住房事务专员Nasir Aliyu Dantsoho律师于2026年11月2日星期一正式视察该处场所期间宣布查封办公室。这是过去一周主导该州政治局势的ADC与索科托州政府对峙事件中的最新进展。争端始于ADC通知州政府，其决定在哈里发国教发源地索科托举行总统竞选启动仪式。该活动最初定于10月31日举行。州政府回应称不同意举办这项活动，ADC则称这一立场令人不安，并威胁政治多元。随后，该党将启动仪式改至11月4日星期三。11月1日星期日，在位于索科托的党总部举行的新闻发布会上，ADC州长竞选主任兼州主席Alhaji Bello Muhammad Goronyo指控该党及其支持者持续遭到袭击和恐吓。Goronyo称，10月28日星期三，ADC女性支持者在一场和平声援游行中遭到袭击，据称她们的手机被抢、衣服被撕毁，车辆也遭到破坏。他还称，同一天，该党州竞选办公室遭到袭击，窗户和门被砸，财物被抢，3辆摩托车被毁。他补充说，该党在各地的广告牌、海报和其他竞选 materials均被毁。据他介绍，10月30日星期五，ADC州长候选人遭到袭击；该党领导人抵达机场时，现场还响起了枪声。Goronyo进一步指控，已确认接待ADC代表入住的酒店在州政府施压下取消了预订，而政府所属酒店则声称已客满。他将这些所谓的袭击与据称由州政府释放的两名政治打手有关，并指出其中一人为Aliyu K.C.及其同伙与这些事件有关。ADC主席还称，索科托社区卫队和索科托法警人员已奉命阻止该党支持者在启动仪式前进入该州。竞选办公室关闭标志着争端进一步升级。该设施是一栋位于索科托市区、涂有绿色和橙色的大楼，内设该党州竞选委员会。截至发稿时，州政府尚未就查封一事发布正式解释。不过，土地部消息人士称，此事可能与土地所有权和建筑许可方面的违规行为有关。尽管办公室已被关闭，ADC仍誓言继续举行11月4日的总统竞选启动仪式。Goronyo说：“任何威胁、恐吓或非法阻碍，都不能剥夺我们组织政治活动的宪法权利。”他呼吁尼日利亚警察部队、国家安全局（DSS）和联邦政府调查这些所谓的袭击，并为该党候选人和支持者提供保护。在邻近的赞法拉州，星期一在考拉纳莫达举行的全非人民大会党（APC）赞法拉北区参议员初选中发生混乱。当时，地方政府主席Hon. Mannir Haidara在向代表发表讲话、敦促他们投票支持代表该区的现任参议员Sahabi Ya’u Kaura时，险些遭到愤怒青年的袭击。据《LEADERSHIP》获得的报道，事发时Haidara正在初选投票点讲话。报道称，这些青年是其所挑战的参议员Tijjani Yahaya Kaura的支持者。他们拒绝了Haidara的呼吁，坚持支持自己属意的候选人。目击者称，局势不断恶化，这些青年对地方政府主席大喊大叫，并因所谓偏袒和强行施压而试图袭击他。现场的警察和其他安全人员介入，将Haidara从人群中救出。此次初选是Sahabi Ya’u与Tijjani Yahaya Kaura争夺APC代表赞法拉北区的党内候选人资格。该区包括考拉纳莫达、比尔宁马加吉、欣卡菲和祖尔米4个地方政府。截至本报道提交时，现场局势已恢复平静，但安全人员仍大量驻守。由于Haidara的电话已关机，未能联系其本人置评。掌握第一手动态，实时获取突发新闻和独家报道，直接发送到你的手机。不要满足于过时新闻。加入LEADERSHIP NEWS的WhatsApp，享全天候更新 →

https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/economy/202.body: Korean stocks traded more than 2 percent lower late Tuesday morning, led by tech losses amid lingering woes about the excessive pace of artificial intelligence (AI) spending. Opening 2.46 percent lower, the benchmark Korea Composite Stock Price Index (KOSPI) fell 145.02 points, or 2.48 percent, to 5,714.06 as of 11:20 a.m. Overnight on Wall Street, the tech-heavy Nasdaq Composite and the S&P 500 closed 1.07 percent and 0.51 percent lower, respectively, ahead of the U.S. midterm elections slated for Tuesday. Investor sentiment was dampened by concerns that massive spending on AI infrastructure is undermining tech firms' near-term profitability. Market bellwether Samsung Electronics sank 2.95 percent, and its chipmaking rival SK hynix slid 3.8 percent. Hanmi Semiconductor, a leading chip equipment maker, fell 4.17 percent, and SK Square, the parent of SK hynix, tumbled 4 percent. Steel giant POSCO Holdings slumped 5.3 percent, and leading oil refinery SK Innovation plunged 7.76 percent. The Korean won was trading at 1,341 won against the U.S. dollar as of 11:20 a.m., up 3.4 won from the previous session's close

https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/business/co.body: WASHINGTON — The U.S. International Trade Commission (USITC) has formally terminated a patent infringement investigation involving Samsung Electronics Co. and several major American technology companies following a settlement between the Korean chipmaker and U.S. chip firm Netlist Inc., according to a federal notice published Monday. The investigation centered on certain dynamic random access memory (DRAM) devices, products containing them and related components, according to the USITC notice published in the U.S. Federal Register. The case was launched in July following a complaint from Netlist, which alleged that certain memory products infringed its patents. Other companies named as respondents in the case included Google, Nvidia Corp., Broadcom Inc. and Super Micro Computer Inc. The notice said Netlist and Samsung, including its two U.S. subsidiaries, jointly requested the termination of the investigation on Aug. 18 based on a settlement agreement between the companies. Netlist develops advanced memory and storage technologies, including server memory and HBM solutions for AI computing. In 2021, Netlist sued Samsung, alleging that the Korean tech giant's memory products used in cloud computing servers, along with other data technologies, infringed its patents. https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/world/20261.body: SEATTLE — With the Trump administration stepping up its crackdown on noncitizen voting ahead of Tuesday's midterm elections, some Korean green card holders are worried that receiving election ballots they never requested could land them in immigration trouble. Across online forums and social media discussions, including Korean-American communities, green card holders have shared accounts of receiving ballots or voter-registration materials despite not being U.S. citizens. "I'm a green card holder, but ballots come to my house every time," one user wrote. Another said she and her husband, both green card holders, had received jury summonses, and that her husband had also received election-related mail. The accounts have prompted discussions about how noncitizens end up receiving election materials and whether mistakes involving voter registration could jeopardize their green cards or future citizenship applications. Some users expressed concern that they may have been registered without realizing it, while others questioned how permanent residents could be unaware that only U.S. citizens are allowed to vote. The concerns come as federal authorities pursue criminal cases against green card holders accused of voting illegally. On Oct. 19, the Justice Department announced charges against 28 permanent residents in California for offenses including fraudulent voter registration, unlawful voting and false statements during naturalization proceedings. Among them was Jennifer Jung, a 31-year-old Korean woman with Canadian citizenship living in San Diego, according to Korean-language broadcaster Radio Korea. Federal prosecutors allege that Jung falsely claimed to be a U.S. citizen when registering to vote, cast a ballot in the November 2024 election and later made false statements about her voting history during a naturalization interview. The cases have also raised questions about California's voter registration system, which automatically registers eligible applicants during Department of Motor Vehicles transactions unless they opt out. State officials say applicants who indicate they are ineligible are not registered through the system. However, California has previously acknowledged cases of people being registered erroneously. Receiving election-related mail does not necessarily mean someone is registered to vote, and simply receiving a ballot is not a voting offense. But knowingly making a false claim of U.S. citizenship or voting illegally can have serious immigration consequences. The consequences depend on the circumstances, including how the person became registered, whether a ballot was cast and whether any false claim of citizenship was made. California allows people who were registered by mistake to cancel their registration through their county elections office, although cancellation does not necessarily eliminate potential immigration consequences from past violations
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/world/20261.title_zh: 美国严打投票问题令持有韩国绿卡的选民担心收到非预期选票
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/world/20261.body_zh: 西雅图——随着特朗普政府加强打击非公民投票，并赶在周二中期选举前展开行动，一些持有韩国绿卡的人士担心，收到自己从未申请过的选票可能会给他们带来移民方面的麻烦。在包括韩裔美国人社群在内的网络论坛和社交媒体讨论中，持有绿卡的人士讲述了自己尽管并非美国公民，却收到选票或选民登记材料的经历。一名用户写道：“我是绿卡持有者，但每次都有选票寄到我家。”另一名用户表示，她和丈夫都持有绿卡，却收到了陪审团传票，她丈夫还收到了与选举有关的邮件。这些经历引发了讨论：非公民为何会收到选举材料，以及选民登记方面的失误是否可能危及他们的绿卡或未来的公民身份申请。一些用户担心自己可能在不知情的情况下被登记为选民，另一些人则质疑，永久居民怎么会不知道只有美国公民才有权投票。联邦当局目前正对被控非法投票的绿卡持有者追究刑事责任。10月19日，美国司法部宣布对加利福尼亚州的28名永久 residents 提出指控，罪名包括欺诈性选民登记、非法投票以及在入籍程序中作虚假陈述。据韩语广播机构Korea Radio报道，被指控者中包括31岁的韩国裔女性Jennifer Jung，她拥有加拿大国籍，居住在圣迭戈。联邦检察官称，Jung在登记投票时虚假声称自己是美国公民，在2024年11月选举中投了票，并在之后的入籍面谈中就自己的投票记录作出虚假陈述。这些案件还引发了人们对加利福尼亚州选民登记系统的疑问。该系统在机动车管理局办理业务时会自动登记符合条件的申请人，除非申请人选择退出。州官员表示，在系统中表明自己不符合资格的申请人不会被登记。不过，加利福尼亚州此前曾承认发生过一些人被错误登记的个案。收到与选举有关的邮件并不一定意味着某人已登记为选民，而仅仅收到选票也不构成投票违法行为。但明知而虚假声称拥有美国国籍或非法投票，可能造成严重的移民后果。具体后果取决于多种情况，包括此人如何被登记、是否实际投票，以及是否曾虚假声称拥有美国国籍。加利福尼亚州允许被错误登记的人通过所在县的选举办公室取消登记，但取消登记并不一定能消除过去违法行为可能产生的移民后果……

https://www.thisdaylive.com/2026/11/03/2.body_zh:
埃格巴诚信组织（EIG）谴责独立国家选举委员会（INEC）选择性执法。10月29日星期四委员会召开会议后，该组织指责INEC在执法过程中标准不一。

该组织表示，INEC执行了最高法院关于州长候选人所属政党党员名册提交期限的裁决，却拒绝在奥贡州国民议会候选人案中采取同样措施。它补充道：“最高法院于2026年9月24日在INEC诉ZLP一案（SC/CV/495/2026）中裁定，《2026年选举法》第77(5)(6)(7)条具有强制性。”

该组织坚持认为，INEC在10月29日采取了选择性执法。它表示：“对于州长候选人：INEC严格执行规定——Isa Pantami（贡贝州PDP）——有条件获准参选；Abdulsalam Gwarzo（卡诺州NDC）——有条件获准参选；Ladi Adebutu（奥贡州PDP州长候选人）——被拒。

“INEC称‘奥贡州PDP候选人未能通过审核。’对于国民议会候选人，INEC拒绝执行相同规定。PDP在奥贡州提交的名册存在缺陷，并因此导致Adebutu被取消资格，但该名册却被用来保留Iyabo Obasanjo参议员（奥贡州中部PDP）及其他国民议会候选人的资格。这属于非法歧视。

“第77条并未区分州长和参议员。名册只有一份。如果该名册对州长候选人无效，那么对参议员候选人同样无效。”

https://www.thisdaylive.com/2026/11/03/b.body: • Says proposal allocates 37 seats each to Senate, House of Representatives •Three additional seats proposed for women in each state assembly The National Assembly has proposed the creation of 74 additional seats exclusively reserved for women in Senate and House of Representatives as part of ongoing efforts to address gender imbalance in Nigeria’s political representation. The proposal, which also provides for three additional seats for women in each of the 36 state Houses of Assembly, is designed to expand women’s participation in legislative decision-making without displacing existing constituencies or elected lawmakers. Senate Leader, Senator Opeyemi Bamidele, disclosed the proposal on Monday while speaking at the 2026 Law Week organised by the International Federation of Women Lawyers (FIDA), Ekiti State Chapter. Bamidele, who is also Vice Chairman of Senate Committee on the Review of the 1999 Constitution, said the proposal formed part of the ongoing constitution amendment exercise being undertaken by the 10th National Assembly. He explained that the proposed arrangement would provide 37 additional seats in Senate and another 37 in House of Representatives, ensuring that every state of the federation and the Federal Capital Territory would have one additional representative in each chamber. According to him, the proposed special seats are intended to provide women with greater access to elective positions and decision-making platforms, particularly against the background of their historically low representation in Nigeria’s legislative institutions. Bamidele disclosed that the Constitution Review Committee had also recommended three additional seats for women in each State House of Assembly. He stressed that the proposed seats would be exclusively reserved for women and would not affect existing electoral constituencies or displace any serving lawmaker. The arrangement, he added, would operate for 16 years, covering four electoral cycles, after which it would undergo a comprehensive review. Bamidele explained, “This arrangement is proposed to run for a period of 16 years, four electoral cycles, before a comprehensive review. This is a sunset clause designed to ensure sustainability and to allow for the organic development of a more inclusive political culture.” The senate leader expressed confidence that the proposal would secure the necessary legislative backing, particularly from the state Houses of Assembly, whose approval is constitutionally required to complete the amendment process. “We are actively and strategically engaging with the State Houses of Assembly, as their concurrence is a constitutional sine qua non for bringing this reform to fruition,” he said. Bamidele described the proposed special seats as a fundamental democratic reform rather than a partisan political initiative, stating that a representative democracy cannot function effectively while excluding a substantial proportion of the population from legislative decision-making. He said the initiative followed extensive consultations and consensus-building, adding that the National Assembly deliberately commenced the constitutional review process early to allow sufficient time for scrutiny and wider stakeholder participation. He said the 10th National Assembly’s commitment to the initiative had also been strengthened by advocacy from prominent figures, including the First Lady, Senator Oluremi Tinubu. Bamidele stated that the under-representation of women in political institutions required deliberate legislative intervention. He said the proposed reform was intended to strengthen democratic inclusion and ensure that women’s interests received adequate attention in the formulation of public policies. He stated, “The special seat initiative is not a partisan endeavour. It is a historic imperative. “The rationale is anchored on a simple, yet profound, principle of constitutional law: the foundational precept of representative democracy. The senate leader also highlighted the need for legislative interventions to protect women, children, and other vulnerable groups, particularly in the areas of healthcare, education, and social protection. He maintained that government had a responsibility to provide adequate safeguards where prevailing market conditions, cultural practices, and institutional weaknesses failed to protect vulnerable citizens. On access to justice, Bamidele insisted that the country’s legal framework must respond effectively to emerging threats against women and children, stressing that justice should not remain a constitutional promise or a provision in the statute books. “Rather, it must be accessible, affordable, timely, and effective,” he said. Bamidele added, “A woman who suffers domestic violence must be able to seek protection without intimidation or social condemnation. A child who experiences abuse must be heard, protected from further harm, and provided with appropriate support. FIDA, Ekiti State Chapter, chaired by Mrs. Ayobami Olowoyo-Richards, organised the Law Week with the theme, “Justice in a Changing World: Responding to New Challenges Affecting Women and Children.” The event was attended by Chairman of House of Representatives Committee on Information and National Orientation, Hon. Steve Fatoba; Speaker of Ekiti State House of Assembly, Rt. Hon. Adeoye Aribasoye; and other dignitaries. https://www.thisdaylive.com/2026/11/03/b.title_zh: 巴米德莱：国民议会提议为女性设立74个特别议席
https://www.thisdaylive.com/2026/11/03/b.body_zh:
• 提议在参议院和众议院各增设37个席位 • 提议在每个州议会为女性增设3个席位

尼日利亚国民议会提议在参议院和众议院增设74个专门保留给女性的席位，以作为解决尼日利亚政治代表中性别失衡问题持续努力的一部分。该提案还规定在尼日利亚36个州议会各为女性增设3个席位，旨在扩大女性对立法决策的参与，同时不取消现有选区，也不取代现任议员。

参议院领袖奥佩耶米·巴米德莱参议员周一在由国际女律师联合会（FIDA）埃基蒂州分会组织的2026年法律周活动上公布了这项提案。巴米德莱同时担任参议院1999年宪法审查委员会副主席。他说，这项提案是第十届国民议会正在进行的宪法修订工作的一部分。他解释说，拟议安排将在参议院增加37个席位，在众议院再增加37个席位，确保联邦每个州及联邦首都领地在两院中各增加一名代表。

据他介绍，拟议中的专门席位旨在让女性有更多机会担任民选职位和参与决策平台，尤其是考虑到女性在尼日利亚立法机构中的代表比例历来较低。巴米德莱透露，宪法审查委员会还建议在每个州议会为女性增加3个席位。他强调，拟议席位将专门保留给女性，不会影响现有选区，也不会取代任何在任议员。

他还说，该安排将实施16年，涵盖4个选举周期，之后将进行全面审查。巴米德莱解释道：“这项安排拟实施16年，即4个选举周期，之后再进行全面审查。这是一项日落条款，旨在确保制度的可持续性，并为更具包容性的政治文化实现自然发展留出空间。”

这位参议院领袖表示有信心，该提案将获得必要的立法支持，尤其是各州议会的支持，因为根据宪法，完成修宪程序必须取得州议会的同意。他说：“我们正在积极且有策略地与各州议会沟通，因为取得它们的同意是推动这项改革实现的宪法必要条件。”

巴米德莱将拟议的专门席位描述为一项根本性的民主改革，而非党派政治行动。他表示，如果将相当大比例的人口排除在立法决策之外，代表制民主就无法有效运作。他说，这项倡议是在广泛征询意见和凝聚共识后提出的；第十届国民议会特意提前启动宪法审查程序，以便留出充足时间进行审查并扩大利益相关方的参与。他还表示，第一夫人奥卢雷米·蒂努布参议员等知名人士的倡导，也加强了第十届国民议会对这项倡议的投入。

巴米德莱指出，女性在政治机构中代表不足，需要立法机关有意采取干预措施。他说，拟议改革旨在加强民主包容性，确保女性利益在公共政策制定中得到充分关注。他表示：“专门席位倡议不是党派行为，而是历史的必然要求。其依据植根于宪法-law的一项简单却深刻的原则：代表制民主的基本原则。”

这位参议院领袖还强调，需要通过立法干预保护女性、儿童及其他弱势群体，尤其是在医疗保健、教育和社会保护等领域。他坚持认为，当 prevailing 市场状况、文化习俗和制度缺陷未能保护弱势公民时，政府有责任提供充分保障。

在司法可及性方面，巴米德莱坚称，该国法律框架必须有效应对针对女性和儿童的新兴威胁，强调司法不应仅仅停留在宪法承诺或法条之中。他说：“相反，司法必须易于获得、价格可负担、及时且有效。”巴米德莱补充道：“遭受家庭暴力的女性必须能够寻求保护，而不受恐吓或社会谴责。遭受虐待的儿童必须有机会表达意见，受到保护以免进一步受到伤害，并获得适当支持。”

由阿约巴米·奥洛约-理查兹夫人担任主席的FIDA埃基蒂州分会组织了本届法律周活动，主题为“变化世界中的司法：应对影响女性和儿童的新挑战”。众议院信息与国家导向委员会主席史蒂夫·法托巴阁下、埃基蒂州议会议长阿德奥耶·阿里巴索耶阁下及其他贵宾出席了活动。

https://www.vanguardngr.com/2026/11/curr.summary: Data from the Central Bank of Nigeria, CBN, Money and Credit Statistics, also showed that currency outside banks increased by 10.3 per cent year-on-year from N4.465 trillion in September 2025 to N4.923 trillion in September 2026. A breakdown of the data showed that currency outside banks increased by 66.2 per cent from N2.416 trillion in September 2023 to N4.016 trillion in September 2024.
https://www.vanguardngr.com/2026/11/curr.summary_zh: 尼日利亚中央银行（CBN）《货币与信贷统计》数据显示，银行体系外流通的货币同比增加10.3%，从2025年9月的4.465万亿奈拉增至2026年9月的4.923万亿奈拉。数据细分显示，银行体系外流通的货币从2023年9月的2.416万亿奈拉增至2024年9月的4.016万亿奈拉，增幅为66.2%。
https://www.vanguardngr.com/2026/11/curr.body: •Demand deposits climb 71% •Analysts highlight cash dependence, financial inclusion challenges Currency held outside the banking system by Nigerians rose by 103.8 per cent to N4.923 trillion in September 2026 from N2.416 trillion in September 2023, highlighting the persistent demand for physical cash despite the expansion of electronic payment channels in the country. Data from the Central Bank of Nigeria, CBN, Money and Credit Statistics, also showed that currency outside banks increased by 10.3 per cent year-on-year from N4.465 trillion in September 2025 to N4.923 trillion in September 2026. The figures indicate that cash held outside the banking system has more than doubled in three years, reflecting the scale of currency demand within the economy and the challenges facing efforts to deepen the use of formal banking and electronic payment systems. A breakdown of the data showed that currency outside banks increased by 66.2 per cent from N2.416 trillion in September 2023 to N4.016 trillion in September 2024. The figure subsequently rose to N4.465 trillion in September 2025, an increase of 11.2 per cent from the corresponding period in 2024, before climbing further to N4.923 trillion in September 2026. According to analysts, the latest increase indicates that the preference for cash transactions remains significant, notwithstanding the growing adoption of mobile banking, electronic transfers, point-of-sale terminals and other digital payment platforms. Meanwhile, demand deposits in the banking system increased by 70.8 per cent to N39.124 trillion in September 2026 from N22.903 trillion in September 2023. The CBN data showed that demand deposits rose to N31.842 trillion in September 2024, representing an increase of 39.0 per cent against the corresponding period in 2023. The figure climbed further to N34.642 trillion in September 2025, an increase of 8.8 per cent year-on-year, before rising to N39.124 trillion in September 2026, representing a 12.9 per cent increase over September 2025. The growth in demand deposits indicates an expansion in funds held in bank accounts that are generally accessible for payments and withdrawals on demand. Reacting to this data, Clifford Egbomeade, Economic and Communications expert, said: “The simultaneous increase in demand deposits and currency outside banks points to the coexistence of formal banking balances and substantial demand for physical cash in Nigeria’s payment system. ‘‘However, the two indicators measure different components of monetary activity. Demand deposits represent bank-account balances, while currency outside banks represents cash held outside the banking system. https://www.vanguardngr.com/2026/11/curr.body_zh: •活期存款增长71% •分析人士指出对现金的依赖及普惠金融挑战 尼日利亚人存放在银行体系外的现金从2023年9月的2.416万亿奈拉增至2026年9月的4.923万亿奈拉，增幅为103.8%，尽管该国电子支付渠道不断扩展，实体现金需求依然旺盛。尼日利亚中央银行CBN的货币与信贷统计数据显示，银行体系外流通的货币从2025年9月的4.465万亿奈拉增至2026年9月的4.923万亿奈拉，同比增幅为10.3%。这些数字表明，银行体系外持有的现金在3年内增长了一倍以上，反映出经济体内现金需求的规模，以及深化正规银行和电子支付系统使用所面临的挑战。数据明细显示，银行体系外流通的货币从2023年9月的2.416万亿奈拉增至2024年9月的4.016万亿奈拉，增幅为66.2%。此后，这一数字在2025年9月升至4.465万亿奈拉，较2024年同期增长11.2%，随后在2026年9月进一步升至4.923万亿奈拉。分析人士称，最新增幅表明，尽管移动银行、电子转账、销售终端及其他数字支付平台的采用率不断提高，人们对现金交易的偏好仍然十分显著。与此同时，银行体系内的活期存款从2023年9月的22.903万亿奈拉增至2026年9月的39.124万亿奈拉，增幅为70.8%。CBN数据显示，活期存款在2024年9月升至31.842万亿奈拉，较2023年同期增长39.0%。这一数字在2025年9月进一步升至34.642万亿奈拉，同比增长8.8%，随后在2026年9月升至39.124万亿奈拉，较2025年9月增长12.9%。活期存款的增长表明，银行账户中的资金规模扩大，这些资金通常可按需用于支付和提取。针对这组数据，经济与传播问题专家Clifford Egbomeade表示：“活期存款与银行体系外流通的货币同步增长，表明尼日利亚支付体系中正规银行余额与对实体现金的大量需求并存。不过，这两个指标衡量的是货币活动的不同组成部分。活期存款代表银行账户余额，而银行体系外流通的货币则代表存放在银行体系外的现金。此处表达的意见并不反映Vanguard报纸或其任何员工的观点

https://www.premiumtimesng.com/news/top-.body: Governor Francis Nwifuru of Ebonyi State says his administration has forwarded an executive bill to the state House of Assembly to make kidnapping a capital offence punishable by death without an option of alternative punishment. Mr Nwifuru said this on Friday during the funeral of the slain traditional ruler of Ndufu-Alike Community in Ikwo Local Government Area, Francis Igwe, Vanguard reported . “This should serve as a deterrent to those planning a kidnapping, whether for political reasons or otherwise,” the governor said. Mr Igwe, father of the immediate past Deputy Governor of Ebonyi State, Kelechi Igwe, was abducted on 1 March 1 while on his way to church. Mr Nwifuru, while speaking at the traditional ruler’s funeral, decried the moral deterioration among Nigerian youths. “I am worried about our present-day youths taking up leadership positions tomorrow. Some of our youths are not well informed, and they act so irrationally. “I am concerned because, with some of their attitudinal dispositions, there seems to be no future for our youths. “The youths need to have a rethink concerning certain actions of theirs, especially as concerns their attitudes towards community leaders,” he said. “They should desist from treating their leaders as holders of their destinies.” Mr Nwifuru vowed to implement any court decision against those arrested over the traditional ruler’s murder, stressing that the proposed legislation was intended to deter kidnapping in the state. He maintained that the traditional ruler’s murder should be the last of such incidents in Ikwo and other parts of the state. The governor described the late traditional ruler as “a forthright, vocal and astute parliamentarian” who represented his people effectively in the old Anambra State. He said the traditional ruler attracted development projects to his community, including the popular Folk Technical College, which has produced prominent Nigerians. In their tributes, former governors of the state, Sam Egwu and Martin Elechi, as well as former Senate President, Pius Anyim, described the deceased as a statesman, peacemaker, renowned educationist, administrator and passionate leader who left enduring legacies. They urged the family and the Ikwo people to take solace in his contributions to society. Speaking in his tribute, the slain traditional ruler’s first son and former deputy governor, Kelechi, described his father as a devoted family man and role model who guided him on family life, religion, politics and culture. He said the circumstances surrounding his father’s death remained difficult for the family to comprehend. The former deputy governor said the family was confident that the legacy of the slain traditional ruler would endure for generations to come. The offence attracts severe penalties, including life imprisonment and, in certain circumstances, the death penalty. Criminal Code Act and the Terrorism (Prevention and Prohibition) Act 2022 are the two principal laws that outlaw kidnapping and hostage taking. While the Criminal Code Act prescribes imprisonment of up to 10 years, the Terrorism (Prevention and Prohibition) Act 2022, which addresses the offence in the context of terrorism, prescribes severe punishment, including death, where the offence resulted in the death of a victim. However, the punishment for kidnappings varies across the states in the country. PREMIUM TIMES reports that the applicable legislation on kidnapping is the Ebonyi State Internal Security Enforcement and Other Related Matters Law, 2009 (Cap. 55, Vol. 2)
