https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/foreignaffa.body: U.S. President Donald Trump has said the United States would talk to North Korea if it is found to be behind the theft of more than $6 billion from Binance, the world's largest cryptocurrency exchange. Trump made the remarks at his Mar-a-Lago estate in Palm Beach, Florida, on Saturday after the U.S. Federal Bureau of Investigation (FBI) said North Korea was responsible for the theft of virtual assets from Binance on or about Oct. 29. "I'm not concerned. We're learning about it," he said. "We don't know if it's North Korea, but if it is, we'll talk to North Korea about it." In a cyber alert, the FBI identified the North Korean cyber operation as "TraderTraitor," a name previously associated with cryptocurrency thefts carried out by North Korean hackers. The agency said it had observed the hackers converting stolen assets primarily into Ethereum, a major cryptocurrency, in cooperation with the U.S. Secret Service and the Internal Revenue Service's Criminal Investigation division. The FBI warned that the hackers were expected to further launder the stolen assets through decentralized finance platforms and cryptocurrency exchange services that allow users to quickly swap one digital asset for another. The three U.S. agencies urged cryptocurrency exchanges, blockchain operators, analytics firms and other virtual asset service providers to block transactions involving digital wallet addresses used by the North Korean hackers to launder the stolen funds. The FBI's announcement follows an assessment by U.S. blockchain intelligence firm TRM Labs, which earlier attributed the estimated $6.36 billion Binance theft to TraderTraitor. Trump's remarks come amid persistent speculation over the possibility of renewed diplomacy between Trump and North Korean leader Kim Jong-un. Trump and Kim met three times during Trump's first presidential term. U.S. Secretary of State Marco Rubio said Saturday that Trump remains open to talks with Kim if Pyongyang is willing to discuss issues of concern to Washington and its allies, though no meeting has been scheduled
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/foreignaffa.title_zh: 特朗普称，如果朝鲜与Binance黑客攻击有关，美国将与其谈判
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/foreignaffa.body_zh: 美国总统唐纳德·特朗普表示，如果查明超过60亿美元的加密货币被盗案与朝鲜有关，美国将同朝鲜对话。全球最大加密货币交易所Binance被盗一案发生后，特朗普于周六在佛罗里达州棕榈滩的海湖庄园发表上述言论。此前，美国联邦调查局（FBI）称，朝鲜应对大约10月29日Binance虚拟资产被盗案负责。他说：“我并不担心。我们正在了解情况。我们还不知道是不是朝鲜干的，但如果是，我们会就此事同朝鲜对话。”FBI在一份网络安全警报中将朝鲜的这项网络行动称为“TraderTraitor”，此前这一名称曾与朝鲜黑客实施的加密货币盗窃活动相关联。该机构称，在美国特勤局和美国国内税务局刑事调查部门的合作下，它发现黑客主要将窃取的资产转换为以太坊这一主要加密货币。FBI警告称，预计这些黑客还会通过去中心化金融平台和加密货币交易服务进一步洗钱，这些服务允许用户快速将一种数字资产兑换为另一种数字资产。上述三个美国机构敦促加密货币交易所、区块链运营商、分析公司及其他虚拟资产服务提供商，阻断涉及朝鲜黑客所用数字钱包地址的交易，以阻止被盗资金遭到洗钱。FBI宣布此事之前，美国区块链情报公司TRM Labs已经评估认定，估计价值63.6亿美元的Binance盗窃案系TraderTraitor所为。特朗普发表上述言论之际，外界持续猜测特朗普与朝鲜领导人金正恩是否有可能重启外交接触。特朗普首次担任总统期间曾与金正恩会面三次。美国国务卿马可·鲁比奥周六表示，如果平壤愿意讨论令华盛顿及其盟友关切的问题，特朗普仍愿与金正恩会谈，不过目前尚未安排任何会面

https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/foreignaffa.body: WASHINGTON — U.S. President Donald Trump remains open to talks with North Korean leader Kim Jong-un if Pyongyang is willing to discuss issues of concern to Washington and its allies, but no meeting has been scheduled, U.S. Secretary of State Marco Rubio said Saturday. Rubio made the remarks during a press conference following a Group of 20 (G20) foreign ministers' meeting in Atlanta. "I think the president's perspective is, if North Korea and Kim Jong-un is prepared to talk with the United States about issues that are of concern to us and of concern to our allies, like South Korea, he would be open to doing it," Rubio said. "Nothing has been scheduled. I do not have anything to announce in regards to that today," he added. His remarks came amid persistent speculations over the possibility of renewed diplomacy between Trump and Kim, who held three meetings during Trump's first presidential term. The comments also followed trilateral talks among Rubio and his South Korean and Japanese counterparts in Atlanta on Friday, during which the three top diplomats reaffirmed their commitment to the complete denuclearization of North Korea. "The president doesn't view talks, doesn't view meeting with someone as a concession." Rubio said. "I know in traditional foreign policy, meeting with someone or inviting someone to something is viewed as a concession that somehow legitimizes them." Asked of recent U.S. visa refusal or delay cases involving South Korean legislators, Rubio said the two countries will "work through" the issue on a bilateral basis. Unlock these with Subscription The government on Saturday (October 31, 2026) slashed the export duty on petrol to nil while hiking the levy on export of diesel and aviation turbine fuel (ATF) by ₹3 per litre and 50 paise per litre respectively for the next 15-day period. There was no change in the existing excise duty rates for petrol and diesel for domestic consumption. Diesel exports would now draw a levy of ₹11.5 for every litre against ₹8.5 per litre it drew in the previous fortnight. ATF would be subject to an export levy of ₹11 for every litre against ₹10.5 for every litre as mandated for the previous fortnight. The revised levy on diesel assumes significance as India spiked its exports of the liquid vehicular fuel amid a global supply crunch, particularly in Europe. According to data from real-time analytics provider Kpler, India’s diesel exports stood at 700 kilo barrels per day in October, the highest since September 2025. The government has been conducting a fortnightly review of export levies since March 27, in the backdrop of the conflict in West Asia. These are done based on the average international benchmark prices of crude oil, petrol, diesel and ATF observed since the previous review. https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/foreignaffa.body: Foreign Minister Cho Hyun met separately with his German and Polish counterparts on the sidelines of a Group of 20 (G20) meeting in Atlanta to discuss ways to enhance bilateral cooperation, his office said Saturday. Cho met with German Foreign Minister Johann Wadephul on Friday (U.S. time), expressing hope for deeper ties with the European nation in a wide range of areas, including defense, the economy and cutting-edge industries, according to the Ministry of Foreign Affairs. In response, Wadephul thanked Seoul's foreign ministry for successfully preparing for German Chancellor Friedrich Merz's recent visit to Korea and expressed hope for expanded cooperation in bilateral trade and investment. Cho also met with his Polish counterpart, Radoslaw Sikorski, and called for continued discussions on cooperation in areas such as defense and batteries as a follow-up to Polish Prime Minister Donald Tusk's visit to Korea in April, the ministry said. Sikorski also requested Korea's attention and support for Warsaw's efforts to join the G20, with Cho proposing continued consultations on the matter

https://leadership.ng/fg-tasks-nigerians.body: The Executive Vice Chairman and Chief Executive Officer of the National Agency for Science and Engineering Infrastructure (NASENI), Mr Khalil Suleiman Halilu, made the call during the distribution of solar home systems, clean cooking stoves and household support packs to 330 residents of Ondo State in Akure. Halilu said the initiative was designed to translate research and development into practical products that could improve living conditions and provide economic opportunities for Nigerians. He explained that the solar home systems would provide lighting for households, enable children to study at night and support small businesses, while the clean cooking stoves would offer more efficient cooking alternatives and reduce exposure to smoke when properly used. According to him, wider adoption of locally developed products would encourage domestic manufacturing and strengthen Nigeria’s capacity to develop solutions to its own challenges. He said “This is to promote locally produced items which brings about employment and also to have something good for our communities. He said the NASENI Sustainable Empowerment Programme had reached more than 10 states across the six geopolitical zones, with 330 men and women benefiting from the intervention in Ondo State. The NASENI chief executive added that the programme was intended to take technological innovations beyond research facilities and make them accessible to households and businesses. Also speaking, the Minister of Youth Development, Ayodele Olawande, said beneficiaries would receive additional financial support to enable them to establish or strengthen micro-businesses. Olawande said the intervention was not a political strategy but an effort to take technology-based solutions and economic opportunities to grassroots communities. In his remarks, gov. Yusuf commended Abejide for extending his empowerment programme beyond his constituency, urging other federal lawmakers to support Nigerians irrespective of their ethnic or religious backgrounds. https://www.premiumtimesng.com/features-.summary_zh: 正是在这一背景下，美国众议院开始审议一项新法案，旨在规范预付租金并保护租户免受其所称非法租赁行为的侵害。违反拟议中的12个月上限而支付租金的租户，可向拟设立的首联邦首都地区租金监管与租户保护管理局申请退款。该法案规范可一次性要求支付的租金数额，但不规定房东实际可收取的租金金额。
https://www.premiumtimesng.com/features-.body: For many residents of the Federal Capital Territory (FCT), securing a roof over their heads can mean raising hundreds of thousands, and sometimes millions, of naira at once. Beyond the annual rent itself, prospective tenants often have to contend with agency, agreement and caution fees, while existing tenants face rent increases that can force them to move to less expensive and sometimes more distant communities. It is against this backdrop that the House of Representatives has begun consideration of a new bill seeking to regulate advance rent payments and protect tenants from what it describes as unlawful rental practices. The Federal Capital Territory Advance Rent Regulation and Tenants’ Protection Bill, 2026 (HB.2839), jointly sponsored by Paul Nnamchi (APC, Enugu) and Ahmed Doro (PDP, Katsina), passed first reading on Thursday, 22 October. But the proposal is not simply another attempt to tell landlords how much rent to collect. A closer look at the 17-page bill obtained by PREMIUM TIMES shows that it seeks to create an entire regulatory framework for tenancy in the FCT, covering advance payments, written agreements, agents, complaints, refunds, eviction practices, penalties and dispute resolution. The central provision is contained in Section 4 of the bill. Section 4(1) of the bill provides that a landlord, estate agent or property manager “shall not demand, receive or compel a tenant to pay more than twelve months’ rent in advance” as a condition for granting, renewing or continuing a tenancy. This simply prohibits the demanding, receiving or compelling of a tenant to pay more than one year’s rent in advance as a condition for obtaining, renewing or continuing a tenancy. That means the bill does not ban advance rent or make monthly rent compulsory. Instead, it establishes 12 months as the maximum amount that can be compulsorily demanded upfront. A landlord would still be able to collect one year’s rent in advance if that is the agreed arrangement. But demanding two or three years as a condition for granting or renewing a tenancy would become an offence if the bill becomes law. The bill also attempts to prevent landlords and agents from simply finding another way around the restriction. It specifically lists intermediaries, unexplained premiums, compulsory service charges, artificial renewal or re-grant of a tenancy, separate agreements and other arrangements designed to extract more than 12 months’ rent in advance as prohibited means of evasion. The proposed restriction has an exception. Section 4(4) states that a tenant may voluntarily pay more than 12 months’ rent in advance if “the tenant initiates the offer” and the payment is not imposed by the landlord and the tenant must not have been subjected to coercion, discrimination, threats or retaliation. The agreement must be recorded in writing, and the person receiving the payment bears the burden of proving compliance. This could become one of the contentious provisions during the legislative process. While the bill attempts to distinguish voluntary payments from compulsory demands, proving that a tenant genuinely volunteered to pay several years’ rent could be difficult where the landlord controls access to the property. The proposed law also seeks to formalise the relationship between landlords and tenants. Section 5 requires landlords or their authorised agents to provide written tenancy agreements stating the rent, payment schedule, duration of the tenancy, refundable deposits, fees and other charges, and the rights and obligations of both parties. Landlords and agents would also be required to disclose the nature, amount and legal basis of compulsory fees before a tenancy agreement is concluded and issue receipts or verifiable electronic acknowledgements for payments. The bill also prohibits retaliation against tenants who refuse to make unlawful payments or who complain about violations. A landlord or agent would not be allowed to threaten or unlawfully evict such a tenant, impose a punitive charge, withdraw a lawful benefit or otherwise retaliate against the tenant. The bill introduces a remedy that could significantly change the balance between tenants and landlords. Section 7 introduces a mechanism for recovering unlawfully collected rent. A tenant who has paid rent in violation of the proposed 12-month limit could apply to the proposed FCT Rent Regulation and Tenants’ Protection Authority for a refund. Where the proposed authority determines that a payment contravened the law, it may order the recipient to refund the unlawful amount within 30 days. The bill also allows an aggrieved party to appeal an order of the authority to the FCT High Court. “7(1) A tenant who has paid rent in contravention of section 4 may apply to the Authority for a refund order. (2) Where the Authority determines that a payment was received in contravention of section 4, it may order the recipient to refund the unlawful amount within thirty days after service of the order.” Under Section 8, the bill proposes the establishment of the Federal Capital Territory Rent Regulation and Tenants’ Protection Authority. The authority would receive and investigate complaints, monitor landlords, estate agents and property managers, issue compliance notices, facilitate mediation, order refunds and refer suspected criminal offences to relevant law-enforcement or prosecuting authorities. It would also establish complaint offices and electronic reporting channels throughout the FCT, including satellite towns, and publish periodic reports on rental practices and enforcement outcomes. Its governing board would include representatives of the FCT Administration, the federal ministry responsible for housing, the federal ministry responsible for justice, tenants, landlords or property owners and estate surveyors and valuers. The president will appoint the chairperson and members of the board, subject to Senate confirmation. The president will also appoint the director-general, subject to Senate confirmation. A person convicted of knowingly demanding or receiving unlawful advance rent would face a fine of between ₦500,000 and ₦5 million. A corporate body could face a fine of between ₦5 million and ₦20 million. The court could also order refunds, compensation for proven losses and payment of lawful costs. Failure to comply with a compliance notice issued by the proposed authority would also constitute an offence punishable by a fine of up to ₦1 million. Estate agents and property managers are expressly covered. Where an offence is committed through an intermediary, anyone who knowingly authorised, participated in or facilitated the offence could also be liable. The bill is not solely about the amount of money tenants pay. It also targets the methods some landlords may use to recover possession. It prohibits violence or threats, disconnecting essential services, removing or damaging a tenant’s property, changing locks without lawful authority and other forms of unlawful self-help. At the same time, it makes clear that tenants remain obliged to pay rent lawfully due and that landlords retain the right to recover rent and possession through due process. This is significant because the bill attempts to protect tenants without removing landlords’ existing property rights. This is perhaps the biggest question the lawmakers will have to confront. The bill regulates how much rent can be demanded upfront, but it does not regulate the actual amount landlords can charge as rent. There is no rent ceiling and no limit on how much rent can increase when a tenancy is renewed. A landlord who cannot demand two years’ rent upfront could still charge a high annual rent. The bill also does not address the shortage of affordable housing, construction costs, mortgage access or the wider factors driving rent increases. The proposed authority would have to monitor landlords and agents, investigate complaints and enforce its decisions across the FCT. The bill also provides for the authority to become operational within six months of the law taking effect. Despite its proposed restrictions on advance rent, the bill does not comprehensively regulate other charges tenants face when securing accommodation in Abuja, including agency fees, agreement fees and caution deposits. In Abuja, these charges are random and some tenants pay as high as 40 per cent of their rent for them. Although Section 5 requires landlords and agents to disclose the nature and amount of charges, it does not prescribe a maximum percentage or amount that can be demanded as agency or agreement fees. Neither does it establish a standard ceiling for caution deposits. The bill requires refundable deposits to be stated in tenancy agreements but does not clearly set out a standard formula for calculating them. This means tenants could have a clearer right to know what they are paying for without necessarily having protection against excessive charges. Section 4 prohibits landlords and agents from using charges that are not reasonably related to a service as a means of circumventing the 12-month advance rent restriction. However, this does not amount to a comprehensive regulation of legitimate agency fees or other letting costs. Consequently, tenants could still face substantial upfront expenses even if the bill becomes law. A landlord may no longer be able to compel a tenant to pay two years’ rent, but the tenant could still be required to pay agency, agreement and other charges, provided those charges comply with the law. Another major issue left unresolved is the payment arrangement for salary earners. Many Abuja residents earn monthly salaries but are expected to pay a full year’s rent upfront, with some landlords demanding two years’ rent from new tenants. For workers whose income comes in monthly, raising such a large sum at once can be difficult, even when they can afford the rent over the course of a year. The proposed law would prohibit landlords from compelling tenants to pay more than 12 months’ rent in advance. However, it does not require landlords to accept monthly or quarterly payments. A landlord could therefore still insist on a full year’s rent upfront, provided the demand does not exceed the proposed limit. This means the bill addresses the length of compulsory advance rent but does not fully address the financial difficulty created by the annual payment system. A tenant who cannot raise 12 months’ rent at once may therefore remain unable to secure accommodation, even if the landlord is no longer demanding two years’ payment. The latest proposal is part of a longer-running attempt by lawmakers to address rent practices in Abuja. In January 2022, the Senate introduced a bill sponsored by Smart Adeyemi, then representing Kogi West, seeking to regulate the payment of rent in the FCT. The bill passed second reading in February 2022. PREMIUM TIMES reported at the time that the proposal sought to reduce advance rent for new tenants from the prevailing one- or two-year payments to three months, followed by monthly payments. Mr Adeyemi argued that the existing system placed an excessive burden on low-income residents, particularly salaried workers who could not easily raise one or two years’ rent at once. While supporters argued that advance rent was placing unbearable pressure on residents, Chimaroke Nnamani, then the senator for Enugu East, opposed the proposal, arguing that rent payment was an economic matter that should be driven by market forces, including the availability of land, construction costs and income. He argued that the government should instead invest in housing schemes, mortgages and housing credit rather than regulate the business of private landlords. The Senate nevertheless voted overwhelmingly for the bill at second reading and referred it to the Committee on Housing and Urban Development for further consideration.

TIMES获得的这份17页法案显示，它试图为FCT的租赁关系建立一套完整的监管框架，涵盖预付款、书面协议、中介、投诉、退款、驱逐程序、处罚和争议解决。法案的核心规定载于第4条。法案第4条第1款规定，房东、房地产中介或物业管理人不得将“要求、收取或迫使租户预付超过12个月租金”作为授予、续租或延续租赁关系的条件。这实际上禁止将要求、收取或迫使租户预付超过一年租金作为取得、续租或延续租赁关系的条件。这意味着，该法案并不禁止预付租金，也不强制要求按月付租。相反，它将12个月确立为可被强制要求一次性预付的最高金额。如果双方约定预付一年租金，房东仍可据此收取。但若法案成为法律，将两年或三年租金作为授予或续租租赁关系的条件将成为违法行为。法案还试图防止房东和中介另辟蹊径规避这一限制。法案明确将中介费、来路不明的额外费用、强制服务费、人为安排续租或重新授予租赁关系、另订协议以及其他旨在收取超过12个月预付租金的安排列为禁止的规避手段。拟议限制设有一项例外。第4条第4款规定，如果“租户主动提出”，且该付款并非房东强加，租户也未受到胁迫、歧视、威胁或报复，租户可以自愿预付超过12个月的租金。相关协议必须以书面形式记录，并由收取款项的一方承担证明合规的责任。这可能成为立法过程中的一项争议条款。尽管法案试图区分自愿付款与强制要求，但在房东掌控物业使用权的的情况下，要证明租户确实自愿支付数年租金可能十分困难。拟议法律还试图将房东与租户之间的关系正规化。第5条要求房东或其授权中介提供书面租赁协议，注明租金、付款时间表、租赁期限、可退还押金、各项费用及其他收费，以及双方的权利和义务。房东和中介还必须在租赁协议订立前披露强制收费的性质、金额和法律依据，并为付款出具收据或可核验的电子确认凭证。法案还禁止房东或中介报复拒绝支付非法款项或投诉违法行为的租户。房东或中介不得威胁或非法驱逐此类租户、施加惩罚性收费、收回合法利益或以其他方式报复租户。法案引入的一项救济措施可能显著改变租户与房东之间的力量平衡。第7条引入了追讨非法收取租金的机制。违反拟议12个月上限而支付了租金的租户，可以向拟议的FCT租金监管与租户保护管理局申请退款。若该管理局认定某笔付款违反法律，可以命令收款方在30天内退还非法收取的金额。法案还允许受侵害一方向FCT高等法院上诉管理局的命令。规定如下：“第7条（1）违反第4条支付租金的租户，可以向管理局申请退款命令。（2）管理局认定某笔付款系违反第4条收取的，可以命令收款方在命令送达后30天内退还非法金额。”根据第8条，法案提议成立联邦首都租金监管与租户保护管理局。该管理局将受理并调查投诉，监督房东、房地产中介和物业管理人，发出合规通知，促成调解，责令退款，并将涉嫌犯罪的案件移交相关执法或检察机关。它还将在FCT各地，包括各卫星城设立投诉办公室和电子举报渠道，并定期发布有关租赁实践和执法结果的报告。其董事会将包括FCT行政机关、负责住房事务的联邦部委、负责司法事务的联邦部委、租户、房东或物业所有者以及土地测量师和估价师的代表。总统将任命董事会主席和成员，但须经参议院确认。总统还将任命总干事，同样须经参议院确认。明知要求或收取非法预付租金的人一旦被定罪，将面临₦500,000至₦5 million的罚款。法人团体可能面临₦5 million至₦20 million的罚款。法院还可责令退款、赔偿经证实的损失并支付合法费用。不遵守拟议管理局发出的合规通知，也将构成犯罪，可处以最高₦1 million的罚款。房地产中介和物业管理人被明确纳入适用范围。若通过中介实施犯罪，任何明知并授权、参与或协助实施犯罪的人也可能承担责任。这部法案的意义不只在于租户支付多少钱。它还针对部分房东可能用来收回物业占有权的手段。法案禁止暴力或威胁、切断基本生活服务、搬走或损坏租户财物、未经合法授权更换门锁以及其他形式的非法自助行为。与此同时，法案明确规定，租户仍有义务依法支付应付租金，房东也仍有权通过正当程序收回租金和物业占有权。这一点十分重要，因为该法案试图在不剥夺房东现有财产权利的情况下保护租户。这或许是议员们必须面对的最大问题。法案对可预付租金的数额作出监管，但并未规定房东实际可收取的租金金额。法案没有设定租金上限，也没有限制续租时租金可以上涨多少。无法要求预付两年租金的房东，仍可收取较高的年租金。法案也未处理可负担住房短缺、建筑成本、按揭贷款可获得性以及推高租金的其他更广泛因素。拟议管理局将不得不监督房东和中介、调查投诉并在FCT各地执行决定。法案还规定，该管理局须在法律生效后六个月内开始运作。尽管该法案对预付租金提出限制，但它没有全面监管租户在阿布贾获取住房时面临的其他收费，包括中介费、签约费押金和押金。在阿布贾，这些收费随意收取，有些租户为此支付的金额高达租金的40%。尽管第5条要求房东和中介披露收费的性质和金额，但并未规定中介费或签约费可收取的最高百分比或金额，也没有为押金设定统一上限。法案要求在租赁协议中注明可退还押金，但未明确列出计算押金的标准公式。这意味着，租户或许能更清楚地了解自己支付的是什么，却未必能获得防止过高收费的保护。第4条禁止房东和中介利用与服务没有合理关联的费用，作为规避12个月预付租金限制的手段。但这并不等于对合法中介费或其他出租成本进行全面监管。因此，即使该法案成为法律，租户仍可能面临巨额前期费用。房东或许不能再强迫租户支付两年租金，但只要相关收费符合法律，租户仍可能被要求支付中介费、签约费和其他费用。另一个尚未解决的重要问题是工薪阶层租户的付款安排。许多阿布贾居民按月领取工资，却仍被要求一次性预付全年租金，一些房东还会向新租户索要两年租金。对按月取得收入的劳动者来说，即使其能够在一年过程中负担得起租金，一次筹集如此巨额资金仍很困难。拟议法律将禁止房东迫使租户预付超过12个月的租金，但并不要求房东接受按月或按季付款。因此，只要所要求的金额不超过拟议上限，房东仍可坚持要求一次性预付全年租金。这意味着，该法案处理了强制预付租金的期限问题，却未完全解决年度付款制度造成的经济困难。因此，无法一次筹集12个月租金的租户，可能仍无法获得住房，即便房东已不再索要两年预付款。这项最新提案是议员们为处理阿布贾租赁收费问题而进行的长期努力的一部分。2022年1月，参议院提出一项由时任代表科吉西部选区的斯马特·阿德耶米提案的法案，试图规范FCT的租金支付。该法案于2022年2月通过二读。PREMIUM TIMES当时报道称，该提案寻求将新租户预付租金从当时普遍存在的一年或两年改为三个月预付，此后按月支付。阿德耶米先生认为，现有制度给低收入居民，特别是难以一次筹集一年或两年租金的工薪阶层造成了过重负担。支持者认为预付租金给居民带来难以承受的压力，但时任恩努古东部选区参议员奇马罗克·纳马尼反对该提案，主张租金支付属于经济问题，应由土地供应、建筑成本和收入等市场力量决定。他认为，政府应转而投资住房计划、按揭贷款和住房信贷，而不是监管私人房东的经营。尽管如此，参议院仍在二读时以压倒性多数投票通过该法案，并将其提交住房与城市发展委员会进一步审议。

https://www.thisdaylive.com/2026/11/01/n.summary: •Threaten removal of illegal structures on transmission routes The House of Representatives’ Committee on Public Assets has threatened to demolish illegal structures erected on the federal government’s rights of way (ROW) for power transmission projects, warning that encroachment and vandalism were threatening investments in the electricity sector.
https://www.thisdaylive.com/2026/11/01/n.summary_zh: •威胁拆除输电线路上的违法建筑。众议院公共资产委员会威胁拆除联邦政府为输电项目预留的通行权（ROW）范围内搭建的违法建筑，并警告称，侵占和故意破坏正威胁电力行业 investments。
https://www.thisdaylive.com/2026/11/01/n.body: •Threaten removal of illegal structures on transmission routes The House of Representatives’ Committee on Public Assets has threatened to demolish illegal structures erected on the federal government’s rights of way (ROW) for power transmission projects, warning that encroachment and vandalism were threatening investments in the electricity sector. The Chairman of the committee, Kuye Ademorin, gave the warning during inspection of the 132kV New Haven-Ninth Mile-Nsukka Double Circuit Transmission Line in Enugu State and the Egbu 330/132/33kV substation in Owerri, Imo State. The committee expressed concern that churches, hotels, private residences and even state government buildings had been erected along designated transmission routes, potentially delaying the completion of projects designed to improve electricity supply. Other lawmakers on the inspection tour, according to a statement by the NDPHC spokesperson, Nazo Agim, included Mark Obetta, Lanre Okunlola, Sani Rigo and Canice Nwachukwu. Ademorin questioned how state authorities could approve developments along corridors already designated as federal government rights of way, describing the situation as a threat to critical national infrastructure. He said the committee was impressed by the scale of the federal government’s investment in developing a sustainable electricity system but was disappointed that some communities were undermining the initiative through encroachment and vandalism. “We observed the magnitude of investment by the federal government in building a sustainable power system for the country, particularly in our states, to help them develop their industrial base through adequate power supply. “However, to our chagrin and disappointment, we saw a people who are not totally buying into the vision of a greater country for all of us,” he said. The lawmaker warned that the National Assembly would take appropriate measures to ensure that illegal structures were removed from the affected corridors. “It is not going to be business as usual. We are going to take drastic, appropriate steps to ensure that those structures are removed,” he said. The committee also called for stronger collaboration between federal and state governments to protect public assets and prevent further delays to electricity infrastructure projects. At the Egbu substation, the delegation acknowledged that the facility was about 85 per cent complete and, upon completion, would add approximately 250 megawatts to electricity supply in Imo State, significantly improving power delivery to the Orlu area. The project, which was first awarded in 2006, has received renewed attention under the leadership of NDPHC Managing Director and Chief Executive Officer, Jennifer Adighije. Ademorin commended the quality of work at the substation and expressed optimism that its anticipated completion around March 2027 would stimulate industrial activities across the South-east. He, however, urged the federal government to ensure the timely completion of ongoing projects and prompt payment of contractors to avoid unnecessary delays. The committee chairman also emphasised the need for adequate and timely compensation for landowners whose properties were acquired for public infrastructure, noting that unresolved compensation issues could trigger disputes and litigation. He appealed to the governors of Enugu and Imo states to work with NDPHC to address encroachment, protect federal assets and accelerate the delivery of the projects. Ademorin further advised Nigerians to verify the ownership and status of land before purchasing properties, particularly around designated government rights of way, to avoid acquiring plots earmarked for public infrastructure. https://www.thisdaylive.com/2026/11/01/n.title_zh: 尼日利亚联邦电力委员会：联邦议员谴责电力项目遭侵占和破坏
https://www.thisdaylive.com/2026/11/01/n.body_zh: •威胁拆除输电线路沿线非法建筑 众议院公共资产委员会威胁拆除联邦政府输电项目用地范围内非法搭建的设施，并警告称，侵占和破坏行为正在威胁电力行业的投资。委员会主席Kuye Ademorin在检查恩古州132kV New Haven—Ninth Mile—Nsukka双回输电线路以及伊莫州奥韦里Egbu 330/132/33kV变电站时发出警告。委员会表示关切，称指定输电线路沿线已建有教堂、酒店、私人住宅，甚至州政府大楼，可能延误旨在改善电力供应的项目竣工。根据尼日利亚联邦电力控股公司发言人Nazo Agim发表的声明，参加此次检查的其他议员包括Mark Obetta、Lanre Okunlola、Sani Rigo和Canice Nwachukwu。Ademorin质疑州 authorities 如何能够批准在已被划定为联邦政府用地范围的走廊沿线开展开发，并称这一局面威胁到关键国家基础设施。他说，委员会对联邦政府为建设可持续电力体系所投入的大量资金印象深刻，但对一些社区通过侵占和破坏破坏该举措感到失望。他说：“我们看到联邦政府为建设可持续电力体系所投入的大量资金，特别是对我们所在各州的投资，旨在通过充足供电帮助它们发展工业基础。“然而，令我们懊恼和失望的是，我们看到一些民众并不完全认同建设一个属于所有人的更伟大国家这一愿景。”这名议员警告称，国民议会将采取适当措施，确保拆除受影响走廊内的非法建筑。他说：“一切照旧的日子不会继续。我们将采取严厉而适当的措施，确保拆除这些建筑。”委员会还呼吁联邦政府和州政府加强协作，保护公共资产，防止电力基础设施项目进一步延误。在Egbu变电站，代表团承认该设施已完成约85%，竣工后预计将向伊莫州新增约250兆瓦电力供应，显著改善奥鲁地区的供电。该项目于2006年首次中标，在尼日利亚联邦电力控股公司董事兼首席执行官Jennifer Adighije的领导下重新受到关注。Ademorin赞扬了变电站的工程质量，并乐观地表示，其预计于2027年3月左右竣工，将推动尼日利亚东南部各地工业活动。然而，他敦促联邦政府确保在建项目按时完工，并及时向承包商付款，以避免不必要的延误。委员会主席还强调，应向土地被征收用于公共基础设施的业主提供充分、及时的补偿，并指出，补偿问题未得到解决可能引发争端和诉讼。他呼吁恩古州和伊莫州州长与尼日利亚联邦电力控股公司合作，处理侵占问题、保护联邦资产并加快项目交付。Ademorin还建议尼日利亚人在购买房产前核实土地所有权和状态，尤其是在指定的政府用地范围周边，以避免购入 earmarked 用于公共基础设施的地块。THISDAY于1995年1月22日创办，由THISDAY NEWSPAPERS LTD.出版，地址为尼日利亚拉各斯阿帕帕Creek Road 35号，在尼日利亚36个州、联邦首都辖区以及世界各地设有办公室。它是尼日利亚最具权威性的新闻媒体，通过所有平台面向政治、商业、专业和外交精英以及更广泛的中产阶级，同时为有志者和千禧一代提供新思想、文化与技术的交汇点。该报秉持公共信托精神，追求真相与理性，报道范围涵盖突发新闻、政治、商业、金融市场、艺术、体育、社区，以及人与社会的交汇点。您可以发送邮件至：hello@thisdaylive.com，或访问我们的联系我们页面

https://www.thisdaylive.com/2026/11/01/h.summary: The Joint Health Sector Unions (JOHESU) have begun mobilising health workers nationwide for possible industrial action over the federal government’s failure to implement the Consolidated Health Salary Structure (CONHESS) adjustment. https://www.thisdaylive.com/2026/11/01/h.summary_zh: 联合卫生部门工会（JOHESU）已开始在全國動員醫護人員，可能因聯邦政府未能落實《綜合醫務人員薪資結構》（CONHESS）調整而發動 industrial action。該工會此前警告，將抵制任何企圖阻礙薪資調整的行為，並表示已不再準備容忍進一步延遲落實協議。
https://www.thisdaylive.com/2026/11/01/h.body: The Joint Health Sector Unions (JOHESU) have begun mobilising health workers nationwide for possible industrial action over the federal government’s failure to implement the Consolidated Health Salary Structure (CONHESS) adjustment. This demand has remained unresolved for about 13 years. The union, which warned that it would resist any attempt to frustrate the salary adjustment, said it was no longer prepared to tolerate further delays in implementing the agreement. This was part of the resolutions reached at an emergency expanded National Executive Council (NEC) virtual meeting held on Thursday, October 29, 2026, attended by its affiliates and organs at federal and state levels. The union recalled that President Bola Tinubu had, on June 5, 2023, promised to actualise the adjustment while appealing to JOHESU to suspend its strike after assuming office. It also recalled that the Federal Ministry of Health and Social Welfare had, on the same date, forwarded the 2021 High Level Body Technical Committee Report on the adjustment to the Budget Office of the Federation, the secretariat of the Presidential Committee on Salaries (PCS). However, JOHESU accused the government of allowing the process to stall because the PCS could not meet, warning that any further attempt to use the committee’s failure to act as an excuse would meet resistance. The union commended the Nigeria Labour Congress (NLC) and the Trade Union Congress of Nigeria (TUC) for taking decisive steps to secure the adjustment, describing it as the oldest demand in organised labour history. It also reminded the federal government of the provisions of the Trade Unions Act, Cap T14, LFN, 2004, which permits trade unions to negotiate benefit packages and collective bargaining agreements on behalf of their members. JOHESU consequently placed its members on alert and directed the commencement of mobilisation across health institutions nationwide for a possible industrial action and what it described as necessary but unparalleled resistance should the government yield to attempts to frustrate the demand. The union, however, urged members to remain peaceful while awaiting further directives from the NLC and TUC, following the ultimatum and timeline issued to the federal government. https://www.thisdaylive.com/2026/11/01/h.body_zh: 联合卫生部门工会（JOHESU）已开始在全国范围内动员卫生工作者，可能因联邦政府未能落实《统一卫生工资结构》（CONHESS）调整而采取工业行动。这一诉求已悬而未决约13年。该工会曾警告，将抵制任何阻挠工资调整的企图，并表示已不再准备容忍协议落实继续拖延。这是工会于2026年10月29日星期四举行的全国执行委员会（NEC）紧急扩大虚拟会议所通过决议的一部分，其联邦和州级附属机构及组织派员出席了会议。工会回顾称，总统博拉·蒂努布曾于2023年6月5日承诺落实工资调整，同时在上任后敦促JOHESU暂停罢工。工会还指出，联邦卫生和社会福利部于同日向联邦预算办公室暨总统薪资委员会（PCS）秘书处转交了有关调整的2021年高层机构技术委员会报告。然而，JOHESU指责政府任由这一进程陷入停滞，因为PCS无法开会，并警告称，任何再次企图以委员会未采取行动作为拖延借口的做法都将遭到抵制。工会赞扬尼日利亚劳工大会（NLC）和尼日利亚工会大会（TUC）为促成工资调整采取果断措施，并称这是有组织劳工历史上持续时间最长的诉求。工会还提醒联邦政府遵守《2004年工会法》T14章《尼日利亚联邦法律汇编》的规定，该法允许工会代表成员谈判福利方案和集体谈判协议。因此，JOHESU已要求成员保持戒备，并指示在全国各医疗和卫生机构启动动员，为可能采取工业行动以及其所称必要但前所未有的抵制行动作准备，以防政府屈从于阻挠这一诉求的企图。不过，在等待NLC和TUC根据向联邦政府发出的最后通牒及时间表进一步下达指示期间，工会仍敦促成员保持和平。THISDAY于1995年1月22日创刊，由THISDAY NEWSPAPERS LTD.出版，地址为尼日利亚拉各斯阿帕帕克里克路35号，在尼日利亚36个州、联邦首都地区及世界各地设有办公室。作为尼日利亚最具权威性的新闻媒体，THISDAY通过所有平台服务政治、商业、专业和外交精英以及更广泛的中产阶级，同时为有志者、千禧一代提供新思想、文化和技术交汇的平台。该报秉持公共信托精神，致力于追求真相与理性，报道范围涵盖突发新闻、政治、商业、金融市场、艺术、体育和社区等议题，直至探索人与社会的交汇点。您可以发送邮件至：hello@thisdaylive.com，或访问我们的联系我们页面

https://www.yna.co.kr/view/akr2026110102.summary_zh: （首爾=聯合新聞社）記者申昌永=中國正快速擴大其市場版圖，不僅限於消費品和中間產品，在工業設備市場的布局也在加速。有觀點指出，韓國若要應對這一趨勢，就必須在先進市場突出供應可靠性，並在新兴市場鎖定生產工藝升級的需求。韓國貿易協會國際貿易通商研究員在1日發布的《中國工業設備出口的崛起與全球供應結構變化》報告中作出上述表述。
https://www.yna.co.kr/view/akr2026110102.body: (서울=연합뉴스) 신창용 기자 = 중국이 소비재와 중간재를 넘어 산업설비 시장에서도 영역을 빠르게 넓히고 있는 것으로 나타났다. 한국이 이에 대응하려면 선진 시장에서는 공급 신뢰성을 내세우고 신흥 시장에서는 생산공정 고도화 수요를 공략해야 한다는 지적이 나왔다. 한국무역협회 국제무역통상연구원은 1일 발표한 '중국 산업설비 수출의 부상과 글로벌 공급구조 변화' 보고서에서 이같이 밝혔다. 보고서에 따르면 중국의 산업설비 수출액은 2015년 1천42억달러에서 2025년 2천572억달러로 약 2.5배 급증했다. 이는 연평균 8.2% 증가한 수준으로, 같은 기간 소비재(1.8%)와 중간재(6.0%)의 성장세를 크게 웃도는 수치다. 중국의 역할이 소비재·중간재 공급자를 넘어 글로벌 제조업 생산 기반을 제공하는 설비 공급자로 확장되고 있는 셈이다. 한국과 중국의 산업설비 수출경합도(ESI)는 2015년 46에서 2025년 54로 상승했다. 독일(55→62)과 일본(44→47)도 중국과의 경합도가 동반 상승했다. 중국은 기존에 강점을 보였던 전력설비와 식품·섬유가공기계 외에도 물류·이송설비에서 독일을 제쳤다. 범용·기타 설비 부문에서는 독일과 공동 1위로 올라서는 등 범용성 높은 분야를 중심으로 글로벌 공급 영향력을 크게 넓혔다. 중국의 산업설비 점유율은 신흥 시장에서 2015년 21.1%에서 2024년 29.6%로 급등했으나 미국의 통상 제재 영향이 미친 선진 시장에서는 12.8%에서 14.0%로 소폭 상승하는 데 그쳤다. 보고서는 독일과 일본의 점유율이 동반 하락하는 사이 한국이 3.0%에서 3.3%로 안정적인 입지를 유지한 선진 시장에서는 공급 신뢰성과 현지 대응 역량을 바탕으로 입지를 넓힐 수 있다고 평가했다. 반면 중국의 저가 공세로 한국 점유율이 6.3%에서 4.1%로 하락한 신흥 시장에서는 생산기지 신규·증설 초기 단계부터 참여해 설비 조달 기회를 선점하고, 이후 자동화와 고정밀화, 설비 교체 수요까지 연계해야 한다고 제언했다. 허슬비 무역협회 연구원은 "중국이 가격경쟁력을 앞세워 산업설비 공급을 빠르게 늘리고 있는 만큼 우리 기업은 품질과 납기 신뢰성, 부품 공급·유지보수 역량으로 차별화해야 한다"며 "정부 차원에서도 현지 인증 대응과 수요기업 발굴 지원 등을 강화해 우리 기업의 해외 진출 부담을 낮춰야 한다"고 강조했다. 제보는 카카오톡 okjebo <저작권자(c) 연합뉴스, 무단 전재-재배포, AI 학습 및 활용 금지> 2026/11/01 11:29 송고 2026년11월01일 11시29분 송고
https://www.yna.co.kr/view/akr2026110102.title_zh: 中国工业设备出口激增……“韩国应以质量、交付和售后服务应对”
https://www.yna.co.kr/view/akr2026110102.body_zh:
（首尔=韩联社）记者申창용报道称，中国正在消费产品和中间产品之外，迅速扩大在工业设备市场的影响范围。有观点指出，韩国若要加以应对，就必须在发达市场突出供应可靠性，并在新兴市场开拓生产流程升级需求。韩国贸易协会国际贸易研究员1日发布的《中国工业设备出口的跃升与全球供应结构变化》报告称，工业设备出口额从2015年的1042亿美元增至2025年的2572亿美元，约为原来的2.5倍，年均增长率达到8.2%，远高于同期消费产品（1.8%）和中间产品（6.0%）的增长速度。这意味着，中国正从消费产品和中间产品供应国，扩展为为全球制造业生产基础提供设备的供应国。
韩国与中国工业设备出口竞争度（ESI）从2015年的46升至2025年的54。德国（55→62）和日本（44→47）与中国之间的竞争度也同步上升。除电力设备以及食品、纺织加工机械等原有优势领域外，中国在物流和输送设备方面也超过德国。在通用及其他设备领域，中国升至与德国并列第一，广泛扩大了在全球供应领域的影响力。
报告称，中国工业设备市场占有率在新兴市场从2015年的21.1%大幅升至2024年的29.6%；但在受美国贸易制裁影响的发达市场，仅从12.8%小幅升至14.0%。报告评价称，在德国和日本市场占有率同步下降的情况下，韩国在发达市场通过将占有率稳定在3.0%至3.3%，可以凭借供应可靠性和当地应对能力扩大市场影响力。
报告建议，在因中国低价攻势而使韩国市场占有率从6.3%降至4.1%的新兴市场，韩国企业应从生产基地新建和扩建初期就参与其中，先行获取设备采购机会，之后再将自动化、高精度化以及设备更新需求一并开发。
韩国贸易协会研究员具晓日（허슬비）强调：“中国凭借价格竞争力迅速扩大工业设备供应，因此我国企业应通过质量、交货期可靠性以及零部件供应和维护能力实现差异化。政府层面也应加强当地认证应对措施，并支持挖掘需求企业，以减轻我国企业出海面临的负担。”

https://www.thisdaylive.com/2026/11/01/h.summary: For instance, Maradun is the home of the Minister of State for Defence, Bello Matawalle, who is also the immediate past governor of Zamfara State. Zamfara is also the home of Senator Abdulaziz Yari, the Director-General of the All Progressives Congress (APC) Presidential Campaign Council mandated to oversee the re-election campaign of President Bola Tinubu. Both communities are in the same Zamfara West Senatorial District currently represented in the Senate by Senate Yari, who was also governor of the state.
https://www.thisdaylive.com/2026/11/01/h.summary_zh: 例如，马拉敦是国防部国务部长贝洛·马塔瓦莱的家乡，他也是赞法拉州最近一任州长。参议员阿卜杜勒阿齐兹·亚里来自赞法拉州，他担任全进步大会党（APC）总统竞选委员会主任，负责监督总统博拉·蒂努布的连任竞选。这两个地区都位于赞法拉州西部参议员选区，该选区目前由参议员亚里在参议院代表，他此前也曾担任该州州长。
https://www.thisdaylive.com/2026/11/01/h.body: The Zamfara State Police Command recently announced the arrest of a 22-year-old member of the Jama’atu Izalatil Bid’ah Wa’iqamatus Sunnah (JIBWIS), Umar Ibrahim Gandi Maradun for chanting incitements to religious violence in Nigeria. In a viral video, the accused was seen leading the chant: “Give Us Rifles to Kill Arna (infidels/Christians)….” in places like Enugu and Jos. According to the police, the suspect was located in Maradun. However, the police said the road from Gusau to Maradun was so bad that they had to contact JIBWIS in Maradun to bring the suspect to Gusau, in a motorcycle, popularly known as Okada. The matter became more disturbing considering the fact that the three former governors of the state since the enthronement of democracy almost came from nearly the affected area. For instance, Maradun is the home of the Minister of State for Defence, Bello Matawalle, who is also the immediate past governor of Zamfara State. The distance from Gusau to Maradun is officially between 91 to 100 kilometres. That should ordinarily take about 70 minutes on a modestly bad road. Now it takes over 180 minutes due mostly to the unmotorable nature of the road, and worsened by insecurity. Zamfara is also the home of Senator Abdulaziz Yari, the Director-General of the All Progressives Congress (APC) Presidential Campaign Council mandated to oversee the re-election campaign of President Bola Tinubu. He is from Talata Mafara, which is separated from Maradun by less than 25 kilometres. Both communities are in the same Zamfara West Senatorial District currently represented in the Senate by Senate Yari, who was also governor of the state. According to media reports, the bad road continues to the village of Senator Yari, through to Talata Mafara Central Primary School where he graduated. Also from Zamfara West is Senator Sani Yerima, who comes from Anka, about 110 kilometres from Gusau. He was also Governor of the state for eight years until 2007 and senator thereafter for 12 years from 2007-2019. Reports claim there is also no road to his place. The state also witnessed the worst form of insecurity when the three were governors. These are the three men leading the charge to bring Renewed Hope to Nigerians. Charity, they say, begins at home. To many, the trio failed the people of the state. https://www.thisdaylive.com/2026/11/01/h.title_zh: 耶里马、亚里和马塔瓦勒如何导致赞法拉州欠发达
https://www.thisdaylive.com/2026/11/01/h.body_zh: 赞法拉州警察指挥部近日宣布，已逮捕22岁的Jama’atu Izalatil Bid’ah Wa’iqamatus Sunnah（JIBWIS）成员乌马尔·易卜拉欣·甘迪·马拉敦，原因是其在尼日利亚煽动宗教暴力。在一段广泛传播的视频中，被告人被发现带头高喊：“把枪支给我们，让我们杀死阿尔纳（异教徒／基督徒）……”地点包括恩古和乔斯等地。据警方称，嫌疑人在马拉敦被找到。然而，警方表示，从古索到马拉敦的道路糟糕至极，他们不得不联系马拉敦的JIBWIS，让其用俗称“Okada”的摩托车将嫌疑人带到古索。考虑到自民主制度建立以来，该州三任前州长几乎都来自受灾地区附近，这起事件更加令人不安。例如，马拉敦是国防部国务部长贝洛·马塔瓦莱的家乡，他也是赞法拉州的前任州长。从古索到马拉敦的官方距离为91至100公里。路况即便只是一般不佳，通常也应只需约70分钟。如今却需要180多分钟，主要是因为道路无法通行车辆，加之安全形势恶化。赞法拉州也是参议员阿卜杜勒阿齐兹·亚里的家乡。他是全进步大会党（APC）总统竞选委员会总干事，负责监督总统博拉·蒂努布的连任竞选活动。他来自塔拉塔·马法拉，该地与马拉敦相距不足25公里。两个社区均位于赞法拉西部参议员选区，目前由参议员亚里在参议院代表，而他也曾担任该州州长。据媒体报道，糟糕的道路一直延伸至亚里参议员所在的村庄，并延伸至他就读毕业的塔拉塔·马法拉中央小学。同样来自赞法拉西部的还有参议员萨尼·耶里马，他来自安卡，距古索约110公里。他也曾担任该州州长8年，之后从2007年至2019年担任参议员12年。报道称，通往他所在地的道路同样不存在。在三人担任州长期间，该州还经历过最严重的安全问题。这三人如今正带头为尼日利亚人带来“ renewed hope ”。他们说，慈善始于家庭。在许多人看来，这三人辜负了该州民众。THISDAY于1995年1月22日创刊，由THISDAY NEWSPAPERS LTD.出版，地址为尼日利亚拉各斯阿帕帕溪路35号，在尼日利亚36个州、联邦首都领地及世界各地设有办公室。作为尼日利亚最具权威性的新闻媒体，该报通过所有平台为政治、商业、专业和外交精英以及更广泛的中产阶级服务，同时充当抱负者与千禧一代交流新思想、文化和技术的交汇点。这份报纸是一项公共信托，致力于追求真理与理性，报道范围涵盖突发新闻、政治、商业、金融市场、艺术、体育和社区，以及人与社会的交叉议题。你可以给我们发送电子邮件：hello@thisdaylive.com，或访问我们的联系我们页面

https://www.thisdaylive.com/2026/11/01/t.title: Taraba Killings Fields and the Crisis of Governance
https://www.thisdaylive.com/2026/11/01/t.summary: R ecent reports confirming the killing of 80 people in bandits’ attacks on the Binnari community in Karim Lamido Local Government Area of Taraba State have continued to break hearts, raising concerns about the federal government’s weakening capacity to protect the lives of Nigerians. On the day of the deadly attack, the Taraba State Police Command said only 10 bodies were recovered, but the next day, it said the death toll had risen to 58, including 15 people who drowned while fleeing in an overloaded canoe.
https://www.thisdaylive.com/2026/11/01/t.summary_zh: 近期有报道证实，塔拉巴州卡里姆拉米多地方政府辖区比纳里社区遭武装分子袭击，造成80人死亡，相关消息不断令人痛心，也引发人们对联邦政府保护尼日利亚人生命能力削弱的担忧。致命袭击当天，塔拉巴州警察司令部表示仅发现10具遗体，但第二天又称死亡人数已升至58人，其中包括15人在乘坐超载独木舟逃离时溺亡。
https://www.thisdaylive.com/2026/11/01/t.body: R ecent reports confirming the killing of 80 people in bandits’ attacks on the Binnari community in Karim Lamido Local Government Area of Taraba State have continued to break hearts, raising concerns about the federal government’s weakening capacity to protect the lives of Nigerians. The report recorded that the attack, which led to massive looting of shops and market stalls and setting of houses ablaze, occurred on Friday, October 23, the community’s weekly market day. The incident to place on a day when traders and buyers from surrounding settlements converged to exchange farm produce, food and other goods, just shortly after Juma’at prayers. Residents said the assailants stormed the community on motorcycles from neighbouring Plateau State, and carried out the four-hour reign of terror unchallenged. By the time the attackers withdrew, residents were searching nearby bushes and a river for their missing relatives, while burnt houses, damaged shops and abandoned belongings testified to the scale of the destruction. On the day of the deadly attack, the Taraba State Police Command said only 10 bodies were recovered, but the next day, it said the death toll had risen to 58, including 15 people who drowned while fleeing in an overloaded canoe. The police spokesperson, Victor Mshelizah, said search operations led to the recovery of additional bodies from surrounding bushes. By Tuesday, it was gathered that the death toll had further risen to 80. Beyond the loss of lives and property, the attack has renewed concerns about the ability of security agencies to protect isolated and vulnerable communities across the country. A trader identified only as Adamu said the assailants operated for hours without resistance. “We have no government in place,” he said, describing the duration of the attack and the destruction of goods during the market raid. Following the attack, the police announced the deployment of additional personnel, alongside the Nigerian Army and other security agencies. Residents were urged to remain calm, stay vigilant and provide credible information to security operatives. Condemning the killing, the global human rights organisation, Amnesty International, accused the federal government of failing to adequately protect vulnerable rural communities from repeated deadly attacks by gunmen and terrorists. The human rights organisation, in a statement, said the attack demonstrated a “disdain for the sanctity of life” and called for an impartial investigation, justice for the victims and adequate reparations for survivors. It said the incident reflected a wider pattern of violence against rural communities in parts of northern Nigeria, where armed groups have repeatedly attacked settlements, killed residents, destroyed property and abducted people. It further criticised the Nigerian authorities for what it described as their failure to prevent recurring atrocities and ensure that suspected perpetrators were brought to justice. The latest attack occurred despite Governor Agbu Kefas’ earlier intervention. Last January, he declared Karim-Lamido a special area of security concern through Executive Order No. 1 of 2026, citing recurring communal clashes, bandit-related attacks and violent herders’ attackers. The declaration was aimed at strengthening efforts to restore peace, protect residents and create conditions for normal economic and social activities. But violence has continued to threaten communities in the area. Observers feel that the Binnari killings are part of a wider pattern of insecurity in Taraba, where communal clashes, banditry, kidnapping and attacks on rural settlements have repeatedly threatened lives and livelihoods. The entire local government has featured prominently in the violence. Its location near the boundaries with Plateau, Bauchi and Gombe states added a cross-border dimension to security operations, particularly where armed groups can move through rural settlements and difficult terrain. In general, banditry has become a growing problem in North-west and North-central, with powerful gangs battling overstretched police and military across hard-to-reach, rural locations. Driven by money rather than ideology, the bandits in Nigeria target poorly policed rural areas, kidnapping for ransom and killing residents. The terror gangs raid villages and impose “taxes” on farmers and mining operations in areas with little state presence. The Armed Conflict Location and Event Data Project (ACLED), an independent, non-profit global research organisation and conflict monitor, recorded thousands of deaths (over 13,485 killed across North-Western states between 2010 and 2023, with a sharp surge of 2,742 casualties across 599 incidents in 2025 alone). Hundreds of thousands have been displaced. Bandits operate not as a single army, but as a loose “franchise” of over 120 armed groups led by regional commanders known as kachalas. Their tactics include mass motorcycle-borne raids, village destruction and looting, kidnap-for-ransom operations, cattle rustling, and imposing illegal “protection taxes” on farmers and miners. Originating from historical attacks on farmers and destruction of farmlands by herders, the crisis expanded due to climate change, shrinking grazing lands, poverty, gold-funded arms smuggling, and vast, unpoliced forested sanctuaries. The Nigerian military regularly launches air strikes and ground sweeps, yet they seem to be growing by the day. Local and state governments have occasionally attempted localised amnesties or peace talks, which critics and defence analysts argue fail because the gangs lack political ideology and repeatedly break truces. The primary responsibility of any government is securing the lives and property of its citizens, but the people hardly see this being demonstrated each time. As sad as the deaths were, there was not a single reaction or statement from the President Bola Tinubu and the Presidency, even as a succour to the community. Even though President Tinubu has repeatedly ordered troops to pursue suspected terrorists responsible for these mass killings of people across the country, Nigerians are yet to see any significant improvement, as people are still being killed almost daily. It was only the Senate that called for an urgent security offensive in border communities across Taraba, Plateau and Bauchi states. The lawmakers urged security agencies to establish additional security camps and intensify surveillance in the affected areas to prevent further attacks and protect vulnerable communities. The upper legislative chamber noted that the continued activities of armed bandits in rural communities undermined the government’s constitutional responsibility to protect lives and property. It warned that failure to address the recurring attacks could lead to further loss of lives, destruction of property, displacement of residents and worsening humanitarian challenges, and that no community should be left at the mercy of armed criminal groups. There is no country where the leaders truly value human lives that will not be jolted by the loss of 80 lives. In normal climes, the attack is enough to declare a state of emergency on insecurity in the state until the perpetrators are fished out and dealt with appropriately. But in Nigeria where the authorities and citizens are inundated with frequent news of massive killing, nothing bothers them anymore. Until authorities demonstrate that vulnerable communities such as Binnari are adequately protected, the killings will remain a grim reminder of the gap between official security commitments and the safety residents experience on the ground. https://www.thisdaylive.com/2026/11/01/t.title_zh: 塔拉巴州杀人案频发与治理危机
https://www.thisdaylive.com/2026/11/01/t.body_zh: 最新报道证实，武装劫匪袭击塔拉巴州卡里姆拉米多地方政府辖区宾纳里社区，造成80人死亡，消息不断令人痛心，也引发人们对联邦政府保护尼日利亚人生命安全能力削弱的担忧。报道称，袭击发生于10月23日星期五，即该社区每周一次的集市日。袭击导致大量商店和市场摊位遭洗劫，房屋被纵火焚毁。当天，附近聚居地的商贩和买家聚集在社区内 exchanged 农产品、食品及其他商品，事件就发生在他们刚刚结束主麻聚礼不久之后。居民称，袭击者从邻近的 Plateau 州骑摩托车冲入社区，并在无人抵抗的情况下持续了4小时的恐怖统治。袭击者撤离时，居民正在附近的灌木丛和河中寻找失踪的亲人，被焚毁的房屋、受损的商店和被遗弃的物品则见证了破坏的严重程度。致命袭击当天，塔拉巴州警察司令部表示仅发现10具遗体；但第二天又称，死亡人数已升至58人，其中包括15人在乘坐超载独木舟逃离时溺亡。警方发言人 Victor Mshelizah 表示，搜索行动从周边灌木丛中发现了更多遗体。到星期二，人们获悉死亡人数进一步升至80人。除了生命和财产损失外，此次袭击再次引发人们对安全机构保护全国偏远、脆弱社区能力的担忧。一名仅透露姓名为 Adamu 的商贩说，袭击者长达数小时未遇抵抗。他描述了袭击持续时间以及市场突袭中货物遭破坏的情况，并说：“我们这里没有政府。”袭击发生后，警方宣布增派人员，同时由尼日利亚陆军及其他安全机构配合行动。居民被敦促保持冷静、提高警惕，并向安全人员提供可靠信息。全球人权组织大赦国际谴责此次杀戮，指责联邦政府未能充分保护脆弱农村社区，使其免遭持枪犯罪分子和恐怖分子反复发动的致命袭击。该人权组织在一份声明中表示，此次袭击显示出对“生命神圣性”的蔑视，并呼吁开展公正调查，为受害者伸张正义，并给予幸存者充分赔偿。该组织称，这起事件反映了尼日利亚北部部分地区针对农村社区的更广泛暴力模式；武装团体一再袭击聚居地、杀害居民、破坏财产并绑架人口。该组织还批评尼日利亚当局未能阻止暴行再次发生，也未能确保将疑似犯罪者绳之以法。尽管州长 Agbu Kefas 此前采取了干预措施，最新袭击仍然发生。今年1月，他通过2026年第1号行政命令，将卡里姆拉米多列为特别安全关注地区，理由是当地社区冲突不断发生、武装劫匪袭击频仍，以及暴力牧民袭击事件。该声明旨在加强恢复和平、保护居民以及为正常经济和社会活动创造条件的工作。然而，暴力活动仍在威胁该地区社区。观察人士认为，宾纳里惨案是塔拉巴州更广泛安全局势恶化的一部分；当地社区冲突、匪患、绑架和针对农村聚居地的袭击一再威胁生命和生计。整个地方政府辖区在暴力事件中首当其冲。该地靠近 Plateau、Bauchi 和 Gombe 三州边界，为安全行动增加了跨境因素，尤其是在武装团体能够经由农村聚居地和崎岖地形流动的情况下。总体而言，武装匪患已成为尼日利亚西北部和中北部日益严重的问题，强大的犯罪团伙在难以抵达的偏远农村与警力不足、兵力吃紧的警察和军队抗衡。这些劫匪受金钱而非意识形态驱动，袭击治安薄弱的农村地区，通过绑架勒索赎金并杀害居民牟利。恐怖团伙突袭村庄，在国家力量鲜少介入的地区向农民和采矿活动征收“税费”。武装冲突地点与事件数据项目（ACLED）是一家独立、非营利的全球研究组织和冲突监测机构。该机构记录了数千人死亡：2010年至2023年期间，西北部各州共有超过13,485人死亡；仅2025年，599起事件便造成2,742人伤亡，增幅显著。数十万人被迫流离失所。武装劫匪并非作为单一军队行动，而是由120多个武装团体构成的松散“加盟网络”，由被称为 kachalas 的地区指挥官领导。他们惯用的手段包括大规模摩托车突袭、摧毁村庄、洗劫财物、绑架勒索、盗掠牲畜，以及向农民和矿工征收非法“保护费”。这场危机起源于牧民对农民的历史性袭击和农地破坏，随后因气候变化、牧场萎缩、贫困、由黄金资金支持的武器走私，以及大片缺乏治安管理的森林避难所而扩大。尼日利亚军方经常发动空袭和地面清剿，但袭击似乎仍在与日俱增。地方政府和州政府偶尔会尝试局部特赦或和平谈判，但批评者和国防分析人士认为，这些努力无法奏效，因为这些团伙缺乏政治理念，并且屡次违背停火协议。任何政府的首要责任都是保障公民生命和财产安全，但民众几乎看不到这一点在每一次事件中得到体现。死亡人数令人悲痛，但总统 Bola Tinubu 和总统府对此次袭击没有作出任何反应或声明，也没有向社区提供任何慰问。尽管 Tinubu 总统已多次命令部队追捕涉嫌制造全国多地大规模杀戮的恐怖分子，尼日利亚人仍未看到局势有显著改善，几乎每天仍有人丧生。只有参议院呼吁在塔拉巴州、Plateau 州和 Bauchi 州的边境社区紧急开展安全攻势。议员敦促安全机构设立更多安全营地，并加强受影响地区的监视，以防止进一步袭击并保护脆弱社区。参议院指出，武装劫匪持续在 rural 社区活动，削弱了政府保护生命和财产的宪法责任。参议院警告，若不处理反复发生的袭击，可能造成更多人员死亡、财产破坏、居民流离失所和人道主义挑战加剧，任何社区都不应落入武装犯罪集团的魔掌。80条生命的丧失足以震动任何真正珍视人生命的国家。在正常情况下，此次袭击已足以促使该州就安全问题宣布紧急状态，直至抓获肇事者并依法处置。但在尼日利亚，当局和公民不断看到大规模杀戮的消息，已经不会再为此感到不安。在当局证明已对宾纳里等脆弱社区提供充分保护之前，这些杀戮仍将是官方安全承诺与居民实际安全之间巨大落差的冷酷提醒。THISDAY https://www.thisdaylive.com/2026/11/01/o.summary_zh: 前參議院副議長歐維·歐莫-阿格吉參議員近日因嚴厲警告任何被抓到操縱2027年選舉的人都將被殺，引發廣泛憤怒。歐莫-阿格吉在其選區的一場政治活動上警告，任何企圖在即將舉行的投票中舞弊或操縱選票的人都將面臨嚴重後果。歐莫-阿格吉的言論不僅令人遗憾，而且缺乏謹慎，完全應受譴責。
https://www.thisdaylive.com/2026/11/01/o.body: Former Deputy President of the Senate, Senator Ovie Omo-Agege, sparked widespread outrage recently after issuing a stern warning that anyone caught manipulating the 2027 elections would be killed. Speaking at a political event in his constituency, Omo-Agege warned that anyone who attempted to rig or manipulate votes in the upcoming polls would face severe consequences. Addressing supporters and party faithful in Delta Central, Omo-Agege declared that the era of political actors subverting the popular mandate was over. Omo-Agege, who is seeking election to the Delta Central senatorial seat under the Nigeria Democratic Congress (NDC), emphasised that voters were prepared to defend their votes at polling units nationwide. “I want to make the news again. Anybody who rigs the election on that day, we will kill him! If you don’t value your life, come and rig the election. They’re rigging your future. They’re rigging the future of your children. We’re waiting for them. Let them try it. It is rig-and- die. We’re going to give them aura for aura. There’s no court this time. We’re going to fight,” he was quoted as saying. Omo-Agege declared his intention to contest for the Delta Central senatorial seat in the 2027 elections in May. He resigned his membership of the All Progressives Congress (APC) in a letter dated May and addressed to the chairman of the party’s Orogun Ward 2 in Ughelli North Local Government Area of Delta State. Omo-Agege’s comment was not only unfortunate but unguarded and totally condemnable. He should know that it is inappropriate for a man of his calibre to advocate for jungle justice. As a lawyer and a former lawmaker, he should know that the best way to treat anybody arrested for a crime, is to be handed over to the police for prosecution. The police should invite him for questioning, and if possible, to write an undertaking that he will not encourage the killing of anyone during the 2027 general election. https://www.thisdaylive.com/2026/11/01/o.title_zh: 奥莫-阿格吉毫无防备的“ rigged and die ”言论
https://www.thisdaylive.com/2026/11/01/o.body_zh: 参议院前副议长、参议员奥维·奥莫-阿格吉近日因严厉警告称，任何操纵2027年选举的人都会被杀，引发广泛愤慨。奥莫-阿格吉在其选区的一场政治活动上警告称，任何企图在即将举行的选举中舞弊或操纵选票的人都将面临严重后果。他在向中三角洲州的支持者和党内人士发表讲话时宣称，政治人物颠覆民意的时代已经结束。奥莫-阿格吉正以尼日利亚民主党（NDC）候选人身份角逐中三角洲州联邦参议院席位，他强调，选民已准备好在全国各地的投票站捍卫自己的选票。据报道，他说：“我要再次成为新闻人物。任何人在那一天操纵选举，我们就会杀了他！如果你不珍惜自己的生命，就来操纵选举吧。他们正在操纵你的未来，操纵你孩子的未来。我们正等着他们。让他们试试看。那就是舞弊和死亡。我们将以同样的手段回敬他们。这次没有法庭。我们将抗争到底。”奥莫-阿格吉于5月宣布 intends 参加2027年中三角洲州联邦参议院席位选举。他在5月写给尼日利亚三角洲州乌盖利北地方政府辖区该党奥罗贡第2选区主席的一封信中，辞去了全尼日利亚进步大会党（APC）的党籍。奥莫-阿格吉的言论不仅不幸，而且缺乏审慎，完全应受谴责。他应当知道，像他这样资历的人鼓吹丛林司法并不合适。作为一名律师和前立法者，他理应懂得，对任何因犯罪被捕的人，最恰当的处理方式是将其移交警方起诉。警方应邀请他接受询问，并尽可能要求他签署承诺书，保证在2027年大选期间不鼓励杀害任何人。THISDAY创刊于1995年1月22日，由THISDAY NEWSPAPERS LTD.出版，社址位于尼日利亚拉各斯阿帕帕克里克路35号，在尼日利亚36个州、联邦首都辖区及世界各地设有办公室。作为尼日利亚最权威的新闻媒体，该报通过所有平台为政治、商业、专业和外交精英以及更广泛的中产阶层提供服务，同时充当抱负者和千禧一代探索新思想、文化与技术的交汇点。该报是一项公共信托，致力于追求真理与理性，报道范围涵盖突发新闻、政治、商业、金融市场、艺术、体育和社区等议题，直面个人与社会之间的 crossroads。您可以发送邮件至：hello@thisdaylive.com，或访问我们的联系我们页面

https://www.lesahel.org/cnpcnp-arret-du-.source: Le Sahel（尼日尔官方报·法语）
https://www.lesahel.org/cnpcnp-arret-du-.summary: Selon des sources proches des opérations d’intervention sur le terrain, le déversement au niveau du puits GW-8 du champ pétrolier d’Agadem, qui suscitait une préoccupation constante des équipes d’intervention d’urgence, a cessé le 20 octobre. Le sable contaminé a fait l’objet d’une prise en charge appropriée et la situation est entièrement maîtrisée.
https://www.lesahel.org/cnpcnp-arret-du-.summary_zh: 据与实地干预行动有关的消息人士称，Agadem油田GW-8油井的井口喷流已停止，这股喷流此前一直令应急干预团队担忧。喷流已于10月20日停止。受污染的沙子已得到妥善处置，局势已得到全面控制。
https://www.lesahel.org/cnpcnp-arret-du-.body: Selon des sources proches des opérations d’intervention sur le terrain, le déversement au niveau du puits GW-8 du champ pétrolier d’Agadem, qui suscitait une préoccupation constante des équipes d’intervention d’urgence, a cessé le 20 octobre. L’état du puits s’est stabilisé. À ce jour, aucun décès ni blessé n’est à déplorer. Le sable contaminé a fait l’objet d’une prise en charge appropriée et la situation est entièrement maîtrisée. Les travaux visant à consolider la sécurité du site et à réhabiliter l’environnement se poursuivent. Le mélange de pétrole brut et d’eau ne s’écoule plus de la tête du puits GW-8. Pour les équipes mobilisées dans les opérations d’urgence depuis le début du déversement, le 25 septembre, cet arrêt signifie que les premières mesures de neutralisation du puits ont produit leurs effets. Il marque une avancée majeure dans les opérations d’urgence et crée des conditions plus favorables à la poursuite des travaux. Situé au cœur du désert du Sahara, dans le département de N’Gourti, ce puits se trouve loin des villes et des zones habitées. Aucun habitant ne réside dans un rayon de cinq (5) kilomètres du site. Cet événement a été provoqué par une détérioration du tubage au niveau de la tête du puits, entraînant un déversement de pétrole brut. Malgré l’éloignement des zones habitées, la CNPCNP, opérateur du champ pétrolier dans le cadre des opérations conjointes, a veillé, tout au long des opérations d’intervention, au respect des exigences de sécurité sur le site et de protection de l’environnement. Dès la survenue de cette situation d’urgence, la CNPCNP a immédiatement informé les autorités compétentes et déclenché rapidement les procédures d’intervention d’urgence. Elle a arrêté le fonctionnement des pompes, coupé l’alimentation électrique, établi des périmètres de sécurité, interdit l’introduction de toute source d’ignition sur site et assuré une surveillance continue des gaz présents sur le site. Les deux autres puits voisins du GW-8 ont également été successivement mis à l’arrêt et soumis à des mesures de sécurisation, afin d’éviter qu’ils ne soient affectés par cet événement. Ces dispositions traduisent une responsabilité claire : tout en faisant face à la situation d’urgence existante, éviter autant que possible l’apparition de nouveaux risques. Après plusieurs phases d’intervention, la majeure partie des souillures pétrolières présentes sur le site du puits a déjà été récupérée et nettoyée. Les couches sols sableux superficiellement affectées par l’écoulement du pétrole brut ont également été décapées. La concrétisation des responsabilités à chaque étape constitue une démarche commune des parties chinoise et nigérienne. Cette intervention d’urgence a mis à l’épreuve non seulement les compétences techniques nécessaires aux interventions au niveau de la tête du puits, mais aussi la mobilisation des équipements, le transport des matériels, l’organisation du personnel et la coordination entre les différentes équipes. L’acheminement de chaque équipement et de chaque lot de matériel jusqu’au site nécessitait un travail d’organisation et de transport. Le Ministère du Pétrole a dépêché un groupe de travail pour soutenir et orienter les opérations d’intervention d’urgence. Les autorités de suivi et du contrôle environnemental et les représentants des autorités locales ont également assuré le suivi des opérations sur le terrain. Le 14 octobre, le Ministre du Pétrole et le Ministre chargé de l’Environnement ont conduit une délégation gouvernementale de haut niveau sur le site pour une visite de terrain. Tout au long de cet événement, les autorités compétentes ont été tenues informées de la situation et ont assuré le suivi et la supervision des opérations. De son côté, la partie chinoise a fourni un soutien technique spécialisé ainsi que des ressources destinées aux interventions d’urgence. Des experts et des spécialistes d’intervention d’urgence ont été dépêchés de la Chine en plusieurs équipes pour rejoindre celles déjà présentes sur le champ pétrolier et participer ensemble aux opérations. La partie nigérienne n’a, quant à elle, ménagé aucun effort pour l’entrée du personnel sur le territoire, les formalités douanières relatives aux matériels et les dispositifs de sécurité. Les entreprises contractantes venues de différents pays ont chacune assumé leurs tâches respectives, contribuant tous ensemble à la sécurité du site et à la maîtrise de la situation d’urgence. L’expérience accumulée et les mécanismes de coordination établis au fil de nombreuses années de coopération pétrolière entre la Chine et le Niger ont également joué un rôle dans cette intervention. La situation au niveau de la tête du puits est maîtrisée, mais les travaux de réhabilitation environnementale se poursuivent. À ce jour, le Bureau National d’Évaluation Environnementale (BNEE) a engagé un examen de conformité environnementale. Les équipes présentes sur le terrain travaillent en coordination avec les autorités gouvernementales compétentes et les communautés locales afin d’accélérer l’évaluation des impacts environnementaux et les opérations de réhabilitation écologique, en mettant tout en œuvre pour réduire au minimum les conséquences de cet événement. Les causes font toujours l’objet d’une enquête. Pour ceux qui suivent l’évolution de cet événement, ce sont les progrès concrets des opérations et les résultats visibles des travaux de nettoyage qui permettent de renforcer la confiance. Les travaux concernant le puits GW-8 se poursuivent. Grâce à l’organisation des interventions d’urgence, à la mise en œuvre des mesures techniques et à la mobilisation des ressources, la CNPCNP a fait preuve d’un professionnalisme technique remarquable, d’une discipline rigoureuse et d’une excellente capacité à faire face aux situations d’urgence. Cette approche transparente et professionnelle dans la gestion de cet événement contribue également à consolider la confiance mutuelle entre les deux parties dans les domaines de la gouvernance environnementale et de la gestion de la sécurité
https://www.lesahel.org/cnpcnp-arret-du-.title_zh: CNPCNP——阿加德姆GW-8号油井停止泄漏：紧急情况已得到全面控制
https://www.lesahel.org/cnpcnp-arret-du-.body_zh: 据与现场干预行动有关的消息，Agadem油田GW-8井的泄漏已停止。该泄漏此前一直令应急干预人员担忧，停止时间为10月20日。井口状况已稳定。截至目前，未造成人员死亡或受伤。受污染的沙土已得到妥善处置，局势已完全得到控制。为加强现场安全并修复环境而开展的工作仍在继续。原油和水的混合物已不再从GW-8井井口流出。自9月25日泄漏发生以来一直参与应急行动的队伍表示，此次停流意味着井口初步中和措施已取得成效。这标志着应急行动取得重大进展，并为后续工作的继续开展创造了更有利的条件。该井位于撒哈拉沙漠腹地，处在N’Gourti县，远离城镇和居民区。现场周边五（5）公里范围内没有居民居住。此次事件由井口套管劣化引发，造成原油泄漏。尽管居民区距离现场较远，作为联合运营框架下该油田运营商的CNPCNP，在整个干预行动期间始终确保遵守现场安全及环境保护要求。紧急情况发生后，CNPCNP立即通知主管机关，并迅速启动应急干预程序。公司停止泵机运行，切断电源，划定安全警戒区，禁止将任何火源带入现场，并持续监测现场气体。GW-8附近的其他两口井也已先后停运并采取安全防护措施，以防受到此次事件影响。这些措施体现了明确的责任意识：在应对现有紧急情况的同时，尽可能避免产生新的风险。经过多个阶段的干预，现场井口区域的大部分石油污染物已得到回收和清理。受到原油流浅层影响的沙土地层也已剥除。各阶段落实责任，是中尼双方共同推动的工作。此次应急行动不仅考验了井口干预所需的技术能力，也考验了设备调集、物资运输、人员组织和不同队伍之间的协调。将每件设备和每批物资运至现场，都需要周密组织和运输。石油部已派出工作组，为应急干预行动提供支持和指导。环境跟踪与监管机构以及地方当局代表也对现场行动进行跟踪。10月14日，石油部长和主管环境事务的部长率领政府高级代表团赴现场视察。整个事件期间，主管机关始终了解情况，并对行动进行跟踪和监督。中方则提供了专业技术支持以及用于应急干预的resources。中国以多个小组为单位派出应急干预专家和技术人员，与已在油田现场的人员会合，共同参与行动。尼日利亚方面为人员入境、物资海关手续和安全措施提供全力支持。来自不同国家的承包企业各自履行职责，共同为现场安全和紧急局势的控制作出贡献。中尼多年来在石油领域合作中积累的经验和建立的协调机制，也在此次干预中发挥了作用。目前，井口局势已得到控制，但环境修复工作仍在继续。截至目前，国家环境评估局（BNEE）已启动环境合规审查。现场队伍正与政府主管机关和当地社区协调工作，加快环境影响评估和生态修复行动，并竭尽全力将此次事件造成的后果降至最低。事件原因仍在调查之中。对于关注此次事态进展的人士而言，行动取得的切实进展和清理工作呈现的成果，正不断增强各方的信心。GW-8井相关工作仍在继续。凭借应急行动的组织、技术措施的实施和资源调集，CNPCNP展现了出色的技术专业能力、严格的纪律和卓越的应急处置能力。在此次事件管理中采取透明、专业的做法，也有助于加强双方在环境治理和安全管理领域的互信

https://businesspost.ng/general/illegal-.body: The Economic and Financial Crimes Commission (EFCC) has arrested 15 suspects, comprising 14 Chinese and one Nigerian, at four illegal lithium processing plants in the Ogere area of Ogun State. The commission disclosed this in a post on its official X account, stating that operatives of its Lagos Zonal Directorate 2 carried out the arrests on Friday, October 23, 2026, following credible intelligence and surveillance. Items recovered during the operation included bags of lithium rocks, 18 mobile devices, four computer laptops, two decoders, a television remote control and a trailer truck. The EFCC said the recovered items had been taken as part of its investigation into the activities of the facilities, adding that the suspects would be charged to court upon the conclusion of investigations. However, the agency did not disclose the specific offences the suspects were alleged to have committed or the ownership of the processing plants. Lithium has become a highly sought-after mineral globally because of its critical role in manufacturing rechargeable batteries used in electric vehicles, smartphones, laptops and renewable energy storage systems. Growing demand for electric vehicles and clean energy technologies has intensified the race to secure lithium supplies, making the mineral increasingly valuable and creating incentives for illegal mining and processing. Nigeria is emerging as a new source of lithium in Africa as the world’s largest producers, like Australia and Chile, are unable to fulfil the growing demand worldwide. However, illegal activities thrive in Nigeria’s extractive sector, denying the government due revenues of up to $9 billion, according to the Nigeria Extractive Industries Transparency Initiative (NEITI). The country’s lithium deposits have attracted growing interest from local and foreign operators, while concerns over unregulated extraction, revenue losses, environmental degradation, and the potential circumvention of mining regulations have heightened calls for stricter enforcement. https://businesspost.ng/general/illegal-.body_zh: 经济和金融犯罪委员会（EFCC）在奥贡州奥盖雷地区的4家非法锂加工厂逮捕了15名嫌疑人，其中14名为中国人、1名为尼日利亚人。该委员会在其官方X账号发布的一则消息中披露，拉各斯第2区分局行动人员于2026年10月23日星期五根据可靠情报和监视行动实施了逮捕。行动中缴获的物品包括装在袋中的锂矿石、18部移动设备、4台笔记本电脑、2个解码器、1个电视遥控器和1辆拖挂卡车。EFCC表示，缴获的物品已作为调查这些工厂经营活动的一部分被查扣，并称调查结束后将把嫌疑人移交法院起诉。然而，该机构没有披露嫌疑人被指控实施的具体罪行，也没有披露这些加工厂的归属。锂已成为全球备受追捧的矿产，因为它在制造用于电动汽车、智能手机、笔记本电脑和可再生能源储存系统的可充电电池方面发挥着关键作用。电动汽车和清洁能源技术需求不断增长，加剧了各国争夺锂供应的竞争，使这种矿产的价值日益提高，也刺激了非法采矿和加工活动。随着澳大利亚和智利等全球最大生产国无法满足全球不断增长的需求，尼日利亚正成为非洲新的锂来源。然而，尼日利亚采掘业的非法活动十分猖獗，使政府损失最高达90亿美元的收入，据尼日利亚采掘业透明度倡议（NEITI）称。该国的锂矿藏吸引了越来越多的本地和外国运营商关注，同时，对不受监管的开采、收入流失、环境破坏以及规避采矿法规的担忧，也强化了要求加强执法的呼声。Adedapo Adesanya是一名记者、多才多艺的学者，也是艺术各个领域的行家。不写作时，他不是埋首阅读自己收藏夹中的众多书籍或文章之一，就是拿着一瓶啤酒或葡萄酒聆听好音乐。他支持世界上最伟大的俱乐部——Manchester United F.C.

It said this temporary measure aimed to improve the smooth running of operations while guaranteeing deliveries and the availability of petrol, following a countrywide shortage. But the measure is impacting taxis drivers, like Moussa Idé Boubacar, who said he has not been able to make his payments for two days. “Normally, we generate revenue of around 20,000 a day, of which 8,000 is for payments and 12,000 is for fuel. Residents in the capital, Niamey, and elsewhere said this was disrupting daily life, making it difficult to get to work and carry out their daily activities. Sanda added that the union wanted to draw the authorities’ attention to the fact that the transport sector “makes a significant contribution to the country’s development”. https://x.com/sun_jun69301/status/211746.title: Tarriela, you seem obsessed with blaming China for every problem the Philippines faces, using legal jargon to disguise your government’s fai
https://x.com/sun_jun69301/status/211746.snippet:
Tarriela, you seem obsessed with blaming China for every problem the Philippines faces, using legal jargon to disguise your government’s failures and justify its anti-China agenda.

Let’s be clear: China is not responsible for the Philippine government’s repeated policy failures.

The 2005 JMSU was declared unconstitutional by the Philippine Supreme Court because of problems within the Philippines’ own constitutional and decision-making framework. China did not write your Constitution.

The 2018 oil and gas cooperation MOU preserved both sides’ legal positions and created no binding obligation for joint development. After years of negotiations, the Philippine side terminated the talks. You cannot rewrite that history simply to make China the villain.

And stop waving the 2016 arbitration ruling as though it gave the Philippines sovereignty over the South China Sea. It did not settle territorial sovereignty or maritime boundaries. You cannot turn a limited arbitration ruling into a political weapon to justify your country’s ambitions.

What is even more revealing is that the Philippines continues to pursue confrontation with China while failing to secure broad support among ASEAN members for its hardline anti-China agenda.

ASEAN does not belong to Manila, and the South China Sea is not your personal political stage.

China has every right to defend its sovereignty, territorial integrity, maritime rights and national interests. No amount of political grandstanding by Philippine officials will change that.

The Filipino people deserve affordable energy, investment, jobs and economic development. They do not need politicians manufacturing hostility toward their largest neighbors to cover up domestic failures.

The 2005 JMSU was declared unconstitutional by the Philippine Supreme Court because of problems within the Philippines’ own constitutional and decision-making framework. China did not write your Constitution.

https://x.com/jaytaryela/status/21173835.title: Mr. Senator, tama po kayo, dalawang administrasyon ang nagtulak ng joint exploration. Pero hindi po ang ating Constitution ang may sala, kun
https://x.com/jaytaryela/status/21173835.snippet:
Mr. Senator, tama po kayo, dalawang administrasyon ang nagtulak ng joint exploration. Pero hindi po ang ating Constitution ang may sala, kundi ang China. As a matter of fact, ang Constitution pa nga ang pumigil para hindi unfairly ma-exploit ang ating likas na yaman!

Itama lang po natin ang sharing arrangements na binanggit ninyo:

1. JMSU, 2005 (President Gloria Macapagal Arroyo)

Hindi po ang Pangulo ang pumirma kundi ang PNOC, kasama ang CNOOC ng China at PetroVietnam. Pantay ang karapatan ng tatlong partido, kaya one-third lang ang boses ng Pilipinas sa 142,886 sq km na Agreement Area, na karamihan ay nasa loob ng ating EEZ at continental shelf. Pati ang seismic data ay jointly owned, at kailangan pa ng written consent ng CNOOC at PetroVietnam bago ito ma-disclose ng ating gobyerno. 

Kaya sa botong 12-2-1, idineklara ng Supreme Court na unconstitutional at void ang JMSU (Bayan Muna v. Macapagal-Arroyo, G.R. No. 182734, 10 Enero 2023). Ibinasura nang may finality ang Motion for Reconsideration noong 27 Hunyo 2023. Sabi pa ng Korte, dahil nasa loob ng ating EEZ at continental shelf ang lugar, ang anumang likas na yaman doon ay pag-aari ng Republika.

2. MOU on Oil and Gas Development, 2018 (President Duterte)

Walang 60-40 na nakasulat sa MOU. Framework lang ito para magbukas ng negosasyon. Ang "60-40" ay hango sa Constitution at sa Oil Exploration and Development Act ng Pilipinas, na siyang nagtatakda ng Service Contract system.
Bakit natigil ang usapan noong Hunyo 2022? Dahil ayaw ng China na pumasok sa ilalim ng ating Service Contract system, na kumikilalang atin ang langis at gas sa ating EEZ at continental shelf. Si dating Pangulong Duterte mismo ang nagsabing hindi ito puwedeng kapalit ng soberanya, kahit katiting.

Kaya hindi po Constitution ang humaharang. Pwede po tayong mag-enter into joint development sa foreign corporations, private man o state-owned, pero subject sa requirements ng Constitution at ng ating Service Contract system. Ang tunay na humaharang ay ang pagtanggi ng China na kilalanin na atin ang langis, gas at mineral sa ating EEZ at continental shelf.

Hindi rin Constitution ang humarang sa survey ng M/V Veritas Voyager sa Recto Bank noong Marso 2011. Mga barko ng China Marine Surveillance iyon, at ayon sa 2016 Arbitral Award, nilabag ng China ang ating sovereign rights sa non-living resources ng ating continental shelf sa Recto Bank (UNCLOS Art. 77; Award ¶716, ¶1203.B(8)).

Kung may dapat sisihin kung bakit hindi natin mapakinabangan ang sarili nating langis at gas, hindi ang ating Constitution kundi ang China. 

Agree din po ako sa sinabi ninyo maging bulldog tayo para sa mamamayang Pilipino at hindi maging tuta para sa iisang pamilya!

https://x.com/jaytaryela/status/21173835.title_zh: 参议员先生，您错了，是两个政府启动了联合勘探。但有错的不是我们的宪法，而是……
https://x.com/jaytaryela/status/21173835.snippet_zh:
参议员先生，是你们错了：有两个政府推动联合勘探。但有过错的不是我们的《宪法》，而是中国。事实上，还是《宪法》阻止了我们的自然资源遭到不公平的开发！

我们只纠正一下您提到的分享安排：

1. JMSU，2005年（总统格洛丽亚·马卡帕加尔·阿罗约）

签字的不是总统，而是菲律宾国家石油公司（PNOC），中国海洋石油有限公司（CNOOC）和越南石油（PetroVietnam）也参与其中。三方权利平等，因此菲律宾在面积142,886平方公里的协议区内只有三分之一的话语权，而该区域大部分位于我们的专属经济区和大陆架内。地震数据也由三方共同所有，在我国政府披露之前，还须取得CNOOC和越南石油的书面同意。

因此，在12比2比1的裁决中，最高法院宣布JMSU违宪且无效（Bayan Muna诉Macapagal-Arroyo案，G.R. No. 182734，2023年1月10日）。复议动议于2023年6月27日被最终驳回。法院还指出，由于该地区位于我们的专属经济区和大陆架内，那里的任何自然资源均归共和国所有。

2. 《石油和天然气开发谅解备忘录》，2018年（总统杜特尔特）

谅解备忘录中并未写入60比40的安排。这只是一份为开启谈判而制定的框架。“60比40”的规定来自菲律宾《宪法》和《石油勘探与开发法》，后者确立了服务合同制度。

为什么谈判在2022年6月陷入停滞？因为中国不愿进入我们的服务合同制度，而该制度在我们专属经济区和大陆架内勘探、开采石油和天然气方面切实保护我们权益。前总统杜特尔特本人也表示，这一安排无论如何都不能替代主权。

因此，阻碍谈判的不是《宪法》。我们确实可以与外国公司开展联合开发，无论是私营公司还是国有公司，但必须遵守《宪法》和我国服务合同制度的要求。真正的阻碍是中国拒绝承认我国专属经济区和大陆架内的石油、天然气及矿产资源属于我们。

2011年3月，“Veritas Explorer”号在Recto Bank进行测量时，阻碍行动的也不是《宪法》。那些船只属于中国海警，而根据2016年仲裁裁决，中国侵犯了我国对Recto Bank大陆架非生物资源的主权权利（《联合国海洋法公约》第77条；裁决书第716段、第1203.B(8)段）。

如果非要追究我们为什么无法从自己的石油和天然气资源中获益，过错方不是我们的《宪法》，而是中国。

我也赞同您的说法：为了菲律宾人民，我应做斗牛犬，而不做一个家族的奴仆！

https://x.com/grok/status/21173652745003.snippet:
The map satirizes EU policy: direct Russian pipeline gas labeled "bad," while the same resource flows to China as "good."

Logic is geopolitical. After 2022 cutoffs weaponized dependence, EU cut pipeline imports ~90% (share from ~40% to ~10-15%). Remaining LNG under old contracts is being phased out fully by Jan 2027, pipeline by late 2027, to deny Russia leverage and war revenue without instant market shock.

China takes Power of Siberia at capacity (~39 bcm) at steep discounts; long-haul LNG routes are costly and tanker-limited, so volumes stay lower. Costly for EU industry, but deliberate decoupling rather than pure idiocy.

https://x.com/ys_pritam_avhad/status/211.title: India does need to strengthen its manufacturing base.
https://x.com/ys_pritam_avhad/status/211.snippet:
India does need to strengthen its manufacturing base. That part of your argument is valid. But attributing the trade imbalance almost entirely to India's structural weaknesses is an incomplete analysis.

In FY26, India exported $19.47 billion to China while importing $131.63 billion. This is not just a manufacturing issue. It is also a question of reciprocal market access.

If Chinese companies enjoy access to India's vast market, Indian businesses should have comparable opportunities in China. Indian exporters continue to face regulatory and non tariff barriers.

India also has legitimate reasons to reduce excessive dependence on a country with which it has unresolved strategic and border tensions. Supply chain diversification is risk management, not necessarily protectionism.

India must become more competitive, but China must also make its market more accessible. Trade cannot be judged only by how efficiently one country sells. Reciprocity, transparency and mutual trust matter too.

A balanced trade relationship requires responsibility from both sides, not a lecture directed at India alone.

https://x.com/ys_pritam_avhad/status/211.title_zh: 印度确实需要加强其制造业基础。
https://x.com/ys_pritam_avhad/status/211.snippet_zh:
印度确实需要夯实制造业基础。您论证中的这一点是成立的。但将贸易失衡几乎完全归因于印度的结构性弱点，分析并不完整。

2025—2026财年，印度向中国出口194.7亿美元，而从中国进口1316.3亿美元。这不仅仅是制造业问题，也涉及市场准入的对等性。

如果中国企业能够进入印度庞大的市场，印度企业也应当在中国获得同等机会。印度出口商仍面临监管和非关税壁垒。

印度也有充分理由降低对一个与其存在未解决的战略和边界紧张局势国家的过度依赖。供应链多元化属于风险管理，未必意味着保护主义。

印度必须提高竞争力，但中国也必须让本国市场更易进入。评价贸易不能只看一个国家销售商品的能力。互惠、透明和相互信任同样重要。

平衡的贸易关系需要双方共同承担责任，而不是只对印度进行说教。

印中边境新的对峙事件使阿鲁纳恰尔邦成为焦点，引发外界对北京沿实际控制线（LAC）意图的担忧。

10月22日，印藏边境警察部队总监沙特鲁吉特·卡普尔证实，阿鲁纳恰尔邦边境多个地点发生对峙，紧张局势集中在上苏班西里县的阿萨菲拉地区。

中国是否正在推行“萨拉米香肠切片”策略——逐步测试印度阵地并推进边界，而不引发全面冲突？

由于中国在西藏享有基础设施优势，印度正在加快边境连通和监视工作，以加强防御。

这些对峙事件是孤立的，还是精心策划的战略的一部分，旨在让印度持续承受压力？

https://x.com/asthana_shashi/status/2116.title: Decoding the LAC: Why Headline Sensationalism Misses the Ground Reality of India-China Border Dynamics?
https://x.com/asthana_shashi/status/2116.snippet:
Decoding the LAC: Why Headline Sensationalism Misses the Ground Reality of India-China Border Dynamics? Already viewed by > 450,000

Media headlines thrive on sensationalism and panic, but national security is governed by cold terrain friction, historical legalities, and strategic calculus and military prowess.

In a recent deep-dive discussion on Ankit Inspires India I, alongside my fellow veteran Maj Gen Sanjay Meston, dismantled prevailing ambiguities and viral social media narratives surrounding India’s northern borders—revealing what routine media reporting misses by anchoring our analysis strictly in professional military experience and verifiable open-source research.

Key Insights from the Discussion

1. Deconstructing "Face-Offs" vs. Incursions: The Line of Actual Control is not a mutually demarcated international border; it is an alignment marked by differing perceptions and overlapping patrol limits. Stand-offs occur when simultaneous patrols encounter each other along disputed pockets—managed strictly through structured protocols and Confidence Building Measures (CBMs), not spontaneous tactical collapse.

2. The Arunachal Reality & Historical Context: From the legal framework of the 1914 Simla Convention and the McMahon Line to the 1962 conflict dynamics and Major Bob Khathing’s consolidation of Tawang, Indian sovereignty over Arunachal Pradesh is unassailable. Viral maps and satellite imagery often mistake border village infrastructure on China’s side for incursions, missing the substantial multi-tier defense and infrastructure India has operationalized along the watershed.

3. Operational Command and Synergy: The frontlines are anchored by the Indian Army holds primary operational command and dominates key tactical heights, integrating paramilitary forces like ITBP seamlessly.

4. The Strategic Dilemma: Why hasn't the border been resolved? Both nations face insurmountable domestic political costs regarding territorial trade-offs. Furthermore, at the macro-strategic level, Beijing is acutely aware that a kinetic conflict with India offers zero strategic dividends—it risks disrupting critical sea lines of communication across the Indian Ocean and disproportionately benefits other global powers.

"At the macro-strategic level, a full-scale kinetic conflict offers no strategic victory for Beijing. The terrain friction of Himalayas serve as India’s defensive asset, and any major misadventure by China risks its maritime lifelines across Indian Ocean while serving third-party geopolitical interests." Shashi Asthana

https://x.com/asthana_shashi/status/2116.snippet_zh:
解码实际控制线：为什么头条耸人听闻的报道忽略了印度-中国边境动态的地面现实？浏览量已超过45万

媒体头条靠耸人听闻和制造恐慌而兴盛，但国家安全由严酷的地形摩擦、历史法律依据、战略考量和军事能力所主导。

在最近一次安基特启发印度频道的深度讨论中，我与退役少将桑杰·梅斯顿一同拆解了围绕印度北部边境的普遍模糊认识和病毒式社交媒体叙事——通过严格锚定在专业军事经验和可验证开源研究上的分析，揭示了常规媒体报道所忽略的内容。

讨论要点

1. 解构“对峙”与“入侵”：实际控制线并非双方共同划定的国际边界；而是由不同认知和重叠巡逻范围所标示的一条线。当双方巡逻队在有争议的地段同时相遇时就会发生对峙——这些对峙通过结构化的协议和建立信任措施（CBMs）严格管理，而非战术突然崩溃。

2. 阿鲁纳恰尔邦的现实与历史背景：从1914年西姆拉会议和麦克马洪线的法律框架，到1962年冲突动态以及鲍勃·卡廷少校对达旺的巩固，印度对阿鲁纳恰尔邦的主权不可动摇。病毒式传播的地图和卫星图像常常将中方一侧的边境村庄基础设施误认为是入侵，忽略了印度沿分水岭已投入使用的多层次防御和基础设施。

3. 作战指挥与协同：前线由印度陆军掌握主要作战指挥权并主导关键战术高地，同时无缝整合印度边防部队等准军事力量。

4. 战略困境：为什么边界问题尚未解决？两国在领土让步方面都面临难以逾越的国内政治代价。此外，在宏观战略层面，北京清楚地意识到与印度发生动能冲突不会带来任何战略红利——这会危及印度洋关键海上交通线，并不成比例地使其他全球大国受益。

“在宏观战略层面，全面动能冲突不会给北京带来任何战略胜利。喜马拉雅山脉的地形摩擦是印度的防御资产，中国任何重大冒险都可能危及其穿越印度洋的海上生命线，同时服务于第三方地缘政治利益。”沙希·阿斯塔纳
